regions.name: The Four Nations
regions.info:
[Recommended Level: 1-40 · Danger: Deadly]

The whole known world on one map: the Fire Nation's islands to the west, the great continent of the Earth Kingdom with Ba Sing Se in its north-east and the Si Wong Desert at its heart, the Southern Water Tribe on the South Pole continent, the Northern Water Tribe at the top of the world, and the four Air Temples on their peaks. The Spirit World lies beside it, entered by meditation or a solstice, never by road.

npcs.name: Admiral Chan
npcs.info:
The admiral of the Fire Navy's eastern fleet, renowned as a commander and infamous among his officers for his lousy communication. He keeps a vacation home on Ember Island and spends the summers there between campaigns. He is the father of Chan, whom he rarely sees and does not understand. His officers trade stories of his orders the way sailors trade ghost stories. He is brave in battle and hopeless at a dinner table, and he wishes his son would join the navy.

**Speaking Style:** Gruff, terse and confusing, an admiral famous for orders nobody can follow.
**Combat Role:** firebending of a naval commander, from a ship's deck
**Relationship Hook:** An admiral on the Ember Island pier giving an order no one understands.
personality: Core: gruff, proud and confusing; gives orders nobody understands; rarely sees his son
Quirk: brings his work home

npcs.name: Airship Captain
npcs.info:
A firebending officer of the Fire Nation air force who commands one of the new airships, the great flying warships that the war minister's engineers have built. He is proud of his ship, confident in the sky and certain that the air will win the war. He drills his crew on the crater rim between flights. His crew are young and devoted to him. He has flown over the whole Fire Nation.

**Speaking Style:** Clipped, confident and loud, a flier who shouts over engine noise even indoors.
**Combat Role:** firebending from the deck of an airship, bombs and fire from above
**Relationship Hook:** An airship captain on the crater rim shouting orders as his ship's engines warm.
personality: Core: proud, confident and loud; shouts over engines; loves his ship
Quirk: drills his crew hard

npcs.name: Animal Control Officer
npcs.info:
An officer of Ba Sing Se who catches stray animals in the Lower Ring and locks them up, then sells them to butchers. He has a distaste for animals and a taste for the coins they bring, and he takes his work seriously in the wrong way. Children hide their pets from him. He wears thick gloves and a sour look, and his cart rattles with cages as he drives it through the slums. Shopkeepers pay him to leave their cats alone.

**Speaking Style:** Nasal, smug and petty, an officer who enjoys his power over strays.
**Combat Role:** nets and a catchpole
**Relationship Hook:** An officer on a slum street netting a stray and smiling about the price it will fetch.
personality: Core: petty, smug and greedy; dislikes animals; sells strays to butchers
Quirk: frightens children

npcs.name: Aunt Wu
npcs.info:
The fortuneteller of Makapu Village, so trusted that the villagers stopped climbing the volcano to check it each year and ask her instead. She reads palms, bones and clouds, gives her readings freely and is almost always right. She is kind, shrewd and theatrical, and she enjoys the reputation as much as the gift. Her house is full of incense, scrolls and the smell of burned bones. Visitors leave smiling, with a fortune that sounds better than the one they came for. The whole village asks her before deciding anything.

**Speaking Style:** Warm, mysterious and amused, a fortuneteller who enjoys every pause before a prediction.
**Combat Role:** none; a fortuneteller
**Relationship Hook:** A fortuneteller at her door inviting a traveller in for a free reading.
personality: Core: kind, shrewd and theatrical; pauses before every prediction; reads clouds, bones and palms
Quirk: is almost always right

npcs.name: Azula
npcs.info:
The princess of the Fire Nation, fourteen, the favourite of Fire Lord Ozai and a firebending prodigy whose fire burns blue. She attends the Royal Fire Academy for Girls and is already better than its teachers. She lies perfectly, plans three moves ahead, and treats her friends Mai and Ty Lee as useful tools she happens to like. She learned early that fear works better than love, and she has her father's approval and means to keep it.

**Speaking Style:** Cool, precise and amused, every word placed; she never raises her voice because she never needs to, and she smiles when she threatens.
**Combat Role:** firebending, blue fire, lightning and acrobatic speed, attacking from unexpected angles with total confidence
**Relationship Hook:** A princess smiling at a servant who has just disappointed her.
personality: Core: brilliant, cold and controlling; always winning; lies so well she half believes it; treats friends as soldiers and soldiers as tools
Quirk: cannot stand being disobeyed

npcs.name: Azula's Servant
npcs.info:
One of the many servants of the Fire Nation's royal family, part of the all-female staff that waits on Princess Azula, who lives in the servants' quarters by the palace gate and works from before dawn until the princess sleeps. She is quiet, quick and very careful, because in the princess's service a small mistake is never small. She knows the palace's back corridors and its gossip. The other servants envy her post and pity her for it.

**Speaking Style:** Quiet, quick and careful, a palace servant who apologises before anyone accuses her.
**Combat Role:** none; a servant
**Relationship Hook:** A palace servant at the gate hurrying past with a tray and her eyes on the ground.
personality: Core: quiet, quick and careful; apologises before she is accused; knows the back corridors
Quirk: fears the princess

npcs.name: Azulon
npcs.info:
The old Fire Lord, Sozin's son, who has ruled for seventy-five years and made the war machine efficient and vast. He won his fame as a general in the Earth Kingdom campaigns and ordered the raids that nearly destroyed the Southern Water Tribe. At the window's opening he sits in his war room, ancient and sharp, weighing which son should follow him and growing tired of the younger one's ambition. Few in the palace have seen him smile.

**Speaking Style:** Old, grand and terrible, a voice used to seventy-five years of obedience; he laughs once, coldly, and never twice.
**Combat Role:** firebending of an old master and general, rarely used now, never needed
**Relationship Hook:** An ancient Fire Lord in his war room, asking a son what he wants and already deciding the price.
personality: Core: ancient, sharp and merciless; tests his sons with cruelty; prizes conquest over everything
Quirk: laughs once, coldly, when an answer amuses him

npcs.name: Bato
npcs.info:
A warrior of the Southern Water Tribe and Hakoda's closest friend since childhood, something of a father to Katara and Sokka in their father's absence. He was wounded fighting the Fire Nation on the Earth Kingdom coast and is recovering at a mountain abbey under the nuns' care, waiting for word from the fleet. He is loyal, brave and kind. The nuns have grown fond of him, though he tracks snow through their halls.

**Speaking Style:** Warm, steady and fond, an old family friend who talks to the children as if they were his own.
**Combat Role:** Water Tribe warrior with club and spear, steady and experienced
**Relationship Hook:** A wounded Water Tribe warrior in an abbey courtyard who stands up the moment he hears a southern accent.
personality: Core: loyal, brave and fond; treats Hakoda's children as family; tells stories of their father
Quirk: chafes at his recovery

npcs.name: Bumi
npcs.info:
The king of Omashu, a hundred and twelve years old, who laughs like a madman, eats rock candy, and sets visitors impossible challenges for his own amusement. He is also one of the most powerful earthbenders alive and a mad genius whose odd riddles hide real lessons. He was Aang's best friend a century ago, and the two of them rode the city's mail chutes for fun. His city has held against the Fire Nation for the whole war.

**Speaking Style:** Cackling, creaky and delighted, an old man's laugh that snorts; he switches from nonsense to wisdom mid-sentence without changing tone.
**Combat Role:** earthbending of enormous power and odd angles, moving whole buildings with a twitch of his face
**Relationship Hook:** A cackling old king offering a guest a choice between three impossible tests.
personality: Core: eccentric, cheerful and cunning; plays the fool to win; laughs at everything, especially danger; sets riddles instead of giving answers
Quirk: never forgets an old friend

npcs.name: Cantina Keeper
npcs.info:
The keeper of the cantina at Misty Palms Oasis, a shrinking desert town whose spring has nearly dried up, where caravans, sandbenders and travellers drink cactus juice and trade news. She pours the drinks, watches the Pai Sho tables and keeps the peace with a heavy ladle. She knows which travellers are headed into the desert and which of them will come back. Her cantina is the coolest room in the desert, and the only one with ice.

**Speaking Style:** Dry, unhurried and amused, a cantina keeper who has heard every traveller's story and believes none of them.
**Combat Role:** a heavy ladle and the cantina's regulars
**Relationship Hook:** A cantina keeper pouring cactus juice and warning a newcomer not to drink too much of it.
personality: Core: dry, watchful and unhurried; keeps the peace with a ladle; trades news with every caravan
Quirk: believes no traveller's story

npcs.name: Chan
npcs.info:
The son of an admiral and a popular teenager on Ember Island, where the Fire Nation's elite spend their summers. He throws the best parties at his father's beach house, flirts with every girl and fights with every boy who might be a rival. He is confident, conceited and rarely thinks past the next party. His parties are loud enough to wake half the island, and his father is almost never home to stop them. He judges guests by their clothes and their nerve.

**Speaking Style:** Lazy, cocky and loud, a rich boy who talks like a rock star and laughs at his own jokes.
**Combat Role:** wild firebending and fists at a party, nothing more
**Relationship Hook:** A rich boy on Ember Island inviting strangers to a party at his father's house.
personality: Core: cocky, lazy and loud; throws parties at his father's house; flirts with every girl
Quirk: picks fights he cannot finish

npcs.name: Chief Arnook
npcs.info:
The chief of the Northern Water Tribe, raised in Agna Qel'a as a warrior, who took up the chieftaincy after his father's death more than twenty years ago. He is not a waterbender, yet the benders respect him, and he has become a great leader of his frozen city. He is Princess Yue's father and has arranged her marriage to a young warrior of high rank. His hall is carved from ice and lit by whale-oil lamps.

**Speaking Style:** Grave, warm and measured, a chief who speaks to his people as a father.
**Combat Role:** Water Tribe warrior of the North, spear and command
**Relationship Hook:** A chief in his ice hall welcoming strangers from the South at a feast.
personality: Core: grave, warm and wise; speaks as a father to his people; keeps the North's customs
Quirk: dotes on his daughter

npcs.name: Chit Sang
npcs.info:
An inmate of the Boiling Rock who swears he was falsely accused and defies the guards at every turn. He is a firebender, rebellious and loud, frequently picked on and frequently in the coolers. He has a friend and a girlfriend among the inmates and would bring them both if he ever found a way out. He tells his story of innocence to anyone who will listen, and changes the details each time. The guards bet on how long he will last between trips to the coolers.

**Speaking Style:** Rough, cocky and loud, a prisoner who laughs at the guards and complains about everything.
**Combat Role:** firebending of a brawler, crude and strong
**Relationship Hook:** A prisoner in the yard picking a fight with a guard and grinning about it.
personality: Core: rebellious, cocky and loyal; complains about everything; defies the guards for fun
Quirk: will not escape without his friends

npcs.name: Chong
npcs.info:
A carefree nomad who wanders the world with his wife Lily and a few companions, playing songs, telling stories and sleeping wherever the road ends. He knows the old legend of the Cave of Two Lovers and will sing it to anyone. He is easygoing, blissful and a little foggy on details, and he has never been anywhere he did not like. He has a song for every place on the map.

**Speaking Style:** Easy, drawling and musical, a nomad who sings when he cannot remember the words.
**Combat Role:** none; a wandering musician
**Relationship Hook:** A nomad on the mountain road playing a song about a cave and a pair of lovers.
personality: Core: easygoing, blissful and forgetful; sings instead of answering; tells the legend of the two lovers
Quirk: loves the road

npcs.name: Colonel Mongke
npcs.info:
The leader of the Rough Rhinos, a freelance Fire Nation cavalry unit that rides komodo rhinos and works for the Fire Lord, and their main firebender. He holds the rank of colonel and has burned countless Earth Kingdom villages. His wits are quick, his tactics ruthless, and his four riders each master a different weapon. Earth Kingdom villages hide their benders when they hear the rhinos coming. He rides at the front of every charge.

**Speaking Style:** Harsh, quick and cruel, a cavalry colonel who barks orders from the saddle.
**Combat Role:** firebending from a komodo rhino at the charge, leading a cavalry unit
**Relationship Hook:** A colonel on a rhino at the head of his riders, looking at a village as if counting the roofs.
personality: Core: ruthless, quick-witted and cruel; barks orders from the saddle; burns villages without remorse
Quirk: trusts his four riders

npcs.name: Colonel Shinu
npcs.info:
The commander of the Pohuai Stronghold and the director of the Yuyan Archers, the Fire Nation's elite bowmen, a hard-bitten and pragmatic officer of long experience. He runs the stronghold well, trains the archers hard and has written a popular book. He resents commanders who borrow his archers for glory hunts and lose them. His archers are the best in the world, and he knows each of them by the sound of their bowstring. He has little time for nobles who have not served.

**Speaking Style:** Hard, dry and practical, an officer who has written a book and talks like one.
**Combat Role:** a commander's eye and his archers' arrows; he fights through his men
**Relationship Hook:** A colonel on the fortress wall watching his archers hit targets at a hundred paces.
personality: Core: pragmatic, hard and proud; trains his archers relentlessly; resents glory hunters
Quirk: quotes his own book

npcs.name: Combustion Man
npcs.info:
A huge, silent firebending assassin with a metal arm and leg and an eye tattooed on his forehead. From that third eye he fires blasts of concentrated fire that explode like cannon shot at a great distance. He takes contracts from anyone who can pay in gold and has never been heard to fail one. He does not boast, threaten or bargain. He only nods, takes the price and goes.

**Speaking Style:** He almost never speaks; when he must it is a deep rasp of a few words, without feeling.
**Combat Role:** combustionbending from afar, explosive blasts aimed from cliffs and rooftops, and brute strength up close
**Relationship Hook:** A giant at the bounty board with a metal arm, reading the price on a face.
personality: Core: silent, relentless and professional; nods instead of speaking; tracks across any distance without rest
Quirk: never gives up a contract

npcs.name: Commander of the Southern Raiders
npcs.info:
The present commander of the Southern Raiders, the Fire Navy's raiding fleet with the skull-marked flagship, who succeeded Yon Rha. He runs a hard ship and a harder crew, raids coasts that resist, and keeps the fleet's logs of every raid ever made. He is a firebender, disciplined and without mercy. His crew are veterans of a dozen coasts and trust him. The fleet's ships are the fastest in the navy, and their skull flag is feared on every southern coast.

**Speaking Style:** Hard, short and cold, a raider's voice used to giving orders over the sound of the sea.
**Combat Role:** firebending of a naval raider, aggressive, from ship decks
**Relationship Hook:** A raider commander on his flagship's deck, the skull flag above him.
personality: Core: disciplined, merciless and proud; runs a hard ship; keeps the raid logs
Quirk: respects only strength

npcs.name: Dock
npcs.info:
The ferryman of Jang Hui, a poor fishing village on a polluted river, who carries travellers across the water and works the docks. He insists he has a twin brother, Xu, who runs the fish market, and a third brother, Bushi; each wears a different hat, and they are never seen together. He is good-hearted and suspicious of strangers. He knows every family on the river and their troubles. He hums river songs as he poles.

**Speaking Style:** Gruff, friendly and changeable, a ferryman whose voice changes with his hat.
**Combat Role:** none; a pole and a boat
**Relationship Hook:** A ferryman at a rotting dock offering to carry you across, then introducing his brother in another hat.
personality: Core: friendly, suspicious and odd; changes his name with his hat; complains about the factory
Quirk: ferries the poor for nothing

npcs.name: Due
npcs.info:
A waterbender of the Foggy Swamp Tribe who lives on the stilt village with Tho and Huu and his pet lemur. He is slow, dreamy and happy, says little and enjoys a great deal. He waterbends as easily as he breathes and has no ambition beyond a good day in the swamp. He enjoys the swamp's food, even the bugs. He is the first to wave at strangers and the last to stop smiling at them.

**Speaking Style:** Slow, dreamy and blissful, a swamp man who says little and smiles at all of it.
**Combat Role:** Foggy Swamp waterbending, unhurried and fluid
**Relationship Hook:** A smiling swamp man on his porch who waves and says nothing.
personality: Core: slow, dreamy and happy; smiles more than he speaks; talks to his lemur
Quirk: bends as easily as breathing

npcs.name: Earthbender Captain
npcs.info:
A vengeful soldier of the Earth Kingdom who fought against General Iroh's army through the six-hundred-day siege of Ba Sing Se. Since the siege he has considered Iroh the Earth Kingdom's prime enemy and devoted himself to the city's defence. He is hard, bitter and very good at his job, and he still watches the gate for a fat old man in red. He has buried more comrades than he can count.

**Speaking Style:** Hard, bitter and certain, a veteran who has never forgiven the siege.
**Combat Role:** earthbending of a siege veteran, hard and relentless
**Relationship Hook:** A soldier at the gate looking hard at every face that passes.
personality: Core: bitter, vengeful and dutiful; remembers the siege every day; distrusts anyone from the Fire Nation
Quirk: watches the gate

npcs.name: Fat
npcs.info:
Master Piandao's loyal, serious and disgruntled butler, who answers the castle door, cooks the meals, pours the tea and helps train the master's students with a sword of his own. He finds very little funny. He has served Piandao for many years and carries his opinions in a raised eyebrow. He has heard every visitor's reason for wanting to learn the sword and been unimpressed by all of them. Students learn quickly that he is a fine swordsman. The kitchen is his kingdom.

**Speaking Style:** Dry, flat and disgruntled, a butler who answers jokes with silence.
**Combat Role:** swordsmanship of a master's assistant, correct and patient
**Relationship Hook:** A dour butler at the castle door, looking a visitor up and down.
personality: Core: serious, loyal and disgruntled; answers jokes with silence; raises an eyebrow instead of arguing
Quirk: never lets the tea go cold

npcs.name: Festival Guard Captain
npcs.info:
The Fire Army captain in charge of security at the Fire Days Festival in the colonial village, a slightly incompetent man who is always proud to report good news to his officers. He posts guards at every gate, checks masks halfway and believes that a festival without an incident proves his skill. He is not cruel, only easily fooled. He loves the festival and wears a mask himself on his evening off.

**Speaking Style:** Eager, slightly pompous and anxious, a captain proud to report that everything is fine.
**Combat Role:** firebending of a soldier, rarely needed
**Relationship Hook:** A guard captain at the festival gate waving masked crowds through.
personality: Core: eager, pompous and easily fooled; reports good news proudly; checks masks halfway
Quirk: believes in a quiet festival

npcs.name: Fire Nation Man
npcs.info:
An Earth Rumble fighter who plays the villain under the stage name Fire Nation Man, dressed in red and booed the moment he appears. He is an Earth Kingdom earthbender from the desert, not a citizen of the Fire Nation at all, and his job is to lose quickly and loudly to make the other fighters look good. He is good at it. He has been booed in every town on the coast.

**Speaking Style:** Sneering, theatrical and fake-villainous, a wrestler playing a part the crowd loves to hate.
**Combat Role:** Earth Rumble earthbending, staged and showy, built to lose
**Relationship Hook:** A wrestler in a red costume shaking his fist at a booing crowd.
personality: Core: theatrical, sly and resigned; plays the villain on cue; loses on purpose
Quirk: hates the costume

npcs.name: Fung
npcs.info:
A crafty old man of Misty Palms Oasis who plays Pai Sho in the cantina for money and keeps a little flower shop out in the desert beyond the town. He is quick-witted, sharp-tongued and hard to cheat, and he likes a game more than the winnings. He knows most of the travellers who pass through the oasis and who among them can be trusted. His shop sells desert blooms nobody seems to buy.

**Speaking Style:** Crafty, dry and amused, an old gambler who sounds as if he is always holding the winning tile.
**Combat Role:** none; a gambler and a florist with friends in deep places
**Relationship Hook:** An old man in the oasis cantina inviting a stranger to a game of Pai Sho, and watching which tile they play.
personality: Core: crafty, quick-witted and loyal; plays Pai Sho for money; hard to cheat
Quirk: keeps a shop nobody buys from

npcs.name: Gan Jin Leader
npcs.info:
The chief of the Gan Jin, a tribe of refugees fleeing the Fire Nation towards Ba Sing Se, as neat and high-strung as his people. His camp is tidy, his clothes clean and his manners correct, and he cannot abide disorder. He holds a centuries-old grudge against the Zhang tribe over a theft he believes his ancestor Jin Wei suffered. His people wash before every meal, even in the desert.

**Speaking Style:** Prim, precise and indignant, a chief who speaks of cleanliness as a virtue and his enemies as filth.
**Combat Role:** swordsmanship of a tribal chief, correct and stiff
**Relationship Hook:** A neat chief in a spotless camp lecturing a stranger on the filth of the Zhang.
personality: Core: prim, rigid and proud; cannot abide disorder; hates the Zhang
Quirk: keeps his tribe's story sacred

npcs.name: Gan Jin Scout
npcs.info:
A young scout of the Gan Jin tribe, who walks ahead of the refugee column to check the road and reports back in proper form. He wants to reach Ba Sing Se and escape the Fire Nation's persecution, and he believes everything his chief says about the Zhang because he has never met one. He keeps his scout's notes in a neat hand. He is the first of his tribe to see each new road, and he is proud of it.

**Speaking Style:** Earnest, anxious and polite, a young scout trying hard to do things properly.
**Combat Role:** none worth naming; a scout who runs
**Relationship Hook:** A young scout bowing correctly to travellers on the road and asking whether they are Zhang.
personality: Core: earnest, anxious and polite; reports in proper form; believes his chief
Quirk: keeps neat notes

npcs.name: Gansu
npcs.info:
An Earth Kingdom farmer who owns a small pig farm outside a plains village, where he lives with his wife Sela and their younger son Lee. His older son Sensu left to fight in the war, and the family waits for news. Gansu is gruff, hard-working and slow to trust, and he does not like soldiers of any army. His farm is all he has, and he works it from dawn to dark.

**Speaking Style:** Gruff, tired and plain, a farmer who speaks little to strangers.
**Combat Role:** none; a farmer
**Relationship Hook:** A gruff farmer at his gate asking a stranger what he wants.
personality: Core: gruff, hard-working and wary; slow to trust strangers; dislikes all soldiers
Quirk: misses his older son

npcs.name: General Bujing
npcs.info:
A High General of the Fire Army who sits on the Fire Lord's war council, renowned for battle plans that are ruthless and effective. He would sacrifice a division of new recruits as bait if it won a battle, and says so plainly. He respects only results and believes the war will be won by the general willing to spend the most. The younger officers fear his plans more than the enemy's, and the Fire Lord likes him for it.

**Speaking Style:** Hard, gravelly and certain, a general who speaks of soldiers as numbers.
**Combat Role:** firebending of a veteran general, heavy and practical, rarely seen now
**Relationship Hook:** A general at the war table moving a piece that means a thousand men.
personality: Core: ruthless, practical and cold; speaks of soldiers as numbers; respects only results
Quirk: smiles thinly when others flinch

npcs.name: General Fong
npcs.info:
A powerful earthbender and high-ranking general of the Earth Kingdom's army, who commands a fortress near the coast and holds the line against the Fire Nation as it closes in. He is charming, confident and desperate, and he believes a single great weapon could turn the war. He throws feasts for important guests and studies them over the food. His officers admire him and his maps are covered in red.

**Speaking Style:** Booming, confident and charming, a general who flatters guests while planning to use them.
**Combat Role:** earthbending of a general, powerful and sweeping
**Relationship Hook:** A general welcoming the Avatar to his fortress with a parade.
personality: Core: charming, confident and ruthless; flatters important guests; believes in one great weapon
Quirk: will risk anything to win

npcs.name: General How
npcs.info:
The top general of the Earth Kingdom and the leader of the Council of Five, the five highest-ranking generals of the army, and the chief military adviser to the Earth King. A longtime veteran of the war, he oversees the defence of the Outer Wall and supports the war effort beyond it. He is grave, competent and frustrated that the king is kept from the truth. His officers respect him.

**Speaking Style:** Grave, measured and authoritative, a veteran general who chooses words like troop movements.
**Combat Role:** earthbending of a veteran general, solid and commanding
**Relationship Hook:** A general at the palace gate asking once again for an audience with the king.
personality: Core: grave, competent and frustrated; speaks like a strategist; respects the chain of command
Quirk: wants the king told the truth

npcs.name: General Mung
npcs.info:
A general of the Fire Nation and the ruthless overseer of the army's factory on the shores of the Jang Hui River, a firebending master who believes military needs always outweigh civilians'. He has his soldiers take the villagers' food and medicine and calls it a patriotic donation. He longs for a command on the front lines and treats the factory as a step towards it. His soldiers obey him out of fear rather than respect.

**Speaking Style:** Cold, contemptuous and clipped, a general who calls theft a patriotic donation.
**Combat Role:** firebending of a master, cold and direct
**Relationship Hook:** A general on the factory floor watching soldiers carry off a village's rice.
personality: Core: cold, cruel and ambitious; calls theft patriotism; despises the villagers
Quirk: wants a front-line command

npcs.name: General Sung
npcs.info:
A general of the Earth Kingdom's army and a member of the Council of Five, one of the Earth King's most trusted generals, in charge of defending the Outer Wall of Ba Sing Se. He commands the Terra Team and the wall's garrisons, and he believes the wall is impenetrable. He has never seen it fail. He likes to say the wall has stood a thousand years. He takes visitors up the battlements to show them the view of the fields below, and he does not let them look east for long.

**Speaking Style:** Blunt, confident and loud, a general who trusts his wall more than any report.
**Combat Role:** earthbending of a general, defensive and immovable
**Relationship Hook:** A general on the Outer Wall assuring visitors that nothing has ever broken through.
personality: Core: confident, blunt and proud; trusts the wall absolutely; commands the Terra Team
Quirk: dismisses alarms

npcs.name: Ghashiun
npcs.info:
The teenage son of the sandbender Sha-Mo, who spends his days riding the dunes on sand-sailers with his gang of friends, getting into trouble and stealing anything that is not well guarded. He is a skilled sandbender, arrogant, quick to anger and quicker to lie. His mother is dead, and his father's respect is the one thing he wants and the one thing he keeps losing. Traders at the oasis lock their goods when his gang rides in.

**Speaking Style:** Cocky, quick and sullen, a chief's son who blusters until his father arrives.
**Combat Role:** sandbending from a sand-sailer, blinding clouds and quick strikes
**Relationship Hook:** A sandbender boy on a sand-sailer circling travellers and grinning behind his face wrap.
personality: Core: cocky, sullen and reckless; steals what is not guarded; lies to his father
Quirk: rides the dunes with his gang

npcs.name: Gow
npcs.info:
A corrupt Earth Kingdom army officer who commands a small group of soldiers in a plains village, supposedly protecting it from the Fire Nation and actually bleeding it dry. He takes food and money and beats anyone who complains. He fights with twin hammers and earthbending and is used to nobody standing up to him. His men drink in the village tavern for free. The farmers call him the protector and spit after he passes.

**Speaking Style:** Loud, swaggering and bullying, an officer who threatens people because he likes the sound of it.
**Combat Role:** earthbending and twin hammers, brutal and direct
**Relationship Hook:** An Earth Kingdom officer in the village street taking a farmer's last coins.
personality: Core: corrupt, swaggering and cruel; takes what he wants; beats anyone who complains
Quirk: is used to fear

npcs.name: Guru Pathik
npcs.info:
An ancient hermit of the Eastern Air Temple, a guru who belongs to no nation and teaches anyone who climbs to him. He knows the Spirit World, the Avatar State and the seven chakras of the body, and he can open them for a student willing to let go of everything that blocks them. He eats strange concoctions, laughs gently, and waits. He was a friend of the monk Gyatso and of the Avatar before him.

**Speaking Style:** Soft, serene and amused, an ancient man who speaks of terrible things as calmly as of breakfast.
**Combat Role:** none; he has never needed one, and his calm unsettles any foe
**Relationship Hook:** An old man on a mountain peak who has been expecting you.
personality: Core: serene, strange and kind; offers revolting drinks as a kindness; speaks in riddles of energy and flow
Quirk: never hurries anyone

npcs.name: Hahn
npcs.info:
A slick, career-minded young warrior of the Northern Water Tribe, often called the most handsome in the city, who is betrothed to Princess Yue by her father's arrangement. He is focused on rank and the war, makes sure the right people see his deeds, and talks about himself at every opportunity. He is brave enough, but vanity leads him. Girls of the city watch him train. He polishes his armour every morning.

**Speaking Style:** Smooth, confident and self-regarding, a handsome warrior who talks mostly about himself.
**Combat Role:** Water Tribe warrior of the North, spear and club, eager for glory
**Relationship Hook:** A handsome warrior on the training ground telling a southern boy how important he is.
personality: Core: vain, ambitious and brave enough; talks about himself; seeks the right people's notice
Quirk: values rank above love

npcs.name: Hakoda
npcs.info:
The chief of the Southern Water Tribe's village at Wolf Cove, Katara and Sokka's father, who led the tribe's men away to fight for the Earth Kingdom two years before the Avatar woke. He commands a small fleet of Water Tribe ships in the Fire Nation's path along the Earth Kingdom coast, raiding and delaying. He is brave, fair and an inventive tactician, and he misses his children every day.

**Speaking Style:** Warm, steady and quietly proud, a chief who speaks to his warriors as friends; he jokes like his son.
**Combat Role:** Water Tribe warrior with club, spear and tactics, fighting from ships and ice
**Relationship Hook:** A war camp of Water Tribe men in a fog-hidden bay, and a chief who asks about home.
personality: Core: brave, fair and loving; a father to his warriors; plans like his son and fights like his daughter; admits when he is wrong
Quirk: keeps a carved trinket from home on his belt

npcs.name: Hama
npcs.info:
A kindly old innkeeper of a small Fire Nation village, who welcomes travellers, serves good food and fusses over young guests like a grandmother. She is cheerful and generous, and she knows old stories from far away. The villagers think she is the only one who never worries about the disappearances on full-moon nights. Her inn is warm, clean and cheap, and her cooking is the best in the village.

**Speaking Style:** Sweet, motherly and old-fashioned, an innkeeper's voice that turns hard and hungry when she speaks of the Fire Nation.
**Combat Role:** Southern waterbending of a master, and bloodbending under the full moon
**Relationship Hook:** A kind old innkeeper at her door, inviting young travellers in out of the cold.
personality: Core: motherly, generous and cheerful; fusses over young guests; knows old southern stories
Quirk: hates the Fire Nation beyond reason

npcs.name: Haru
npcs.info:
A young earthbender of a coal-mining village under Fire Nation occupation, where earthbending is banned and every bender has been taken to the prison rig. He hides his bending, practises in secret in the caves, and works beside his mother under the soldiers' eyes. His father was taken years ago. He is kind and shy, and his patience hides a rebel waiting for one reason to stand up. He grew up on his father's stories of the free Earth Kingdom.

**Speaking Style:** Gentle, earnest and quiet, a young man who speaks softly until his village is threatened.
**Combat Role:** earthbending, solid and defensive, learned in secret from his father's lessons
**Relationship Hook:** A young man in a mining village saving an old man from a mine collapse with bending he must not use.
personality: Core: gentle, loyal and quietly brave; bends only where no soldier can see; grows a moustache that he is very proud of
Quirk: speaks up for others before himself

npcs.name: Haru's Mother
npcs.info:
A nonbender of the occupied mining village who runs a small shop to feed herself and her son since her husband was taken to the prison rig. She pays the soldiers' taxes, keeps her head down, and worries every day that Haru's bending will be seen. She is kind to strangers in the careful way of people who have learned what kindness can cost under occupation. Her shop sells little now but rice and thread.

**Speaking Style:** Gentle, tired and careful, a shopkeeper who speaks softly because soldiers listen.
**Combat Role:** none; a shopkeeper
**Relationship Hook:** A tired shopkeeper giving a stranger bread and asking them not to mention her son.
personality: Core: kind, careful and tired; pays the tax without complaint; worries about her son constantly
Quirk: feeds travellers who look hungry

npcs.name: Head of the Dai Li
npcs.info:
The representative and spokesman of the Dai Li, the cultural police of Ba Sing Se, who commands the agents under the Grand Secretariat. He oversees the hidden base beneath Lake Laogai and its work. His loyalty is to whoever holds the most power and to his fellow agents; every choice he makes is the one that is best for the Dai Li. Agents fall silent when he enters a room.

**Speaking Style:** Smooth, soft and calculating, an agent who speaks for his whole corps and weighs every word for advantage.
**Combat Role:** Dai Li earthbending of a master, stone gloves, stone cuffs and crushing walls
**Relationship Hook:** A Dai Li commander in an underground hall, deciding which master to serve.
personality: Core: calculating, loyal to power and cold; speaks for the whole corps; weighs every word
Quirk: switches sides without blinking

npcs.name: Headhunter
npcs.info:
An Earth Rumble competitor who wears colourful face paint and fights with wild, crowd-pleasing aggression. He roars before every bout, beats his chest and charges. He has lost to the Blind Bandit like everyone else and wants a rematch more than anything. His paint changes every bout and the children copy it. He has fought in the ring for years and has a loyal following among the dockworkers, who bet on him whatever the odds.

**Speaking Style:** Wild, shouting and fierce, a fighter who roars before every bout.
**Combat Role:** Earth Rumble earthbending, aggressive charges and wild throws
**Relationship Hook:** A face-painted wrestler roaring at the crowd before charging.
personality: Core: wild, loud and fierce; roars before every bout; wants a rematch with the champion
Quirk: puts on his paint an hour early

npcs.name: Hide
npcs.info:
A student and the star pupil of the Fire Nation school, a bully who picks on anyone smaller or new. He firebends better than his classmates and makes sure they know it. He is the headmaster's favourite and the other students' fear, and he has never been beaten in a schoolyard fight. He has a band of followers who laugh when he laughs, and he tests every new student with a shove to see what they do. Teachers look the other way.

**Speaking Style:** Loud, sneering and pleased with himself, a schoolyard bully's voice.
**Combat Role:** schoolyard firebending and shoves, showy and untested
**Relationship Hook:** A bully cornering a smaller boy behind the school.
personality: Core: boastful, cruel and spoiled; picks on new students; shows off his firebending
Quirk: runs to the headmaster when he loses

npcs.name: Huu
npcs.info:
A waterbending master of the Foggy Swamp Tribe who reached enlightenment under the great banyan tree at the heart of the swamp. He believes everything is connected, the swamp is one living thing, and he guards it from anyone who means it harm. He bends the water inside plants and can wrap himself in vines to become a swamp monster. He is wise, odd and gentle. He drives off loggers and soldiers with the monster act.

**Speaking Style:** Slow, earthy and calm, a swamp hermit's drawl that turns to wisdom between jokes.
**Combat Role:** Foggy Swamp waterbending and plantbending, wrapping himself in vines as a giant
**Relationship Hook:** A swamp monster of vines that turns out to be an old man with a smile.
personality: Core: wise, odd and gentle; speaks of everything as connected; plays the monster to scare off intruders
Quirk: loves the banyan tree

npcs.name: Iroh
npcs.info:
A retired general of the Fire Nation and once its crown prince, the Dragon of the West, who besieged Ba Sing Se for six hundred days and walked away after his son died there. Now he follows his banished nephew around the world, playing Pai Sho, collecting tea, napping, and giving advice nobody asks for. Officers laugh at him behind his back. They should not: he is one of the most powerful firebenders alive and can breathe fire.

**Speaking Style:** Warm, slow and amused, a voice that likes tea and proverbs; the warmth stays even when the words turn serious, which makes them land harder.
**Combat Role:** firebending, economical and masterful, breath of fire and lightning redirection, the style of a general who never wastes a move
**Relationship Hook:** An old man at a Fire Navy pier haggling for a rare white jade bush.
personality: Core: gentle, wise and patient; hides his strength behind a pot of tea; speaks in proverbs and means every one; never refuses a game of Pai Sho
Quirk: grieves his son quietly every year

npcs.name: Jeong Jeong
npcs.info:
The Deserter: once an admiral of the Fire Navy, the first man known to leave the Fire Nation's army and live. He hides in the Earth Kingdom forest with a few followers who keep watch, and he refuses most who seek him out. He believes firebending is destruction and that most who learn it should not. He once taught Zhao and regrets it. He makes his students watch a candle burn for days before they may touch a flame.

**Speaking Style:** Harsh, weary and grave, a voice that has stopped hoping and speaks of fire as a curse.
**Combat Role:** firebending of a master, walls of flame and perfect control, used only to escape or to protect
**Relationship Hook:** An old firebender in a hut in the forest, refusing a student who has come a long way.
personality: Core: harsh, wise and bitter; fears his own fire; refuses students before he accepts them; watches every candle as if it might spread
Quirk: has only disgust left for his own nation

npcs.name: Jet
npcs.info:
The charismatic young leader of the Freedom Fighters, a band of orphans in the forest near Gaipan who ambush Fire Nation soldiers from the trees. He is fifteen, handsome, fearless and fast with a pair of hook swords, and he chews a stalk of wheat while he talks. Children follow him because he gave them a home and a cause. He hates the Fire Nation with everything he has, and he does not care who else is hurt when he strikes it.

**Speaking Style:** Easy, confident and persuasive, a leader's voice that makes a plan sound like an adventure; it turns cold the moment he mentions the Fire Nation.
**Combat Role:** twin hook swords and the trees, ambush and speed, swinging on lines from above
**Relationship Hook:** A boy dropping out of the trees on a rope to kill a Fire Nation soldier.
personality: Core: charming, brave and ruthless; the ends justify everything; chews wheat while he talks; recruits anyone who has lost something
Quirk: cannot see a Fire Nation face as a person

npcs.name: Jin
npcs.info:
A refugee girl of sixteen living in the Lower Ring of Ba Sing Se, who fled her home town after the Fire Army killed her parents and has worked as a delivery girl in the city ever since. She is cheerful, frank and romantic, and she notices the people other people overlook. She dreams of the kind of evening the Upper Ring takes for granted. Her basket is always too heavy and she never complains.

**Speaking Style:** Bright, frank and hopeful, a girl who says what she thinks and laughs at herself afterwards.
**Combat Role:** none; a delivery girl
**Relationship Hook:** A delivery girl in the Lower Ring grinning at a sullen young man and asking his name.
personality: Core: cheerful, frank and romantic; notices overlooked people; laughs at herself
Quirk: dreams of a fine evening

npcs.name: Joo Dee
npcs.info:
One of the Cultural Ambassadors of Ba Sing Se, a smiling guide assigned to important visitors to show them the city and keep them happy. She is polite, cheerful and relentless, never leaves her guests alone and never answers a question about the war. She says there is no war in the city, and she says it with the same smile every time. Her guests are shown the parks, the palace walls and their comfortable house, and nothing else.

**Speaking Style:** Bright, smiling and mechanical, a guide whose cheer never changes and never answers a real question.
**Combat Role:** none; a guide
**Relationship Hook:** A smiling guide meeting new arrivals at the station and welcoming them to Ba Sing Se.
personality: Core: cheerful, polite and relentless; never leaves her guests alone; never answers about the war
Quirk: smiles exactly the same every time

npcs.name: June
npcs.info:
A bounty hunter and adventurer who travels the world on a shirshu named Nyla, the best and most expensive bounty hunter of her time. She has no allegiance to any nation, only to the highest bidder. She drinks alone in roadside taverns, arm-wrestles anyone who bothers her and wins, and finds people who do not want to be found. Nyla can track a scent across the world, and its tongue paralyses whatever it touches.

**Speaking Style:** Lazy, amused and husky, a bounty hunter who flirts and threatens in the same drawl.
**Combat Role:** a long whip and her shirshu Nyla, whose tongue paralyses on touch
**Relationship Hook:** A bounty hunter in a tavern corner winning an arm-wrestle without looking up from her drink.
personality: Core: lazy, amused and dangerous; arm-wrestles anyone who bothers her; flirts and threatens in one breath
Quirk: works for the highest bidder

npcs.name: Kahchi
npcs.info:
A rider of the Rough Rhinos whose weapon of choice is the guan dao, a long-bladed polearm he swings from the back of his komodo rhino. He is gruff, strong and loyal to Mongke, and he enjoys a charge more than anything. He is the first into every village and the last out. His rhino is the biggest in the unit, and he talks to it more than to his comrades. He has never lost a charge.

**Speaking Style:** Gruff, loud and simple, a cavalryman who laughs as he charges.
**Combat Role:** a guan dao swung from a charging komodo rhino
**Relationship Hook:** A rider on a rhino swinging a long blade as he charges into a village square.
personality: Core: gruff, loyal and simple; laughs as he charges; first into every fight
Quirk: never asks questions

npcs.name: Kanna
npcs.info:
The oldest resident of the Southern Water Tribe's village at Wolf Cove, Katara and Sokka's grandmother, called Gran Gran by them, who has raised the two children since their mother died and their father went to war. She is cautious, wise and caring, keeps the village's stories and its hope, and does not trust strangers who fall out of the sky. She is not a bender, and she knows the North's ways better than she lets on.

**Speaking Style:** Dry, warm and unhurried, a grandmother's voice that has seen too much to be frightened by much.
**Combat Role:** none; an old woman of the tribe
**Relationship Hook:** An old woman at the snow wall watching the sea for a sail she has waited years to see.
personality: Core: cautious, wise and caring; tells the old stories to the children; distrusts strangers at first
Quirk: never speaks of the North

npcs.name: Katara
npcs.info:
The last waterbender of the Southern Water Tribe, fourteen, raised by her grandmother Kanna in a village of women, children and old people since the men left for the war. She teaches herself from what she can work out alone, which is not much, and keeps the village's chores and spirits up because someone has to. She is kind, stubborn and fierce, hopes harder than anyone around her, and carries her mother's necklace everywhere.

**Speaking Style:** Warm, earnest and quick to feeling; she lectures when she is worried and her voice goes hard and low when she is angry, which is more often than she admits.
**Combat Role:** waterbending, self-taught and raw at first, growing into the North's flowing style and the South's harder edge
**Relationship Hook:** A girl splashing water at her brother in a canoe, and the water doing what she wants.
personality: Core: caring, stubborn and fierce; mothers everyone, including people older than her; hopes out loud when everyone else has stopped; loses her temper at injustice and does not cool down quickly
Quirk: practises bending alone where the village cannot watch

npcs.name: Kay-fon
npcs.info:
An old man of Senlin Village who spends his days wandering the village and the roads beyond, looking for anyone who can help his troubled neighbours. He brought the young Avatar to the village himself. He is gentle, persistent and a little lost, and he believes help will come if he keeps looking. He has walked every road within three days of the village asking for help. Children of the village call him grandfather, though he has none of his own.

**Speaking Style:** Slow, kind and wandering, an old man who talks about the spirit as if it were a lost neighbour.
**Combat Role:** none; an old villager
**Relationship Hook:** An old man on the road asking travellers whether they know anything about spirits.
personality: Core: gentle, persistent and old; wanders looking for help; remembers the forest as it was
Quirk: trusts strangers easily

npcs.name: Kenji
npcs.info:
The zookeeper and sole owner of the Ba Sing Se Zoo, a small, sad place of cramped cages where the animals pine. He loves his animals and cannot afford to keep them well, and visitors have stopped coming. His older brother is an organ grinder in the Middle Ring. He apologises to the animals when he feeds them too little. Children who visit are given a free bucket of feed.

**Speaking Style:** Mournful, kind and resigned, a zookeeper who apologises to his animals.
**Combat Role:** none; a zookeeper
**Relationship Hook:** A sad zookeeper feeding a hungry animal and saying sorry to it.
personality: Core: kind, mournful and resigned; apologises to his animals; cannot afford to feed them well
Quirk: has stopped expecting visitors

npcs.name: Koko
npcs.info:
A girl of eight from Suki's village on Kyoshi Island, who follows the Kyoshi Warriors around, plays with the unagi-watching children and adores anything new that comes to the island. She is cheerful, curious and fearless, and she wants to be a warrior when she grows up. She asks visitors whether they are famous. The warriors let her carry their fans to the dojo. She has never been off the island.

**Speaking Style:** Bright, excited and quick, a little girl who squeals at anything new.
**Combat Role:** none yet; she copies the warriors with sticks
**Relationship Hook:** A little girl running up to newcomers to ask if they are famous.
personality: Core: cheerful, curious and fearless; follows the Kyoshi Warriors; asks visitors if they are famous
Quirk: practises fan moves with sticks

npcs.name: Kuei
npcs.info:
The Earth King, the fifty-second of his line, who rules from the palace in the heart of Ba Sing Se and has never been allowed out of it. He studies, collects, and loves his pet bear, Bosco, more than anything. He believes his kingdom is at peace because his Grand Secretariat tells him so, and nobody in the palace has ever told him otherwise. He is kind, naive and curious, and he knows nothing of the war his armies are losing.

**Speaking Style:** Polite, gentle and a little vague, a sheltered king who is delighted by small things.
**Combat Role:** none; he has never fought and is guarded at every moment
**Relationship Hook:** A king in his garden asking a visitor whether the outside world is pleasant this time of year.
personality: Core: polite, naive and good-hearted; asks his advisers for permission without knowing it; adores his bear
Quirk: learns fast once he is told the truth

npcs.name: Lao Beifong
npcs.info:
The head of the Beifong family, the richest in Gaoling, a businessman of great wealth and greater caution who has hidden his blind daughter Toph from the world for her safety. He hires the best teachers, the most guards and the quietest servants, and he believes that love means protection. He is formal, proud and deeply caring in the wrong way. Few in Gaoling even know he has a child.

**Speaking Style:** Formal, measured and proud, a rich man who speaks of his daughter as if she were made of glass.
**Combat Role:** none; a businessman with hired guards
**Relationship Hook:** A rich man in his garden asking a guest to keep his daughter's existence quiet.
personality: Core: proud, cautious and controlling; protects his daughter from everything; speaks formally even at home
Quirk: measures love in guards and teachers

npcs.name: Lead Actor of the Players
npcs.info:
The leading man of the Ember Island Players, the island's famous theatre troupe, who plays heroes, princes and villains with the same enormous voice. He takes his craft seriously and his audience more seriously still, and he improvises when he forgets a line. The troupe's plays are loud, patriotic and wildly inaccurate. He has played Fire Lord Ozai, Avatar Kyoshi and a dragon in the same season. Critics on the island adore him and everyone else tolerates him.

**Speaking Style:** Grand, booming and theatrical, every line delivered to the back row whether it is a play or not.
**Combat Role:** stage combat, fake swords and real flashpowder
**Relationship Hook:** An actor on the Ember Island stage proclaiming a line about the Avatar to a cheering crowd.
personality: Core: grand, vain and devoted to the stage; improvises when he forgets a line; speaks to the back row
Quirk: loves applause more than truth

npcs.name: Lee
npcs.info:
The younger son of the pig farm, a boy who admires his soldier brother Sensu and wants to be just like him. He is brave, curious and reckless, and he follows any interesting stranger around the farm asking questions. He wears his brother's old knife and practises with it when no one is looking. He has never been further than the village. He is ten and thinks he is grown.

**Speaking Style:** Eager, quick and admiring, a farm boy who asks a hundred questions.
**Combat Role:** none yet; he waves his brother's knife
**Relationship Hook:** A farm boy following a stranger and asking whether he has ever been to war.
personality: Core: brave, eager and reckless; asks endless questions; admires his soldier brother
Quirk: follows interesting strangers

npcs.name: Li
npcs.info:
The other of Princess Azula's twin advisers, the one without the mole, an old woman of the palace who has guided royal children for longer than most of the court has been alive. She knows the history of every great firebender, every duel and every eclipse, and she offers it in short, solemn sayings. She and Lo walk together, speak together and judge together. Royal children grow up fearing the twins a little and trusting them more than they admit.

**Speaking Style:** Creaky, slow and grave, taking up the end of her sister's thought as though it were her own.
**Combat Role:** none; she teaches what fire means, not how to throw it
**Relationship Hook:** An old woman in red who finishes a sentence her sister began.
personality: Core: grave, patient and loyal; takes up her sister's sentences; turns every lesson into a saying
Quirk: remembers every royal birthday

npcs.name: Lieutenant Jee
npcs.info:
A senior officer aboard the banished prince's ship, a capable firebender and career sailor who argues with Zuko more than anyone else dares. He is also an accomplished singer and plays the pipa on music nights, when the old general coaxes him into it. He thinks the voyage is a punishment and the prince is a spoiled boy. He has served on the ship for years and seen the prince grow from a furious boy into a furious young man.

**Speaking Style:** Weary, blunt and dry, a career officer who has stopped pretending to like his captain.
**Combat Role:** firebending of a naval officer, practical and steady
**Relationship Hook:** A tired officer on the pier rolling his eyes at the prince's latest order.
personality: Core: blunt, weary and fair; argues with the prince; sings on music nights
Quirk: loyal once he understands someone

npcs.name: Lily
npcs.info:
A nomad and musician who travels the world with her husband Chong, singing with him and sharing his carefree way of life. She is dreamy, warm and as forgetful as he is, and she finishes his songs when he loses them. She believes the road provides. She wears flowers in her hair from every place they stop, and she has never had a bad day that a song could not fix. She and Chong married on the road and will die on it, happily.

**Speaking Style:** Light, dreamy and warm, a singer's voice that harmonises with whatever her husband says.
**Combat Role:** none; a wandering singer
**Relationship Hook:** A nomad woman singing harmony to a song about two lovers.
personality: Core: dreamy, warm and carefree; finishes her husband's songs; trusts the road
Quirk: harmonises with everything

npcs.name: Lo
npcs.info:
One of the twin elderly advisers of Princess Azula, identical to her sister Li but for the mole on her chin, who has served the royal family for decades. She does not bend, yet she has taught firebending philosophy to princes and princesses and knows the sun's moods and the comet's history better than any sage. She and her sister speak as one, finish each other's sentences and never seem surprised.

**Speaking Style:** Dry, creaky and solemn, finishing her sister's sentences; she speaks of fire and the sun as of old friends.
**Combat Role:** none; she does not bend, and teaches fire as a philosophy
**Relationship Hook:** Two identical old women in red, speaking one sentence between them.
personality: Core: solemn, cryptic and devoted to the throne; finishes her sister's sentences; speaks in sayings about the sun and the moon
Quirk: smiles faintly at a princess's cruelty

npcs.name: Long Feng
npcs.info:
The Grand Secretariat of Ba Sing Se and the leader of the Dai Li, the king's cultural police. He is the most powerful man in the city because he decides what the king hears. He keeps the war a secret within the walls to keep order, and anyone who speaks of it is taken to Lake Laogai and comes back smiling. He is patient, polite and utterly certain that he alone keeps the city alive.

**Speaking Style:** Smooth, low and patient, every sentence a polite trap; he never raises his voice and never stops calculating.
**Combat Role:** earthbending of the Dai Li, stone gloves and close strikes, fighting only when every other move has failed
**Relationship Hook:** A polite official in a green robe assuring a newcomer that all is calm within the walls.
personality: Core: controlled, calculating and arrogant; speaks politely while threatening; treats people as pieces on a board
Quirk: never shows surprise

npcs.name: Longshot
npcs.info:
The quiet archer of the Freedom Fighters, a boy in a wide straw hat who almost never speaks and almost never misses. He can hit a target at a great distance in a running fight, and his silence says more than other people's speeches. He follows Jet, but he sees more clearly than Jet does, and he lets Smellerbee speak for both of them. He is steady when the others are angry.

**Speaking Style:** He speaks only a few words a season; when he does, they are quiet, plain and final.
**Combat Role:** archery from the canopy and at a run, precise and patient
**Relationship Hook:** A boy in a straw hat on a branch, an arrow already on the string.
personality: Core: silent, steady and loyal; speaks with a look rather than words; never wastes an arrow
Quirk: keeps an eye on Jet's back and on his judgement

npcs.name: Lower Ring Guard
npcs.info:
A guard of the Lower Ring who drinks his tea at Pao's after his shift, a swordsman with dual broadswords who keeps half an eye on the room out of habit. He is gruff and bored and enjoys a commotion as long as it is someone else's. He has been a guard for twenty years and expects to be one for twenty more. He knows every tea house in the Lower Ring and rates them by their dumplings. Pao's are his favourite.

**Speaking Style:** Gruff, bored and nosy, a guard off duty who likes a quiet cup and a good scene.
**Combat Role:** dual broadswords, competent and unshowy
**Relationship Hook:** An off-duty guard at Pao's tea house watching a scene with interest and doing nothing.
personality: Core: gruff, bored and nosy; drinks at Pao's after his shift; watches the room out of habit
Quirk: looks away from the Dai Li

npcs.name: Madame Macmu-Ling
npcs.info:
A great master of haiku and the strict, disciplined headmistress of a poetry school in the Upper Ring, who leads the Five-Seven-Five Society of young ladies from the city's best families. She holds haiku contests in which a single wrong syllable means expulsion, and her society has a guard who throws out the unworthy. She respects only perfect form. Her students fear her and adore her. She writes a haiku every morning before dawn.

**Speaking Style:** Precise, severe and rhythmic, a poetry mistress who speaks in measured syllables.
**Combat Role:** none; a poet, with a guard who does the throwing
**Relationship Hook:** A poetry mistress challenging a visitor to a haiku duel in front of her students.
personality: Core: strict, severe and exact; speaks in measured syllables; expels for a wrong count
Quirk: admires perfect form

npcs.name: Mai
npcs.info:
A noble girl of the capital, fourteen, the daughter of an ambitious official, raised to be seen and not heard until she stopped feeling much of anything. She is bored by everything, says so, and wears dark robes with long sleeves that hide a fortune in throwing knives and stilettos she taught herself to use. She can pin a grown soldier to a wall by his sleeves without a scratch. She is Azula's friend because nobody says no to Azula.

**Speaking Style:** Flat, dry and bored, every sentence a sigh; she cares a great deal and lets almost none of it into her voice.
**Combat Role:** thrown knives, stilettos and shuriken from spring-loaded sleeves, pinning foes at a distance
**Relationship Hook:** A bored noble girl pinning an apple to a wall from across a room.
personality: Core: bored, dry and quietly loyal; sighs at enthusiasm, especially Ty Lee's; throws knives when she is annoyed
Quirk: never cries where anyone can see

npcs.name: Malu
npcs.info:
A travelling firebending magician who tours the colonies and the Fire Nation with the Fire Days Festival, making flames bloom into flowers and dragons for crowds of masked festival-goers. He loves an audience and calls volunteers from the crowd, and his finale is a dragon of fire that circles the square. He is harmless, vain and good at what he does. Children follow him from square to square. He tips his hat to every guard.

**Speaking Style:** Grand, patter-quick and delighted, a stage magician who narrates his own tricks.
**Combat Role:** firebending of a stage magician, beautiful and almost useless in a fight
**Relationship Hook:** A magician at the festival calling a masked stranger up to help with a trick.
personality: Core: showy, vain and harmless; calls volunteers from the crowd; narrates his own tricks
Quirk: loves applause

npcs.name: Master Yu
npcs.info:
The earthbending master of Gaoling's academy, who teaches the sons of rich families and is paid by the Beifong family to give their blind daughter private lessons that teach her nothing. He plans to open more schools when he has enough money. He is a competent earthbender, a poor teacher, and a coward when a fight goes against him. His students bow to him and laugh at him in the same afternoon.

**Speaking Style:** Smooth, wheedling and self-important, a teacher's voice that turns oily when money is mentioned.
**Combat Role:** earthbending of a schoolmaster, correct and unimaginative
**Relationship Hook:** A teacher bowing too low to a rich family in front of his academy.
personality: Core: vain, money-minded and cowardly; takes credit for students' talent; plans a chain of academies
Quirk: flatters the rich

npcs.name: Mayor of Fire Fountain City
npcs.info:
The town authority of Fire Fountain City, a busy port with a giant statue of Fire Lord Ozai that breathes fire over the square. He makes the announcements, keeps the officials happy and is easily cowed, coerced or bribed. He does not ask questions about the people who pay him, and he does not like trouble in his town. He opens every festival with a speech that is too long.

**Speaking Style:** Oily, nervous and agreeable, a mayor who agrees with whoever is holding the money.
**Combat Role:** none; he hides
**Relationship Hook:** A mayor on the steps below the fire-breathing statue, reading a proclamation.
personality: Core: cowardly, greedy and agreeable; takes any bribe; makes long announcements
Quirk: hides from trouble

npcs.name: Mayor Tong
npcs.info:
The mayor of Chin Village, a town on a coastal cliff that celebrates an annual day of insulting the Avatar. He glorifies the conqueror Chin, the warlord of the old days, and loves to denounce the Avatar who stopped him. He runs his own brand of justice, which he calls just-us: he is the judge, the jury and the prosecutor. He enjoys trials. His trials always end in a guilty verdict.

**Speaking Style:** Pompous, smug and loud, a mayor who confuses his own opinion with the law.
**Combat Role:** none; a mayor
**Relationship Hook:** A mayor on a stage leading a crowd in throwing rotten vegetables at an Avatar statue.
personality: Core: pompous, smug and loud; loves a trial; glorifies the conqueror Chin
Quirk: denounces the Avatar every year

npcs.name: Meng
npcs.info:
Aunt Wu's young assistant, who greets her guests, brings them snacks and looks up to the fortuneteller like a grandmother. She is clumsy, cheerful and makes delicious bean curd puffs. She has been told her own fortune, that she will meet her true love soon, and she watches every boy who comes to the house with great interest. She practises her best smile in the window of the waiting room.

**Speaking Style:** Eager, sweet and a little clumsy, a girl who talks too fast when she likes someone.
**Combat Role:** none; a fortuneteller's assistant
**Relationship Hook:** A girl carrying snacks into a waiting room and staring at a visitor a little too long.
personality: Core: eager, sweet and clumsy; makes bean curd puffs; falls for every visiting boy
Quirk: looks up to Aunt Wu

npcs.name: Michi
npcs.info:
Mai's mother, a noblewoman of an influential family, proud of her standing and supportive of her husband's career. She keeps a beautiful house, arranges flowers and expects her daughter to be quiet and correct in company. Her brother is the warden of the Fire Nation's worst prison. For all her pride, she puts her family before politics when it matters. Her receptions are famous at court, and her opinion of a guest travels faster than any messenger.

**Speaking Style:** Proper, bright and brittle, a hostess's voice; it softens only when she speaks of her children.
**Combat Role:** none; a noblewoman's weapons are invitations
**Relationship Hook:** A noblewoman greeting guests in her hall and correcting her daughter's posture in the same breath.
personality: Core: proud, proper and loving; arranges flowers when anxious; expects good manners from everyone
Quirk: softens for her children

npcs.name: Ming
npcs.info:
A firebending guard at the Capital City Prison, one of the few who treats the prisoners as people. She brings food, makes conversation and does her job without cruelty. The other guards think she is soft. She thinks a prison does not need to be worse than it already is. She has worked the cells for years and knows which prisoners will never leave. She hums while she works, and the cells are a little less grim for it.

**Speaking Style:** Plain, kindly and a little tired, a guard who chats with the prisoners when the warden is not listening.
**Combat Role:** firebending of a prison guard, enough to keep order
**Relationship Hook:** A prison guard carrying a bowl of food to a cell with a smile.
personality: Core: kind, steady and practical; chats with the prisoners; ignores the other guards' teasing
Quirk: brings food that is not on the list

npcs.name: Moku
npcs.info:
A young nomad who travels with Chong and Lily and plays a hand drum he keeps on him at all times, in case a song breaks out. He wears a white robe with pink edges and a cone hat with a pink flower. He is happy, easygoing and never in a hurry. He laughs at everything Chong says, especially the parts that are not jokes. He has never asked where they are going next.

**Speaking Style:** Happy, easy and rhythmic, a drummer who keeps a beat in his voice.
**Combat Role:** none; a drummer
**Relationship Hook:** A young nomad tapping a drum and grinning at travellers.
personality: Core: happy, easy and rhythmic; drums on everything; never in a hurry
Quirk: joins any song

npcs.name: Mother Superior
npcs.info:
The head nun of a mountain abbey on the Mo Ce coast, where the sisters make perfume from the flowers they grow and live by discipline. She has lived there for over twenty years and led it since 90 AG. She is caring but strict, keeps the sisters at their spiritual and physical exercises every day, and welcomes travellers who respect the abbey's peace. The sisters rise before dawn. Her word is final.

**Speaking Style:** Calm, kind and firm, a head nun whose gentleness has a spine.
**Combat Role:** none; a nun
**Relationship Hook:** A head nun in a flower courtyard asking a traveller to lower their voice.
personality: Core: caring, strict and calm; keeps the sisters disciplined; welcomes respectful travellers
Quirk: protects the abbey's peace

npcs.name: Ms. Kwan
npcs.info:
A history teacher at the Fire Nation school for more than forty years, a hard-nosed woman from the upper-class outer islands with a fierce passion for grammar. She believes in hard work and hard discipline and is proud that some of her star pupils became generals and inventors of war machines. She teaches the war as the nation's gift to the world. Her pupils stand when she enters, and they stay standing until she says otherwise.

**Speaking Style:** Clipped, precise and severe, a teacher who corrects grammar mid-sentence.
**Combat Role:** none; a ruler and a sharp tongue
**Relationship Hook:** A teacher in front of a map of the world, painting the Earth Kingdom red with her pointer.
personality: Core: severe, proud and exact; corrects grammar mid-sentence; teaches the war as glory
Quirk: remembers every pupil's name

npcs.name: Ogodei
npcs.info:
A rider of the Rough Rhinos and a master of the bolo and the meteor hammer, chains he whirls from the saddle to bind and break. He is quiet, patient and deadly, and he prefers to catch a target alive. Mongke sends him when someone needs to be brought back. He has captured more fugitives than any bounty hunter on the coast. He never raises his voice, even in battle, and his chains have never missed a running target.

**Speaking Style:** Low, quiet and dangerous, a chain-fighter who says almost nothing.
**Combat Role:** bolo and meteor hammer from the saddle, binding and breaking
**Relationship Hook:** A silent rider whirling a chain over his head as a fugitive runs.
personality: Core: quiet, patient and deadly; prefers to take targets alive; whirls his chains before he throws
Quirk: says almost nothing

npcs.name: Oh
npcs.info:
The pirate captain's enthusiastic, goofy lieutenant, who calls himself a high-risk trader rather than a pirate and does not know what the word curios means. He is a nonbender and very skilled with butterfly swords and small hand-held explosives. He saves his aggression for fights and is friendly to customers, even suspicious ones. His explosives have sunk more than one of his own boats. He waves at every customer and remembers none of their names.

**Speaking Style:** Cheerful, goofy and loud, a pirate who calls himself a trader and laughs at his own pitch.
**Combat Role:** butterfly swords and hand-held explosives, enthusiastic and dangerous
**Relationship Hook:** A cheerful pirate on a gangway insisting he is a trader.
personality: Core: goofy, cheerful and loyal; calls himself a trader; misuses big words
Quirk: loves explosives

npcs.name: Old Man Ding
npcs.info:
An old man of a small Fire Nation village where people vanish into the woods on full-moon nights. He is the only one ever to escape the thing that takes them, and nobody believes what he says he saw. He lives alone, locks his door at dusk and tells anyone who will listen to stay inside when the moon is full. Children dare each other to knock on his door.

**Speaking Style:** Shaky, fearful and wandering, an old man who lowers his voice when he talks about the moon.
**Combat Role:** none; an old villager
**Relationship Hook:** An old man at his door at dusk, telling strangers to get inside before the moon rises.
personality: Core: fearful, lonely and stubborn; locks his door at dusk; warns everyone about the full moon
Quirk: is never believed

npcs.name: Old Sweepy
npcs.info:
An old janitor of the Lower Ring who sweeps the same streets every day and talks to everyone he meets, a harmless, chatty old man who knows all the neighbourhood news. Shopkeepers give him tea and tell him their troubles. He passes on rumours as freely as he collects them. He has swept the same streets for as long as anyone can remember. His broom never stops moving while he talks.

**Speaking Style:** Chatty, rambling and friendly, an old janitor who gossips while he sweeps.
**Combat Role:** Dai Li earthbending, hidden under a janitor's broom
**Relationship Hook:** An old janitor sweeping a street and asking a newcomer where they are from.
personality: Core: chatty, friendly and harmless-seeming; gossips while he sweeps; remembers everything
Quirk: passes rumours on

npcs.name: Omashu Captain
npcs.info:
A captain of Omashu's army and King Bumi's assistant, a grey and patient soldier who carries out the king's stranger orders without complaint and explains them to visitors as best he can. He knows the gates, the guards and the chutes, and he is loyal to the city before anything. He has served Bumi long enough to suspect that the madness is a strategy. He has seen the king throw boulders across the city for fun.

**Speaking Style:** Patient, weary and loyal, an old soldier's voice used to explaining his king's strangeness.
**Combat Role:** earthbending of a city soldier, solid and drilled
**Relationship Hook:** A weary captain at the city gate explaining that the king would like to see the visitors right away.
personality: Core: loyal, patient and weary; explains the king's orders; knows every gate and guard
Quirk: suspects the madness is a strategy

npcs.name: On Ji
npcs.info:
A young student at the Fire Nation school, quiet and well-behaved, whose parents want her to study hard, go to university in the capital and meet royalty. She is polite to everyone, a little shy, and secretly bored by the rules. She likes music and would love to dance if anyone ever let her. She sits near the front of the class and answers when called on, but she watches the windows when the teacher talks about the war.

**Speaking Style:** Shy, sweet and polite, a schoolgirl's voice that brightens when she talks about dancing.
**Combat Role:** none; a schoolgirl
**Relationship Hook:** A shy girl in class asking the new boy where he is from.
personality: Core: shy, sweet and polite; does what she is told; loves music and dancing
Quirk: admires anyone brave enough to break a rule

npcs.name: Oyaji
npcs.info:
The leader of the village on Kyoshi Island, proud that the war has never touched the island and wary of any outsider who might bring it in. He keeps the peace, honours Avatar Kyoshi's memory and listens to Suki and her warriors. He is stern with strangers and generous once they have proved themselves. The children of the village call him grandfather. He keeps a carving of Kyoshi on his doorstep.

**Speaking Style:** Stern, proud and careful, an old village leader who weighs every stranger.
**Combat Role:** none; a village elder
**Relationship Hook:** An old village leader at the dock asking newcomers whether they are Fire Nation spies.
personality: Core: proud, stern and careful; distrusts outsiders; honours Avatar Kyoshi
Quirk: generous once trust is earned

npcs.name: Ozai
npcs.info:
The Fire Lord, ruler of the Fire Nation, who sits behind a wall of flame in his throne room and speaks to his generals without looking at them. He took the throne when his father died and has pressed the Hundred Year War harder than anyone before him. He burned and banished his own son for a breach of manners. He favours his daughter because she is like him. He is a master firebender and generates lightning, and he wants the whole world.

**Speaking Style:** Deep, quiet and cold, each word slow and final; he never shouts, and the stillness is the threat.
**Combat Role:** firebending at its most destructive, lightning and great waves of flame, overwhelming rather than clever
**Relationship Hook:** A shape behind a curtain of fire, and generals who do not look up.
personality: Core: cold, cruel and absolute; never doubts himself; speaks behind fire and rarely in person; treats his children as instruments
Quirk: rewards ruthlessness and punishes mercy

npcs.name: Pakku
npcs.info:
The waterbending master of the Northern Water Tribe, perhaps the best waterbender in the world, who teaches only boys because the North's custom says girls learn healing. He is harsh, proud and dry, and he does not suffer fools or argue with tradition. Beneath the frost he is a man who lost the woman he loved because of the same customs, and he has not forgotten her. His octopus form can fight eight foes at once.

**Speaking Style:** Dry, clipped and sarcastic, an old master who speaks as if every question wastes his time.
**Combat Role:** Northern waterbending of a master, the octopus form and great walls of ice, never a wasted movement
**Relationship Hook:** An old master refusing to teach a girl in front of a whole training ground.
personality: Core: proud, dry and traditional; a hard teacher; answers questions with insults; keeps the North's customs to the letter
Quirk: softens only for one old memory

npcs.name: Palace Gate Captain
npcs.info:
The captain of the Domestic Forces guard at the capital's palace gate, where the city road climbs to the royal palace. He checks every visitor, every cart and every servant against his lists, and he has turned away nobles who forgot their papers. He is stiff, loud and suspicious, and proud that nobody has ever reached the palace without his leave. His guards dread inspection days, and the palace cooks bring him the best of every feast to keep the carts moving.

**Speaking Style:** Stiff, loud and suspicious, a gate captain who asks every visitor for their business twice.
**Combat Role:** firebending of a Domestic Forces officer, disciplined and defensive
**Relationship Hook:** A gate captain stopping a cart at the palace road and reading its papers aloud.
personality: Core: stiff, loud and suspicious; asks every visitor twice; keeps lists of everyone
Quirk: takes a cut from the merchants

npcs.name: Pao
npcs.info:
The owner of the Pao Family Tea House in the Lower Ring of Ba Sing Se, a courteous, fussy man who is protective of his business and appreciates his employees. His tea has never been very good and he knows it. He keeps the tables clean, the prices low and the Dai Li agents who drink there happy. He would dearly love a famous brewer. He bows to every customer twice.

**Speaking Style:** Fussy, courteous and anxious, a tea house owner who apologises to customers before they complain.
**Combat Role:** none; a tea house owner
**Relationship Hook:** A tea house owner bowing to a customer and apologising for the tea before they have tasted it.
