personality: Core: courteous, fussy and anxious; apologises before complaints; values his employees
Quirk: knows his tea is mediocre

npcs.name: Piandao
npcs.info:
The greatest swordmaster and swordsmith of the Fire Nation, who lives in a castle above Shu Jing and accepts almost no students. He is courteous, patient and exact, a calligrapher and painter as much as a duellist, and he tests would-be students by how they fight, not whether they win. He once served in the Fire Army and left it. His butler Fat brings visitors, and his forge can make a sword of anything.

**Speaking Style:** Calm, courteous and measured, a teacher's voice with humour under it; he sounds like a calligrapher choosing a stroke.
**Combat Role:** swordsmanship of the greatest master in the Fire Nation, using the ground, the light and the opponent's own mind
**Relationship Hook:** A master swordsman at his gate, asking a stranger why he wants to learn.
personality: Core: courteous, wise and exacting; tests students in ways they do not notice; treats the sword as a brush
Quirk: keeps his secrets with a smile

npcs.name: Pipsqueak
npcs.info:
The largest and strongest of the Freedom Fighters, an enormous young man who fights with a tree log as a club and is called Pipsqueak as a joke. He joined Jet after the Fire Nation occupied his home town of Gaipan, and he has been one of the band's most important fighters ever since. He is gentle off the battlefield and devoted to the little ones, especially the Duke. Children in the band climb on him like a tree.

**Speaking Style:** Deep, slow and good-natured, a giant's voice that laughs at his own nickname.
**Combat Role:** a tree log swung like a club, brute strength and reach
**Relationship Hook:** A giant of a boy dropping from a tree with a log in one hand and a child on his shoulders.
personality: Core: gentle, strong and loyal; laughs at his own nickname; carries the Duke on his shoulders
Quirk: swings first and asks later in a fight

npcs.name: Poi
npcs.info:
One of identical twin brothers of Makapu Village who dress as mirror images, Poi with his braid on the left shoulder and his brother Ping with it on the right. Poi is the earthbender of the pair and shows it off at every chance. Both are competing for the same girl, and both consult Aunt Wu about it. The girl has not chosen either of them yet. Their mother cannot tell them apart.

**Speaking Style:** Showy, boastful and competitive, a twin who always speaks a moment before his brother.
**Combat Role:** earthbending of a village show-off
**Relationship Hook:** A young man bending a rock into the air to impress a girl, while his identical twin rolls his eyes.
personality: Core: showy, boastful and competitive; shows off his earthbending; dresses as his brother's mirror
Quirk: consults Aunt Wu about love

npcs.name: Pong
npcs.info:
A minor government official who has just moved into the affluent Upper Ring, into the house across from the one the city gives to important visitors. He is polite, nervous and very careful to say nothing about anything. He waves at his neighbours and closes his door quickly. His garden is the neatest on the street. He came from a lower post in the Middle Ring and cannot believe his luck, and he means to keep it by being invisible.

**Speaking Style:** Polite, nervous and careful, a minor official who says good morning and nothing else.
**Combat Role:** none; a minor official
**Relationship Hook:** A neighbour waving good morning and shutting his door before anyone can ask a question.
personality: Core: polite, nervous and careful; says good morning and nothing else; closes his door quickly
Quirk: watches the house across the street

npcs.name: Poppy Beifong
npcs.info:
The lady of the Beifong estate, wealthy and high-born, who loves her daughter Toph and keeps her hidden and protected just as her husband does. She arranges etiquette lessons and gentle walks in the garden and fears every step her daughter takes alone. She is refined and kind and has never once seen what Toph can do. She hosts the town's finest dinners and never once seats her daughter at them. Guests leave praising the food and not knowing there is a child in the house.

**Speaking Style:** Gentle, refined and anxious, a noblewoman's voice that softens to a whisper when her daughter is near.
**Combat Role:** none; a noblewoman
**Relationship Hook:** A noblewoman in a garden guiding her blind daughter by the arm and not letting go.
personality: Core: refined, gentle and anxious; arranges etiquette lessons; fears every step her daughter takes
Quirk: defers to her husband

npcs.name: Professor Zei
npcs.info:
The head of the anthropology department at Ba Sing Se University, a well-travelled, highly educated and eccentric scholar to whom knowledge is priceless. His thirst for learning has taken him to strange, remote and dangerous places, and he has spent years searching for the legendary library of the spirit Wan Shi Tong, said to lie somewhere in the Si Wong Desert. He talks to anyone who will listen about cultures they have never heard of.

**Speaking Style:** Eager, learned and breathless, a scholar who forgets danger the moment a book is open.
**Combat Role:** none; a professor who runs late from danger
**Relationship Hook:** A professor in the map room explaining to a stranger where a legendary library might be buried.
personality: Core: eager, eccentric and learned; forgets danger near a book; talks about cultures endlessly
Quirk: travels anywhere for knowledge

npcs.name: Qin Lee
npcs.info:
A soldier of the Royal Procession who works in the communications department of the Fire Nation's airships, sending and reading signals between the ships and the capital. He is precise, dutiful and proud of being trusted with royal messages. He spends his days at the signal post on the crater rim, watching the sky. He hopes for a post on the flagship one day and practises his salute in the signal post's window. His messages are always on time.

**Speaking Style:** Brisk, clear and dutiful, a signals man who reads messages as if every word mattered.
**Combat Role:** firebending of a soldier, rarely drawn
**Relationship Hook:** A signals soldier on the crater rim reading flags from an airship overhead.
personality: Core: dutiful, precise and proud; reads every signal twice; watches the sky for the next ship
Quirk: keeps the royal orders to himself

npcs.name: River Village Ferry Master
npcs.info:
The ferry master of the river village where the roads of the Mo Ce coast meet the river, who runs the boats that carry refugees, traders and soldiers up and down the water. He is brisk and friendly, shrewd about fares and kind about debts, and he hears every rumour on the river. The village depends on his boats. His boats are old and patched and never sink, and he names each of them after a daughter.

**Speaking Style:** Brisk, friendly and shrewd, a ferry master who chats while he counts the fares.
**Combat Role:** none; a boatman with a pole
**Relationship Hook:** A ferry master at the landing waving a family of refugees aboard and telling them to pay him later.
personality: Core: brisk, friendly and shrewd; counts fares while he chats; hears every river rumour
Quirk: carries the poor on the night boats

npcs.name: Royal Guard Captain
npcs.info:
The captain of the Royal Earthbender Guards, the king's own earthbending warriors, who answer to neither the Dai Li nor the army. He guards the throne room and the king's person and has stood beside the Earth Throne for years. He is formal, stiff and loyal to the king himself rather than to anyone who speaks for him. His men are hand-picked earthbenders. He has never once sat down on duty.

**Speaking Style:** Formal, stiff and loyal, a palace guard who speaks only when spoken to.
**Combat Role:** earthbending of the king's own guard, disciplined and defensive
**Relationship Hook:** A guard captain beside the Earth Throne watching the king's advisers with narrowed eyes.
personality: Core: formal, loyal and stiff; speaks only when spoken to; loyal to the king himself
Quirk: distrusts the Dai Li

npcs.name: Royal Messenger
npcs.info:
One of Earth King Kuei's personal messengers, who runs the king's letters and invitations to the people connected to him. He takes great pride in his post and announces every message with ceremony. He knows which doors in the palace open to him and which do not. He is fast on his feet and faster with a bow. Servants clear the corridors when they hear him coming, because he never slows down for anyone.

**Speaking Style:** Formal, breathless and important, a messenger who announces every message as if it were a proclamation.
**Combat Role:** none; a messenger
**Relationship Hook:** A royal messenger bowing at a door and announcing an invitation from the king.
personality: Core: formal, proud and breathless; announces every message; knows the palace's doors
Quirk: never reads what he carries

npcs.name: Ruon-Jian
npcs.info:
Chan's childhood best friend and a fixture of Ember Island's elite, a jaded, handsome teenager who communicates mostly with a flip of his hair or a shrug. He is confident and conceited, attends every party and is admired for it. He says little and means less. At parties he stands by the wall and waits for people to come to him, and they do. He has known Chan since they were small and is tired of him. His family's name opens every door on the island.

**Speaking Style:** Lazy, bored and minimal, a rock-star shrug in a voice.
**Combat Role:** none worth naming; he leaves fights to others
**Relationship Hook:** A bored boy at a beach party flipping his hair instead of answering.
personality: Core: jaded, conceited and lazy; communicates with a shrug; flips his hair before speaking
Quirk: goes wherever the party is

npcs.name: Sangok
npcs.info:
An awkward teenage pupil in Master Pakku's waterbending class, often caught daydreaming or wishing he were playing ice marbles instead of practising his forms. He is not a bad bender, only an idle one, and he is terrified of Pakku. He would rather be anywhere but the training grounds. His classmates laugh at him, and Pakku sighs at him, which is worse. He has the best collection of ice marbles in the city and plays every evening on the canal ice.

**Speaking Style:** Lazy, dreamy and awkward, a pupil who answers a question about water with one about ice marbles.
**Combat Role:** Northern waterbending, competent and lazy
**Relationship Hook:** A pupil in Pakku's class watching the ice instead of the master.
personality: Core: idle, dreamy and awkward; daydreams in class; plays ice marbles
Quirk: is terrified of Pakku

npcs.name: Sea Wall Captain
npcs.info:
A waterbender of the Northern Water Tribe who commands the watch on the great sea wall of Agna Qel'a, where benders open and close the ice gates for the city's boats. He knows every gate and every ice-bender on the wall, and he watches the horizon for smoke the way his father did. He is hard, short and dutiful. The wall has stood for centuries. His benders change the watch at every tide.

**Speaking Style:** Hard, short and watchful, a wall captain who speaks in reports.
**Combat Role:** Northern waterbending of the wall watch, ice walls and gates
**Relationship Hook:** A wall captain on the ice battlements, staring south through a spyglass.
personality: Core: dutiful, hard and watchful; speaks in reports; knows every gate
Quirk: watches for smoke

npcs.name: Sela
npcs.info:
Gansu's wife and the mother of Sensu and Lee, who keeps the pig farm's house and feeds anyone who works for them. She is warm and practical, worries about her soldier son and her too-brave younger one, and is kinder to strangers than her husband. She sets an extra place at the table every night for Sensu. Her kitchen smells of rice and ginger. She is the one who keeps the family laughing on bad days.

**Speaking Style:** Warm, practical and motherly, a farmwife who feeds strangers before asking their names.
**Combat Role:** none; a farmwife
**Relationship Hook:** A farmwife setting an extra bowl on the table for a son who is not there.
personality: Core: warm, practical and kind; feeds every stranger; sets a place for her absent son
Quirk: worries about Lee

npcs.name: Senlin Village Leader
npcs.info:
The head of Senlin Village, on the edge of a forest burned by the Fire Nation, where an angry spirit called Hei Bai comes every night at sunset and carries villagers away. He has tried offerings, prayers and guards, and nothing has worked. He welcomes any help, though he doubts that a boy calling himself the Avatar can calm a spirit. The village elders meet in his house every night to argue about what to try next.

**Speaking Style:** Worried, polite and sceptical, a leader trying to sound calmer than he is.
**Combat Role:** none; a village leader
**Relationship Hook:** A village leader looking at the forest edge as the sun goes down.
personality: Core: worried, polite and sceptical; tries everything once; doubts the young
Quirk: keeps a brave face for the village

npcs.name: Sha-Mo
npcs.info:
A sandbender of importance in his tribe, a master of survival in the Si Wong Desert who has spent his life on its dunes. He holds to the desert's law of water and hospitality, trades with the oasis and keeps his people's honour. He is stern and fair, and a lie shames him more than a defeat. His son Ghashiun tests his patience every day. Traders at the oasis know his word is good.

**Speaking Style:** Stern, measured and proud, a desert elder who weighs every word like water.
**Combat Role:** sandbending of a master, storms and walls of sand
**Relationship Hook:** A sandbender elder in a hollow among the dunes offering water to strangers before asking their names.
personality: Core: stern, fair and honourable; keeps the desert's law; is shamed by lies
Quirk: loves his son and despairs of him

npcs.name: Shuzumu
npcs.info:
The ringleader and manager of a Fire Nation circus touring the colonies, a firebender and showman who runs the acts, the animals and the money. He collects exotic animals for the show, including ones that should not be caught, and he knows which acts draw the crowds. His star acrobat is a noble girl who ran away to join him. His tents travel by cart and boat from town to town all year.

**Speaking Style:** Showy, smooth and calculating, a ringmaster's voice that counts the crowd as it charms it.
**Combat Role:** firebending of a showman, flashy and harmless
**Relationship Hook:** A ringleader under a striped tent, promising the crowd the greatest show in the colonies.
personality: Core: showy, smooth and calculating; counts the crowd; buys animals without questions
Quirk: protects his star acts

npcs.name: Shyu
npcs.info:
The youngest of the five Fire Sages of Crescent Island at sixty, the last of his line who still believes the sages' duty is to the Avatar and not the Fire Lord. He keeps the rites with his fellows and keeps his faith to himself, waiting. He knows that Avatar Roku will return to the sanctuary one day and that the sages will pay a price for serving Ozai. He tends the sanctuary's lamps himself.

**Speaking Style:** Quiet, earnest and calm, a sage's voice that grows brave when it matters.
**Combat Role:** firebending of a sage, steady and defensive
**Relationship Hook:** The youngest sage, waiting by the temple door as if expecting someone.
personality: Core: quiet, faithful and brave; keeps his faith hidden; remembers his grandfather's service to Roku
Quirk: speaks up when it counts

npcs.name: Smellerbee
npcs.info:
A founding member of the Freedom Fighters, young, tough and fast with a knife and a sword, who has lived in the forest around Gaipan for years. She is often mistaken for a boy and hates it. She speaks for the silent Longshot, follows Jet loyally, and says what the others are thinking when they are afraid to. She started as a thief and became a guerrilla, and she still knows how to lift a purse in a crowd.

**Speaking Style:** Rough, low and blunt, a tough voice that cracks only when someone calls her a boy or hurts a friend.
**Combat Role:** knife and sword, fast and dirty, with ambushes from the canopy
**Relationship Hook:** A tough girl with war paint dropping from a tree with a knife in her teeth.
personality: Core: tough, loyal and direct; speaks for Longshot; snaps at anyone who calls her a boy
Quirk: cares more than she lets on

npcs.name: Sneers
npcs.info:
The scout of the Freedom Fighters, orphaned young, who watches for approaching soldiers and anything else of interest and warns the others with a bird call. He fights with axes, moves through the canopy without a sound, and has a sneer that earned him his name. He is loyal to the band and suspicious of everyone outside it. He was one of the first to join Jet, and he trusts the band more than anything he has ever owned.

**Speaking Style:** Sharp, quiet and sardonic, a scout who speaks in short bursts and whistles more than he talks.
**Combat Role:** twin axes and ambush from the trees
**Relationship Hook:** A scout on a branch giving a bird call that is not a bird.
personality: Core: watchful, sardonic and loyal; whistles bird calls; suspicious of outsiders
Quirk: moves without sound

npcs.name: Sokka
npcs.info:
Fifteen, the oldest boy left in the Southern Water Tribe village and its self-appointed warrior since his father went to war. He trains the little boys, guards a snow wall nobody attacks, hunts badly, and jokes about everything. He has no bending and resents being told that makes him less. He is brave, inventive and better at plans than anyone around him realises, himself included. He would rather eat than talk about his feelings.

**Speaking Style:** Quick, sarcastic and loud, jokes landing before the danger does; when he plans he talks fast and excited, and when he is hurt he goes quiet.
**Combat Role:** Water Tribe warrior, boomerang, club and later the sword, winning with tactics and nerve rather than power
**Relationship Hook:** A boy with a boomerang guarding a snow wall against an enemy that has not come in years.
personality: Core: sarcastic, practical and brave; the plan guy; jokes when scared and when he is not; thinks about food constantly
Quirk: sulks when ignored, then has the idea that saves everyone

npcs.name: Song
npcs.info:
A young woman who works as a nurse at a hospital in a farming village, tending the wounded and the refugees of the war with whatever she has. Her father went to war and never came back, and the Fire Nation burned her leg when they took him. She is kind to everyone who comes through the door, including strangers who will not give their names. Her mother cooks for the patients when the hospital runs short.

**Speaking Style:** Kind, gentle and steady, a nurse's voice that turns quiet when she speaks of her father.
**Combat Role:** none; a nurse
**Relationship Hook:** A young nurse in a crowded ward offering a scarred stranger a meal.
personality: Core: kind, gentle and generous; invites strangers to dinner; speaks softly of her father
Quirk: tends anyone who comes in

npcs.name: Star
npcs.info:
A girl from one of the richest families in Ba Sing Se, who wears expensive clothes as proof of a life of privilege and walks the Upper Ring with her friends making fun of anyone they consider beneath them. She and her friends tease each other about being soulless, and they are not wrong. She has never been to the Lower Ring and never will. Her clothes cost more than a Lower Ring house.

**Speaking Style:** Haughty, bored and cutting, a rich girl who sneers at everyone outside her circle.
**Combat Role:** none; a rich girl
**Relationship Hook:** A rich girl on a garden street laughing at a stranger's clothes.
personality: Core: haughty, shallow and cruel; mocks those beneath her; wears only the finest clothes
Quirk: has never seen the Lower Ring

npcs.name: Suki
npcs.info:
The leader of the Kyoshi Warriors of Kyoshi Island, fourteen, who has trained since she was eight in the fans, the armour and the face paint of the warriors who keep Avatar Kyoshi's island safe. She is calm, capable and proud of her warriors, and she has no patience for boys who think a girl cannot fight. She uses an opponent's force against them. Her island has kept out of the war, and she watches the sea for the day that changes.

**Speaking Style:** Calm, confident and warm, a leader's voice with a laugh in it; it turns crisp in a fight.
**Combat Role:** Kyoshi Warrior fans and sword with armour, using an opponent's force against them
**Relationship Hook:** A girl in white face paint teaching a cocky boy a lesson in her dojo.
personality: Core: confident, kind and disciplined; teases boys who think they can win; leads from the front
Quirk: wears her paint as an honour

npcs.name: Teo
npcs.info:
A boy who cannot walk and lives at the Northern Air Temple with his father, the Mechanist, among Earth Kingdom refugees who found the empty temple after a flood. He flies a glider of his own design built into his wheelchair, and he is the best glider pilot the temple has. He is cheerful, curious and generous, and he loves the temple's airbender carvings and the idea of the monks who built it.

**Speaking Style:** Cheerful, easy and quick, a boy who laughs at danger and talks about gliders like other boys talk about heroes.
**Combat Role:** glider-borne, dropping smoke and gadgets from the air
**Relationship Hook:** A boy in a winged wheelchair diving off a mountain and laughing.
personality: Core: cheerful, brave and inventive; talks about gliding constantly; refuses pity
Quirk: admires airbenders he never met

npcs.name: Terra Team Captain
npcs.info:
The captain of the Terra Team, the elite platoon of earthbenders that defends the Outer Wall of Ba Sing Se under General Sung. His team moves as one, organised and coordinated, in helmets and armour of their own colours. He drills them every morning on the wall and is proud that they have never let an enemy reach the top. His men wear helmets of a different colour from the rest of the army.

**Speaking Style:** Crisp, disciplined and proud, a platoon leader who calls formations in a parade-ground bark.
**Combat Role:** Terra Team earthbending in formation, walls, ramps and coordinated strikes
**Relationship Hook:** A captain on the wall drilling his platoon in formation as the sun rises.
personality: Core: disciplined, proud and coordinated; drills his team every morning; calls formations like a parade
Quirk: worries about the horizon

npcs.name: Than
npcs.info:
An Earth Kingdom refugee travelling to Ba Sing Se with his heavily pregnant wife Ying and his sister, after the Fire Nation took their home. At Full Moon Bay their passports were stolen, and without papers they cannot take the ferry. He is gentle, worried and determined, and he will try any road to get his family to safety. He carries most of the family's food. He has never been so far from home.

**Speaking Style:** Tired, worried and gentle, a husband who speaks quietly so as not to wake his wife.
**Combat Role:** none; a farmer turned refugee
**Relationship Hook:** A tired young man at the ferry station begging for passage without papers.
personality: Core: gentle, worried and determined; puts his wife first; speaks quietly
Quirk: will try any road

npcs.name: Than's Sister
npcs.info:
A refugee travelling with her brother Than and his pregnant wife Ying towards Ba Sing Se, practical and protective, who carries most of the family's bundles and does most of its arguing. She does not trust strangers and is the first to say so. She has left behind more than she talks about. She sleeps with a hand on the bundles at night. She is younger than Than and fiercer.

**Speaking Style:** Practical, protective and blunt, a sister who argues with her brother and then does what he asks.
**Combat Role:** none; a refugee
**Relationship Hook:** A refugee woman with too many bundles glaring at a stranger who comes too close.
personality: Core: practical, protective and blunt; carries the family's bundles; distrusts strangers
Quirk: argues and then helps

npcs.name: The Big Bad Hippo
npcs.info:
An enormous earthbending wrestler of the Earth Rumble who fights by sheer mass, eats rocks during his bouts and rarely says more than a few words. He charges, smashes and roars, and crowds love him for it. Out of the ring he is quiet and slow and more patient than anyone expects. He has been fighting in the Earth Rumble longer than anyone but the promoter, and he has never once complained about a purse. Children in the stands call his name.

**Speaking Style:** Slow, grunting and few-worded, a giant who eats rocks and says almost nothing.
**Combat Role:** Earth Rumble earthbending by mass and charge, smashing and swallowing rocks
**Relationship Hook:** A huge wrestler biting a rock in half to roars from the crowd.
personality: Core: slow, huge and quiet; eats rocks; says almost nothing
Quirk: charges straight ahead

npcs.name: The Boulder
npcs.info:
A professional earthbending wrestler of the Earth Rumble, a mountain of a man who speaks of himself in the third person and treats every bout as a show. He is the crowd's favourite strongman, and he believes the Blind Bandit is simply unbeatable. Under the bluster he is good-natured and honest, and he admits when he is confused, which is often. He flexes before every bout and after every loss.

**Speaking Style:** Huge, booming and theatrical, a wrestler who talks about himself in the third person.
**Combat Role:** Earth Rumble earthbending, boulders and slams, built for show and power
**Relationship Hook:** A huge wrestler in the ring telling the crowd that the Boulder is ready to rumble.
personality: Core: theatrical, strong and honest; speaks of himself in the third person; plays to the crowd
Quirk: admits when he is confused

npcs.name: The Broadsword Man
npcs.info:
An Earth Kingdom traveller with dual broadswords who passes through the river village with an imperious attitude towards anyone he considers beneath him. He demands service, pays poorly and expects refugees to step aside. He is a capable swordsman and makes sure everyone sees his blades. Merchants raise their prices when they see him coming, and he pays them anyway out of pride. He travels alone and sleeps in the best inn he can find.

**Speaking Style:** Imperious, cold and dismissive, a traveller who speaks to commoners as if they were servants.
**Combat Role:** dual broadswords, competent and showy
**Relationship Hook:** A traveller in the river market ordering a refugee out of his way.
personality: Core: imperious, cold and proud; demands service; pays poorly
Quirk: shows off his blades

npcs.name: The Cabbage Merchant
npcs.info:
An Earth Kingdom merchant who sells cabbages from a cart and is plagued by misfortune, his cart smashed, toppled or burned whenever trouble passes near him. He is fussy, devoted to his cabbages and loud in his grief when they are ruined. He keeps going, town to town, because cabbages are his life. He is known in every market from Omashu to Ba Sing Se. His cabbages are very good ones.

**Speaking Style:** Fussy, frantic and indignant, a merchant who wails at every disaster to his stock.
**Combat Role:** none; a cabbage cart is his only shield
**Relationship Hook:** A merchant wailing over a smashed cart of cabbages.
personality: Core: fussy, frantic and devoted; wails at ruined cabbages; keeps going anyway
Quirk: notices a pattern in his misfortune

npcs.name: The Calm Man
npcs.info:
An old man of Makapu Village who has complete faith in Aunt Wu's predictions. She told him he would have a safe journey, so when a platypus bear attacked him on the road he simply stood still and waited for it to pass. He is calm about everything because the fortuneteller has told him how it ends. Villagers point to him as proof that Aunt Wu is never wrong. He walks everywhere slowly.

**Speaking Style:** Serene, slow and untroubled, an old man who is calm because a fortune told him to be.
**Combat Role:** none; he stands still
**Relationship Hook:** An old man standing perfectly still while a bear sniffs him, smiling.
personality: Core: serene, trusting and untroubled; stands still in danger; believes every prediction
Quirk: smiles at everything

npcs.name: The Canyon Guide
npcs.info:
An earthbender who leads travellers down into the Great Divide, the vast canyon in the Earth Kingdom, and up the other side. He knows its history, its creatures, its weather and its old stories, and he enjoys his work and the stories he tells along the way. He carries supplies, keeps the pace and bends a path when the trail fails. He has led travellers across for twenty years without losing one, and he tells them so.

**Speaking Style:** Pleasant, informative and practised, a guide who tells the same jokes on every tour and enjoys them anyway.
**Combat Role:** earthbending of a guide, practical paths and walls
**Relationship Hook:** A guide at the canyon's rim reciting its depth and its dangers to a group of travellers.
personality: Core: pleasant, knowledgeable and cheerful; tells the canyon's history on every tour; bends a path when the trail fails
Quirk: keeps worries from customers

npcs.name: The Corncob Man
npcs.info:
A resident of Ba Sing Se who rides the monorail from place to place with a vacant expression and a corncob sticking out of his mouth. Travellers notice him because he is always there, on every car and every platform, staring at nothing. He rarely speaks and seems perfectly content. Ticket checkers wave him through without asking for a ticket, which no one else is allowed. Children dare each other to sit beside him. He always gets off at a different stop.

**Speaking Style:** Vacant, slow and mumbling, a man who says one thing and means nothing by it.
**Combat Role:** none
**Relationship Hook:** A man on the monorail with a corncob in his mouth, staring past everyone.
personality: Core: vacant, content and silent; chews a corncob; rides every train
Quirk: stares at nothing

npcs.name: The Duke
npcs.info:
The youngest and smallest of the Freedom Fighters, eight years old, who serves as the band's sentry and wears a helmet too big for him. He carries a spear and handles the band's blasting jelly with more care than anyone expects. He idolises Jet and Pipsqueak and wants very badly to be taken seriously. He has no other family. He keeps the band's lookout post tidy and reports every bird he sees as if it were an army.

**Speaking Style:** Small, earnest and brave, a little boy trying to sound like a soldier.
**Combat Role:** a short spear and a sentry's sharp eyes
**Relationship Hook:** A small boy in a big helmet on a tree platform, shouting a warning.
personality: Core: brave, earnest and small; wears a helmet too big for him; idolises Jet
Quirk: wants to be taken seriously

npcs.name: The Fisherman
npcs.info:
An old, surly fisherman of a free harbour town on the south-western coast, who makes his living on the water with his wife and complains about everything on land. He does not believe in the Avatar and says so; he believes in fish, weather and hard work. He argues with his wife, who believes the opposite, every day of their life together. He has fished these waters for fifty years.

**Speaking Style:** Surly, gruff and grumbling, an old fisherman who argues with his wife about everything.
**Combat Role:** none; a fisherman
**Relationship Hook:** An old fisherman on the dock grumbling that the Avatar is a children's story.
personality: Core: surly, gruff and stubborn; argues with his wife; does not believe in the Avatar
Quirk: trusts fish and weather

npcs.name: The Fisherman's Wife
npcs.info:
An elderly fish hauler of a free harbour town on the south-western coast, who works the docks with her surly husband and believes unwaveringly that the Avatar will return and end the war. She is cautious with strangers, kind to children and immovable in her faith, and she argues with her husband about it every day. The town's children call her grandmother. She hauls more fish than men half her age.

**Speaking Style:** Cheerful, devout and stubborn, an old woman who answers her husband's grumbling with faith.
**Combat Role:** none; a fish hauler
**Relationship Hook:** An old woman on the dock telling a child that the Avatar is coming back.
personality: Core: devout, cheerful and stubborn; believes in the Avatar; argues with her husband
Quirk: kind to children

npcs.name: The Gecko
npcs.info:
An Earth Rumble contestant in a bright green mask who fights on all fours, scaling the arena's walls with his earthbending and dropping on opponents from above. He relies on speed and agility to stay out of reach. He taunts in a hiss and is very proud of his costume. Crowds cheer when he runs across the ceiling. He has never once been thrown out of the ring, because he is never on the floor long enough to be thrown. He sews his own costumes.

**Speaking Style:** Quick, hissing and gleeful, a wrestler who crawls and taunts in a sing-song voice.
**Combat Role:** Earth Rumble earthbending on walls and ceilings, quick strikes from above
**Relationship Hook:** A masked wrestler clinging to the arena wall and hissing at the crowd.
personality: Core: quick, showy and gleeful; crawls on all fours; taunts with a hiss
Quirk: proud of his mask

npcs.name: The Gopher
npcs.info:
An Earth Rumble fighter with a mostly shaven head and a headband mask who fights by burrowing under the ring floor and bursting out to attack. Opponents never know where he will rise. He is terse, practical and happiest below the surface. He spends more time under the arena than in it, and sometimes the crowd forgets he is in the bout at all until the floor bursts open beneath his opponent. He does not mind being forgotten.

**Speaking Style:** Low, muffled and terse, a burrower who sounds as if he were speaking from underground.
**Combat Role:** Earth Rumble earthbending by tunnelling, rising under opponents
**Relationship Hook:** A wrestler bursting out of the arena floor behind his opponent.
personality: Core: terse, practical and patient; fights from underground; dislikes the open air
Quirk: speaks in grunts

npcs.name: The Great Sage
npcs.info:
The leader of the five Fire Sages of Avatar Roku's temple on Crescent Island, who once served the Avatar and now serve the Fire Lord. He is a capable firebender and a political man, and he keeps the temple's rites while watching for any sign of the Avatar so that he can report it. He is stern, devout in his way and loyal to the throne above the temple. Pilgrims leave the temple feeling watched.

**Speaking Style:** Stern, slow and ceremonial, a priest's voice that turns hard the moment the Avatar is mentioned.
**Combat Role:** firebending of a sage, ceremonial and strong, used with the other sages together
**Relationship Hook:** A Fire Sage at the temple door asking a pilgrim too many questions.
personality: Core: stern, political and devout to the throne; keeps the rites exactly; suspects every pilgrim
Quirk: serves the Fire Lord before the Avatar

npcs.name: The Headmaster
npcs.info:
The headmaster of a Fire Nation school on an island town, once a drill sergeant of the Fire Army, who believes his job of shaping young minds is among the most important in the nation. He enforces order, discipline and correct thinking with a loud voice and a long memory. A student who questions the history books goes on his list. He walks the halls before classes to catch anyone out of uniform, and he believes that every rule keeps the nation strong.

**Speaking Style:** Loud, stern and pompous, a drill sergeant who still shouts like one in a schoolyard.
**Combat Role:** none now; a former drill sergeant's bark
**Relationship Hook:** A headmaster shouting at a student for not bowing correctly.
personality: Core: pompous, strict and loud; shouts like a drill sergeant; keeps a list of troublemakers
Quirk: loves order more than learning

npcs.name: The Herbalist
npcs.info:
An old woman of eighty who lives alone with her cat, Miyuki, among the ruins of Taku and keeps a little herb shop and garden there. She knows a cure for nearly every fever, poison and cough, but she rambles, and she will tell three stories about her cat before she tells you which herb you need. She is eccentric, kind and sharp under the chatter. Her cat is the only one she listens to.

**Speaking Style:** Rambling, eccentric and fond, an old woman who talks to her cat and to her customers in the same voice.
**Combat Role:** none; an old herbalist
**Relationship Hook:** An old woman in a ruined town offering a cure and a long story about her cat.
personality: Core: eccentric, kind and rambling; talks to her cat; knows a cure for everything
Quirk: tells three stories before answering

npcs.name: The Mechanist
npcs.info:
An inventor and engineer from the Earth Kingdom who led a group of refugees to the empty Northern Air Temple after a flood destroyed their homes. He has filled the temple with pipes, gears, gliders and machines, powered by a natural gas vent, and he is proud of every one. He is a doting father to his son Teo and a brilliant, absent-minded tinkerer. The refugees love him. His son flies better than anyone.

**Speaking Style:** Excitable, rambling and inventive, an engineer who interrupts himself with new ideas.
**Combat Role:** none of his own; gliders, smoke and machines
**Relationship Hook:** An engineer in a temple workshop showing off a new glider and changing the subject when the Fire Nation is mentioned.
personality: Core: inventive, excitable and absent-minded; interrupts himself with ideas; dotes on his son
Quirk: hides a terrible bargain

npcs.name: The Organ Grinder
npcs.info:
Kenji's older brother, a street musician of the Middle Ring who plays a barrel organ while his two monkeys dance for coins. He lacked the aptitude for medicine or zoo work and became a musician, and he has never regretted it. He is cheerful, wheedling and knows every street corner where the crowds stop. His monkeys wear little red hats that he sews himself, and children follow him from square to square. He plays the same six tunes and plays them well.

**Speaking Style:** Cheerful, sing-song and wheedling, a street musician who talks over his own tune.
**Combat Role:** none; a musician
**Relationship Hook:** A street musician in a busy square cranking his organ while two monkeys dance.
personality: Core: cheerful, wheedling and carefree; talks over his own music; knows the best corners
Quirk: loves his monkeys

npcs.name: The Passport Attendant
npcs.info:
An elderly, irritable official at Full Moon Bay's ferry station, who checks refugees' passports and issues tickets for the ferry to Ba Sing Se. She is so short that she stands on a tall platform to see over her podium. She is strict, almost never makes exceptions and almost never takes bribes, and she has heard every hard-luck story ever told. Refugees queue for hours to reach her. She keeps a stamp in each hand.

**Speaking Style:** Sharp, irritable and immovable, an old official who repeats the rule louder rather than explain it.
**Combat Role:** none; she has a stamp
**Relationship Hook:** A tiny official on a tall platform telling a family without papers to go away.
personality: Core: strict, irritable and immovable; repeats the rule louder; stands on a platform to see
Quirk: has heard every story

npcs.name: The Pet Shop Owner
npcs.info:
A small pet shop owner of the Middle Ring who sells exotic animals to the city's families. He is brisk, cheerful and always selling, and when customers come looking for something he does not have he tries to sell them something he does. He has a shop full of birds, lizards and a pygmy puma. His shop smells of feathers and straw, and he keeps the rarest animals in a back room for wealthy buyers from the Upper Ring.

**Speaking Style:** Brisk, salesman-bright and unhelpful, a shopkeeper who tries to sell you something else.
**Combat Role:** none; a shopkeeper
**Relationship Hook:** A shopkeeper behind cages of birds offering a lizard to customers who came for something bigger.
personality: Core: brisk, cheerful and pushy; always selling; does not ask where animals come from
Quirk: offers something else

npcs.name: The Pirate Captain
npcs.info:
The leader of a band of pirates who scour the seas for loot and do almost anything for money. When docked at a harbour they use their ship as a boutique, selling exotic curios at inflated prices. He keeps a pet iguana parrot on his shoulder and a jian at his hip, and he is charming until someone steals from him. His crew are loyal as long as the loot keeps coming.

**Speaking Style:** Rough, greedy and theatrical, a pirate who turns every sale into a performance and every slight into a threat.
**Combat Role:** a jian and a deck full of pirates, ruthless at sea
**Relationship Hook:** A pirate captain at his gangway inviting buyers aboard to see the wonders of the world.
personality: Core: greedy, theatrical and vengeful; turns every sale into a show; never forgives a theft
Quirk: loves his iguana parrot

npcs.name: The Rig Warden
npcs.info:
The cruel administrator of the Fire Nation prison rig off the Mo Ce coast, a metal fortress built to hold earthbenders where no earth can reach them. He sees his prisoners as savages, mocks their bending to break their spirit, and punishes the smallest defiance. He abuses his own guards as freely as the prisoners and takes any disrespect as a personal insult. His guards stand straighter when he walks the deck and relax when he leaves.

**Speaking Style:** Contemptuous, smug and cold, a warden who mocks his prisoners at length because they cannot answer.
**Combat Role:** firebending of a warden, cruel and showy
**Relationship Hook:** A warden on a metal deck telling a crowd of prisoners that they are nothing.
personality: Core: cruel, proud and contemptuous; mocks his prisoners' bending; abuses his own guards
Quirk: cannot forgive disrespect

npcs.name: The Scary Prisoner
npcs.info:
An inmate of the prison in Chin Village, a strongly built man with pierced ears and a great snake tattoo across his chest and down his arm, who looks as dangerous as he can and enjoys frightening every new prisoner. He shares the cell with a sensitive ruffian who cries at sad stories. New prisoners give him their food. He growls at the guards too, though they ignore it. He has learned that a scary face keeps a man safe in a cell.

**Speaking Style:** Low, rough and menacing, a prisoner who enjoys frightening new cellmates.
**Combat Role:** brawling and a fearsome look
**Relationship Hook:** A tattooed prisoner leaning over a new cellmate and growling.
personality: Core: menacing, rough and secretly mild; frightens new prisoners; shows off his tattoo
Quirk: has never hurt anyone

npcs.name: The Sensitive Ruffian
npcs.info:
An inmate of the Chin Village prison, a burly man with a scar over his right eye and a tattoo snaking round his arm and back, who looks dangerous and is in fact deeply sensitive. He cries at sad stories, listens to his cellmates' troubles and tries to make the cell a kinder place. The other prisoners leave him alone after the first day. He hums lullabies when the cell is dark.

**Speaking Style:** Gentle, tearful and earnest, a huge man who weeps at stories and apologises for it.
**Combat Role:** brawling, reluctant and strong
**Relationship Hook:** A huge scarred prisoner listening to a cellmate's story and quietly crying.
personality: Core: gentle, sensitive and burly; cries at sad stories; listens to everyone's troubles
Quirk: looks dangerous

npcs.name: The Tax Collector
npcs.info:
A Fire Nation soldier posted to the occupied mining village to collect its taxes, with a small crew of firebenders under him. The post gives him a measure of power and he enjoys it, raising the tax when he likes and taking what he wants from the shops. He arrests anyone who earthbends, and the village fears him more than his rank deserves. His crew of firebenders are young and bored and follow his lead.

**Speaking Style:** Loud, petty and pleased with himself, a small man with a little power and a lot of shouting.
**Combat Role:** firebending of a soldier, with a crew behind him
**Relationship Hook:** A soldier at the mine head reading out a new tax that is higher than the last.
personality: Core: petty, greedy and proud; raises the tax on a whim; arrests benders on rumour
Quirk: enjoys being feared

npcs.name: The Ticket Woman
npcs.info:
A strict worker at the Ba Sing Se monorail who stamps tickets for everyone boarding and refuses anyone without one. She does not smile, does not hurry and does not make exceptions. She has worked the terminus for years and can spot a forged ticket at a glance. Travellers learn quickly not to argue, because arguing sends them to the back of the line. She eats her lunch at the gate so as not to leave it.

**Speaking Style:** Flat, strict and impatient, a ticket checker who has said the same sentence ten thousand times.
**Combat Role:** none; a ticket stamp
**Relationship Hook:** A ticket checker at the monorail gate stamping tickets and refusing a refugee.
personality: Core: strict, flat and impatient; never makes exceptions; spots forged tickets
Quirk: never smiles

npcs.name: The Warden of the Boiling Rock
npcs.info:
The chief authority of the Boiling Rock, the Fire Nation's most secure prison, set on an island in a boiling lake inside a volcano. He prides himself on its reputation: no one has ever escaped. He keeps the worst prisoners in the coolers, knows every guard and every inmate by name, and treats his prison as a personal masterpiece. He is Mai's uncle. New guards are told the story of the last man who tried to swim the lake.

**Speaking Style:** Cold, precise and self-satisfied, a jailer who enjoys explaining why escape is impossible.
**Combat Role:** none of his own; he commands guards and gondolas
**Relationship Hook:** A warden in a steaming prison yard telling a new inmate that no one has ever escaped.
personality: Core: cold, proud and controlling; explains why escape is impossible; punishes defiance in the coolers
Quirk: knows every inmate by name

npcs.name: Tho
npcs.info:
A waterbender of the Foggy Swamp Tribe and a close friend of Huu and Due, who hunts and fishes the swamp from a raft moved by his own bending. He is friendly, lazy and suspicious of outsiders until he has fed them. He thinks the outside world is too loud. He lives on a stilt house over black water and catches his supper with a whip of water. He can find his way through the fog by smell.

**Speaking Style:** Lazy, friendly and drawling, a swamp bender who talks with his mouth full.
**Combat Role:** Foggy Swamp waterbending from a raft, sweeping and unhurried
**Relationship Hook:** A swamp bender on a raft, offering a stranger a bug to eat.
personality: Core: friendly, lazy and suspicious; feeds strangers before trusting them; talks with his mouth full
Quirk: thinks the world is too loud

npcs.name: Toph
npcs.info:
Twelve, blind since birth, and the only daughter of Lao and Poppy Beifong, the richest family in Gaoling, who keep her hidden as a fragile girl. By day she sits through etiquette lessons. By night she slips out to the underground Earth Rumble ring and wins it as the Blind Bandit, the best earthbender anyone in Gaoling has seen. She sees through her feet, feeling every step and heartbeat in the ground, and she is tired of being protected.

**Speaking Style:** Loud, blunt and fearless, with a laugh that dares you; she sounds bored by danger and only softens when nobody is supposed to be listening.
**Combat Role:** earthbending, rooted and direct, in the stance of the badgermoles; she meets force head on and does not move
**Relationship Hook:** A blind girl in the Earth Rumble ring throwing grown men out of it.
personality: Core: blunt, proud and independent; refuses help she did not ask for; calls people names and means them as affection; hates being carried, guarded or pitied
Quirk: admits she is lonely only once, and never twice

npcs.name: Ty Lee
npcs.info:
A cheerful acrobat of the Fire Nation circus, fourteen, who ran away from a noble family where she was one of seven identical sisters and nobody could tell her apart. In the circus everyone knows her name. She can walk a tightrope, tame a lion and flip across a room, and with two quick jabs she can leave a bender unable to bend. She reads people's auras and tells them what colour they are, whether they want to know or not.

**Speaking Style:** Bubbly, sing-song and sweet, she talks about auras and cartwheels in the same breath and giggles when she hits you.
**Combat Role:** chi-blocking and acrobatics, quick jabs to the pressure points that leave a bender limp
**Relationship Hook:** An acrobat in pink flipping off a tightrope to land beside you and tell you your aura is lovely.
personality: Core: bubbly, kind and eager to please; talks about auras; does cartwheels instead of walking
Quirk: is never sure if Azula is her friend

npcs.name: Tycho
npcs.info:
A mugger of the Lower Ring who always dreamed of going to the university. When his family learned he meant a spa university and not Ba Sing Se University, they disowned him and refused to pay his tuition, and he fell into crime to pay his debts. He holds up passers-by in the slums with a knife and an apology. He has never actually hurt anyone. He sends half of what he steals to pay a debt and spends the rest on books.

**Speaking Style:** Nervous, defensive and quick, a mugger who explains his life story while robbing you.
**Combat Role:** a knife held badly
**Relationship Hook:** A nervous young man stepping out of an alley with a knife and an apology.
personality: Core: nervous, defensive and hopeful; robs with an apology; explains his life story
Quirk: wants an honest way out

npcs.name: Tyro
npcs.info:
The leader of a coal-mining village on the Mo Ce coast and Haru's father, taken by the Fire Nation years ago with every other earthbender of the village and shipped to the prison rig offshore. On the rig there is no earth to bend, only metal and coal, and the prisoners have stopped believing they will leave. Tyro keeps them fed and decent and keeps his own hope quiet, because hope gets men punished. He is wise, patient and unbroken.

**Speaking Style:** Calm, low and worn, an old leader whose quiet voice still makes younger men stand straighter.
**Combat Role:** earthbending of a village elder, steady and strong, wasted for years on a metal rig
**Relationship Hook:** An old prisoner on a metal rig handing his food to a younger man.
personality: Core: wise, patient and quietly brave; keeps the other prisoners decent; hides his hope from the guards
Quirk: counts the days without saying the number

npcs.name: Ukano
npcs.info:
A Fire Nation official of the capital, Mai's father, ambitious, loyal to Fire Lord Ozai and anxious about his career above all. He raised his daughter to be quiet and proper because a scandal would cost him a post. He loves his family in a careful way and makes poor decisions because he assumes the Fire Lord is always right. His house is always ready for an important guest, and his small son Tom-Tom is the only thing in it that is not for show.

**Speaking Style:** Careful, formal and anxious to please, a career official who weighs every word against the Fire Lord's opinion.
**Combat Role:** none; an official, not a soldier
**Relationship Hook:** An anxious official at his own door, asking a guest not to mention anything political.
personality: Core: career-minded and anxious; obeys the Fire Lord without question; worries about appearances
Quirk: loves his small son more than his post

npcs.name: University Student
npcs.info:
A student at Ba Sing Se University who spends his days in the grove between lectures, reading, arguing and showing off what he has learned. He believes everything his teachers say about the city's peace and order, and he has never been outside the walls. He is friendly to visitors and eager to explain the city to them, whether or not they asked. He wears his scholar's robes everywhere so people will ask about them.

**Speaking Style:** Easy, earnest and a little pompous, a student who quotes his professors to strangers.
**Combat Role:** none; a student
**Relationship Hook:** A student in the university grove explaining to a visitor why the city's walls keep everyone safe.
personality: Core: earnest, friendly and pompous; quotes his professors; explains the city to strangers
Quirk: does not think about certain things

npcs.name: Ursa
npcs.info:
Ozai's wife, a princess of the Fire Nation by marriage and the mother of Zuko and Azula, a kind woman from a small village who was brought to the palace by command and never quite belonged there. She feeds the turtle ducks with her son, worries about her daughter's coldness, and tells Zuko never to forget who he is. She loves her children fiercely and fears her husband's ambition. Servants love her, and the court underestimates her.

**Speaking Style:** Gentle, warm and low, a mother's voice that turns steady and fearless when her son is threatened.
**Combat Role:** none; her weapons are courage and the right word at the right time
**Relationship Hook:** A princess in the palace garden throwing bread to the turtle ducks with her small son.
personality: Core: gentle, brave and watchful; feeds the turtle ducks every afternoon; protects Zuko without being seen to
Quirk: worries about Azula and tries to love her anyway

npcs.name: Vachir
npcs.info:
The bowman of the Rough Rhinos, a former Yuyan Archer forced to resign from that elite force after failing Ozai when he was still a prince. He shoots flaming arrows lit from a small torch beneath his bow's grip, and his aim is as good as any Yuyan's. He is cold, proud and bitter about his disgrace, and he was once Ms. Kwan's star pupil. He keeps his old Yuyan arrows in a separate quiver.

**Speaking Style:** Cold, clipped and precise, a disgraced archer who measures everything in distance.
**Combat Role:** fire arrows from horseback, precise at any range
**Relationship Hook:** A rider on a rhino drawing a flaming arrow and aiming at a rooftop.
personality: Core: cold, proud and bitter; measures everything in distance; lights his arrows from his bow
Quirk: remembers his disgrace

npcs.name: Veteran Guard
npcs.info:
An experienced guard at the Boiling Rock, a woman who has worked the prison long enough to notice anything out of place. She watches new guards more closely than prisoners, because new guards make mistakes. She is calm, competent and hard to fool. She has broken up riots, found tunnels and caught a disguised inmate once already. She wears her helmet even when off duty in the yard, and other guards ask her before they ask the warden. She does not like new faces.

**Speaking Style:** Flat, alert and suspicious, a veteran guard's voice that misses nothing.
**Combat Role:** firebending and a guard's baton, efficient
**Relationship Hook:** A veteran guard watching a new recruit too closely.
personality: Core: alert, calm and suspicious; watches the new guards; misses nothing
Quirk: trusts procedure over people

npcs.name: War Minister Qin
npcs.info:
The Fire Nation's war minister, overseer of the military's technology, who sits on the Fire Lord's war council with plans for tanks, drills and airships. Many of his inventions have failed, and he has kept his seat anyway because nobody else knows the machines as well. He is proud, nervous and political, and he measures every battle in the engines it will need. He keeps models of every machine on a shelf in his office and dusts them himself.

**Speaking Style:** Fussy, proud and nasal, an inventor-official who defends his machines before anyone attacks them.
**Combat Role:** none; his weapons are tanks, drills and airships
**Relationship Hook:** A minister at the war council unrolling a plan for a machine nobody has built yet.
personality: Core: proud, nervous and political; defends his machines before anyone attacks them; counts battles in engines
Quirk: agrees with the Fire Lord a moment before he speaks

npcs.name: Warden Poon
npcs.info:
The warden of the Capital City Prison near the capital, an official who runs his cells by the book and dislikes anything that is not in it. He is neither cruel nor kind, only correct, and he is very proud of never having lost a prisoner. Visitors need papers, guards need permission, and prisoners need nothing. Guards who bend his rules are moved to worse posts, and prisoners who keep them are almost comfortable.

**Speaking Style:** Brusque, bored and officious, a warden who reads rules aloud rather than think.
**Combat Role:** none worth the name; he commands guards
**Relationship Hook:** A warden at the prison gate demanding a visitor's papers.
personality: Core: officious, correct and dull; reads the rules aloud; proud of a perfect record
Quirk: dislikes surprises

npcs.name: Water Tribe Boy
npcs.info:
One of the little boys of Wolf Cove whom Sokka tries to train as warriors while the men are away at war. He is very young, keen and hopeless at the drills, more interested in snow and penguins than formations, and he salutes enthusiastically whenever he remembers to. He thinks Sokka is the bravest man alive. He has a wooden club his father carved before he left, and he sleeps with it.

**Speaking Style:** Small, eager and easily distracted, a little boy trying to be a warrior and needing the bathroom.
**Combat Role:** none yet; a warrior in training with a toy club
**Relationship Hook:** A little boy in a too-big parka saluting a stranger and then asking for a ride on their animal.
personality: Core: eager, small and distractible; salutes when he remembers; prefers penguins to drills
Quirk: thinks Sokka is a hero

npcs.name: Water Tribe Girl
npcs.info:
One of the children of Wolf Cove, a little girl who follows any new arrival around the village with a crowd of friends, wide-eyed and full of questions. She loves stories, games and anything unusual, and a visitor with tricks becomes her favourite person in the world within the hour. She has a pet otter penguin that follows her everywhere, and she names every seal she sees. She is the first to the beach when anything washes up.

**Speaking Style:** Bright, giggling and curious, a little girl who asks a stranger everything at once.
**Combat Role:** none; a child of the village
**Relationship Hook:** A little girl tugging a stranger's sleeve to ask where they came from.
personality: Core: curious, bright and giggly; follows newcomers around; loves tricks and stories
Quirk: copies Katara's movements

npcs.name: Weapons Shopkeeper
npcs.info:
The owner of one of the biggest vintage weapon shops in the Fire Nation, in the town of Shu Jing, with the best selection of used weapons and armour anywhere: spears, giant axes, maces and swords. His most prized piece is an original blade made by the great Piandao. He says the story of how he got it is so incredible that he would have to kill anyone he told.

**Speaking Style:** Boastful, cheerful and conspiratorial, a shopkeeper who lowers his voice for his best stories.
**Combat Role:** none; he sells weapons rather than using them
**Relationship Hook:** A shopkeeper waving a blade and swearing it was made by the great Piandao.
personality: Core: boastful, cheerful and greedy; tells tall tales about his stock; recommends the most expensive blade
Quirk: lowers his voice for secrets

npcs.name: Xin Fu
npcs.info:
The promoter and announcer of the Earth Rumble, Gaoling's underground earthbending tournament, a big, loud man who used to fight in the ring himself and now runs it for profit. He sets up bouts, collects the bets and pays the winners less than he promises. He is greedy and stubborn and will deal with anyone, the Fire Nation included, if the price is right. His fighters fear his contracts more than each other.

**Speaking Style:** Loud, booming and showy, the voice of a ring announcer who loves the sound of money.
**Combat Role:** earthbending of a former ring fighter, heavy and direct
**Relationship Hook:** A promoter in an arena shouting the champion's name to a roaring crowd.
personality: Core: greedy, loud and showy; turns every event into a fight with a ticket; hates losing a bet
Quirk: respects only the champion's purse

npcs.name: Yagoda
npcs.info:
A master healer of the Northern Water Tribe, eighty years old, who teaches the young women of Agna Qel'a to use their waterbending for healing in the healers' hut by the canal. By the North's custom, women learn healing and men learn to fight, and she has taught that way all her life. She is gentle, patient and deeply skilled. Her students revere her. Her hut smells of salt and herbs.

**Speaking Style:** Gentle, patient and kind, a healer's voice that soothes before it explains.
**Combat Role:** none; a healer, though her water could stop a fight
**Relationship Hook:** An old healer kneeling by a pool with water glowing in her hands, teaching a line of girls.
personality: Core: gentle, patient and skilled; teaches the girls of the city; keeps the North's customs
Quirk: remembers old friends

npcs.name: Yeh-Lu
npcs.info:
The explosives specialist of the Rough Rhinos, who rides with a satchel of bombs and a lit fuse and throws them at walls, gates and anyone in the way. He giggles at every explosion and is the most cheerful man in the unit. Mongke relies on him for any wall that will not burn. His rhino has learned not to flinch at explosions. He rides at the back, for everyone's safety.

**Speaking Style:** Giggling, quick and gleeful, an explosives man who loves the sound of a fuse.
**Combat Role:** thrown bombs and blasting charges from a charging rhino
**Relationship Hook:** A rider on a rhino giggling as he lights a fuse.
personality: Core: gleeful, reckless and cheerful; giggles at explosions; rides with a lit fuse
Quirk: hides his scarred hand

npcs.name: Ying
npcs.info:
Than's wife, heavily pregnant, travelling to Ba Sing Se with him and his sister after the Fire Nation took their home. She is cheerful in spite of everything, believes the baby will be born safe in the city, and keeps everyone else calm. She talks to her unborn child as she walks. She has chosen a name for the baby and will not tell anyone until it is born. Other refugees at the bay bring her food and blankets.

**Speaking Style:** Soft, hopeful and brave, a mother-to-be who speaks about her baby as if it were already born.
**Combat Role:** none; a mother-to-be
**Relationship Hook:** A pregnant refugee in the camp at Full Moon Bay, telling her baby they are nearly there.
personality: Core: cheerful, brave and hopeful; talks to her unborn child; keeps everyone calm
Quirk: hides how close the birth is

npcs.name: Yon Rha
npcs.info:
A retired officer of the Fire Navy who lives quietly in a small Fire Nation village with his elderly mother, gardening and shopping for her, nervous and unremarkable. Once he commanded the Southern Raiders, the fleet that raided the Southern Water Tribe to take its waterbenders. He retired two years after his last raid and has tried to forget it. The village knows him as a fussy old man devoted to his mother, and nothing more. He jumps at loud noises.

**Speaking Style:** Whining, cowardly and quick, an old man who bargains for his life.
**Combat Role:** firebending of a retired raider, weak now
**Relationship Hook:** An ordinary old man in a village market buying vegetables for his mother.
personality: Core: cowardly, petty and nervous; fusses over his mother; bargains when threatened
Quirk: remembers nothing he does not want to

npcs.name: Yue
npcs.info:
The princess of the Northern Water Tribe, sixteen, the daughter of Chief Arnook, with white hair she has had since birth. She was born still and the Moon Spirit gave her life, and her hair is the sign of it. She is gentle, dutiful and kind, betrothed by custom to a young warrior she does not love, and she does what her people need of her even when it hurts.

**Speaking Style:** Soft, gentle and calm, a princess's voice that holds firm when she has decided something.
**Combat Role:** none; she does not bend, and her strength is her choice
**Relationship Hook:** A princess with white hair at the edge of the Spirit Oasis, watching the koi circle.
personality: Core: gentle, dutiful and brave; puts her people before herself; visits the Spirit Oasis to pray
Quirk: smiles at jokes she should not

npcs.name: Zhang Leader
npcs.info:
The chief of the Zhang, a tribe of refugees fleeing the Fire Nation towards Ba Sing Se, as unkempt and relaxed as her people. Her camp is messy, loud and generous, and she cannot stand prim people. She holds a centuries-old grudge against the Gan Jin over the arrest of her ancestor Wei Jin, who she says was a hero. Her people eat with their hands and sleep where they drop.

**Speaking Style:** Loud, laid back and scornful, a chief who shouts across a camp and laughs at rules.
**Combat Role:** a crescent sword, swung freely
**Relationship Hook:** A loud chief in a cluttered camp laughing at the tidy tents of her rivals.
personality: Core: unkempt, laid back and scornful; laughs at rules; hates the Gan Jin
Quirk: generous to her own

npcs.name: Zhao
npcs.info:
A commander of the Fire Nation's forces on the Mo Ce coast, ambitious, arrogant and very good at his job, who runs the Pohuai Stronghold and the navy's harbours there. He trained under Jeong Jeong and has the firebending of a master and the patience of none. He despises the banished prince and his old uncle and means to catch the Avatar himself and take the glory. His men fear him more than any enemy.

**Speaking Style:** Confident, arrogant and cutting, a commander's voice that relishes other people's humiliation.
**Combat Role:** firebending of a master, aggressive and showy, wide blasts of flame
**Relationship Hook:** A Fire Nation commander looking down on a banished prince in a harbour.
personality: Core: ambitious, arrogant and cruel; belittles anyone beneath him; collects trophies of his victories
Quirk: will burn anything to win

npcs.name: Zuko
npcs.info:
The banished crown prince of the Fire Nation, sixteen, with a burn scar over his left eye that his father gave him. He may not go home unless he brings back the Avatar, who has not been seen for a hundred years. He hunts with one old ship, a small crew and his uncle, docking at the Fire Navy's harbours for coal and repairs where officers sneer at the exile. He is proud, short-tempered and driven, and he trains every day as if honour could be earned by sweat.

**Speaking Style:** Hoarse, tense and loud, every sentence pushed out through his teeth; when he is unsure the anger goes and he sounds like a lost teenager.
**Combat Role:** firebending, aggressive and close, fuelled by anger at first and later by breath; dual dao swords as the Blue Spirit
**Relationship Hook:** A scarred young prince on a Fire Navy pier, shouting at his uncle about the Avatar.
personality: Core: driven, proud and angry, hiding a good heart; cannot let an insult pass; trains alone until his hands shake
Quirk: listens to his uncle only after ignoring him

locations.name: Abbey
locations.info:
[Safe Haven · Recommended Level: 3-12 · No hostile spawns · Downtime protected]

An abbey over four hundred years old near the Mo Ce Sea's shore, high walls and a large courtyard, where nuns make perfume and claim neutral ground in the war, which the war does not always respect. A traveller is given water and a bed and asked to leave their fight outside.

areas.name: Perfume Courtyard
areas.text: The walled courtyard and its perfume stills.

locations.name: Agna Qel'a
locations.info:
[Town Core · Recommended Level: 12-30 · Danger: Severe · No major hostile encounters within the settlement itself; surrounding ground remains dangerous]

The capital of the Northern Water Tribe at the top of the world, a city built almost entirely of ice on the shore of the Northern Sea, tiered and carved, with canals for streets and a great wall facing the sea. Chief Arnook rules from the Northern Water Tribe Royal Palace; Master Pakku teaches waterbending to the men and the healers teach the women. The city has never fallen. A traveller sees first the sea wall opening, then the whole city rising in ice behind it.

areas.name: Ice Palace
areas.text: The Northern Water Tribe Royal Palace at the city's top, Chief Arnook's hall and the feast given for guests.

areas.name: Sea Gate
areas.text:
The opening in the sea wall where the waterbenders raise the ice to let a boat in, and the harbour steps where passage is booked with the harbour master.

The roads, ferries and cutters serves this yard: ferries sail to Northern Air Temple (about 36 Pieces), River village (about 40 Pieces); ask at the yard or the pier, pay the fare, and the days of the road pass.

areas.name: The Canals
areas.text: The ice canals that are the city's streets, boats poled along them under carved bridges.

areas.name: Training Grounds
areas.text: The ice fields where Master Pakku drills his students and refuses the women.

locations.name: Agrarian Zone
locations.info:
[Recommended Level: 6-24 · Danger: High]

The farmland between the Outer Wall and the Inner Wall, fields and villages that feed the city, with Lake Laogai in the middle and the monorail crossing it on its piers. A traveller rides across it for an hour and sees no war.

areas.name: The Fields
areas.text: The farms under the monorail.

locations.name: Ash Market
locations.info:
[Recommended Level: 12-24 · Danger: High]

The capital's common market on the lower crater floor, under red awnings grey with ash: fire flakes, komodo sausage, cloth, charms, the war news on a board, and the Domestic Forces strolling through it. A traveller buys what they need here and learns the price of being overheard.

areas.name: Ash Stalls
areas.text: Food, cloth and charms under the awnings, the sellers shouting prices.

areas.name: News Board
areas.text: The board where the Fire Lord's news is posted and read aloud to those who cannot read.

locations.name: Ba Sing Se Prison
locations.info:
[Recommended Level: 12-30 · Danger: Severe]

A maximum-security jail of solid metal on the grounds of the Earth Kingdom Royal Palace, built so no earthbender can escape and used mostly for political dissidents. A traveller sent here has crossed Long Feng.

areas.name: Metal Cells
areas.text: The cells of solid metal.

locations.name: Ba Sing Se University
locations.info:
[Recommended Level: 6-24 · Danger: High]

The greatest university in the world by its own account, in the grove district of the Middle Ring, educating scholars from across the Earth Kingdom and exchange students from the other nations. A traveller with a question finds a professor with an expedition in mind.

areas.name: Map Room
areas.text: The room of maps and expeditions.

areas.name: The Grove
areas.text: The campus and its trees.

locations.name: Ba Sing Se Zoo
locations.info:
[Recommended Level: 6-18 · Danger: Moderate]

The city's zoo, in the Lower Ring until the spring of 100 AG and in the Agrarian Zone after, with a keeper who cannot feed his animals and animals who show it. A traveller pays a copper to see a sad rabaroo.

areas.name: The Cages
areas.text: The cages, and later the open zoo.

locations.name: Beach cave
locations.info:
[Recommended Level: 6-14 · Danger: Moderate]

A system of caverns under an island in the eastern Fire Nation, near the Fire Nation school, with a sandy floor and room for a crowd. A traveller finds it from the beach and can hide a sky bison in it.

areas.name: The Great Cave
areas.text: The main cavern, big enough for a bison and a dance.

locations.name: Beetle-Head Caravanserai
locations.info:
[Recommended Level: 9-21 · Danger: High]

A walled rest house on the caravan trail between the oasis and the eastern plains, kept by the beetle-headed merchants, where their giant rhinoceros beetles are stabled and their goods are sold at desert prices. A traveller pays for water and sleeps behind a wall.

areas.name: Beetle Yard
areas.text: The beetle yard and the merchants' stalls.

locations.name: Black Cliffs
locations.info:
[Recommended Level: 8-20 · Danger: High]

A line of black coastal cliffs and stacks off an uninhabited inner island of the Fire Nation, forming a natural hidden bay where a fleet can anchor unseen. A traveller finds it only by knowing it is there.

areas.name: Hidden Anchorage
areas.text: The hidden anchorage behind the stacks.

locations.name: Boiling Rock
locations.info:
[Recommended Level: 12-24 · Danger: High]

The Fire Nation's maximum-security prison, on a volcanic island in the middle of a boiling lake inside a crater, reached only by a gondola over the steam. The most dangerous prisoners, domestic and foreign, are sent here, and nobody has escaped. A traveller arrives in chains or as a guard.

areas.name: Prison Yard
areas.text: The prison yard where the inmates take the air under the towers.

areas.name: The Coolers
areas.text: The cold cells where firebenders are kept from their bending.

areas.name: The Gondola
areas.text: The cable car over the boiling lake, the only way in or out.

locations.name: Canal Market
locations.info:
[Recommended Level: 12-24 · Danger: High]

The market along the main canal of Agna Qel'a, boats and stalls selling furs, fish, carvings and the goods of a city that trades with nobody but itself. A traveller buys warm clothes and is stared at.

areas.name: Canal Stalls
areas.text: The stalls along the canal.

locations.name: Capital City Prison
locations.info:
[Recommended Level: 14-30 · Danger: Severe]

A large fortified stone tower inside the crater, where the Fire Nation keeps the prisoners it cares most about: traitors, war captives of rank, enemies of the Fire Lord. The doors are iron and the guards do not talk. A traveller sees the tower from the plaza road and does not go closer unless sent.

areas.name: Cells
areas.text: The tower's cells, stone, chain and one barred window each.

locations.name: Capital Drill Ground
locations.info:
[Recommended Level: 12-26 · Danger: High]

The Fire Army's drill field on the crater floor, where recruits learn the forms, the rhinos are stabled and the regiments assemble before they ship out. The sergeants' voices carry to the plaza. A traveller sees the ranks from the road and understands how the war has lasted a hundred years.

areas.name: Parade Square
areas.text: The square where the ranks form and the sergeants shout.

areas.name: Rhino Pens
areas.text: The komodo rhinos' stables, the smell and the noise.

locations.name: Cave of Two Lovers
locations.info:
[Recommended Level: 6-18 · Danger: Moderate]

A series of caverns under the Kolau Mountain Range near Omashu, the secret tunnel of the song, said to be the birthplace of earthbending and a labyrinth that changes. Travellers who cannot cross the mountains, which the Fire Nation holds, go through it instead. A traveller follows the nomads' song or gets lost.

areas.name: The Labyrinth
areas.text: The shifting caverns and the badgermoles that shift them.

areas.name: Tunnel Mouth
areas.text: The entrance under the carved lovers.

locations.name: Chameleon Bay
locations.info:
[Recommended Level: 9-21 · Danger: High]

A small inlet near the northern waters of the Eastern Sea in the north-eastern Earth Kingdom, the mouth of a river that runs to the outskirts of Ba Sing Se, where the Southern Water Tribe's men under Hakoda hold the water against the Fire Navy. A traveller finds the cutters by finding the men first.

areas.name: Bay Mouth
areas.text: The bay and its river mouth.

locations.name: Chin Village
locations.info:
[Recommended Level: 3-12 · Danger: Moderate]

A medium-sized town on the cliffs of the Earth Kingdom's south-western coast, host to the Avatar Day festival, which until 100 AG was held to curse the Avatar for Kyoshi's killing of Chin, its conqueror. The town has a court, a prison and strong opinions. A traveller who is an Avatar should not say so.

areas.name: Cliff Court
areas.text: The open court where the mayor judges by the old laws.

areas.name: Cliff Stair
areas.text: The steps down the cliff to the fishing boats.

areas.name: Festival Square
areas.text: The square with Chin's statue and the Avatar's effigy.

locations.name: Chin Village prison
locations.info:
[Recommended Level: 3-12 · Danger: Moderate]

The town's detention house, where the accused wait for trial under the old laws of Chin Village. A traveller locked here can hear the festival and the sea.

areas.name: The Cell
areas.text: The one cell and the jailer's stool.

locations.name: Coast Road Waystation
locations.info:
[Recommended Level: 3-9 · Danger: Low]

An inn and stable on the coast road between Chin Village and Gaoling, where the coaches change ostrich horses and the carters eat. A traveller hears every rumour of the south coast here for the price of a bowl.

areas.name: Common Room
areas.text: The inn's room and its gossip.

locations.name: Crater Rim Batteries
locations.info:
[Recommended Level: 16-30 · Danger: Severe]

The ring of batteries and watch posts along the crater's rim above the city: catapults, signal fires and the soldiers who man them, with a view of the whole approach from the Great Gates of Azulon. Nobody comes here without a uniform. A traveller sees the smoke of the watch fires from the harbour.

areas.name: Signal Post
areas.text: A watch post on the rim with its fire, its horn and its two bored soldiers.

locations.name: Crescent Island
locations.info:
[Recommended Level: 8-24 · Danger: High]

A volcanic isle shaped like a crescent in the eastern Fire Nation, with the Fire Sages' temple on its crag and a shrine to Avatar Roku inside it. The volcano is not dead. A traveller lands on black sand and climbs.

areas.name: Black Shore
areas.text: The landing on the crescent's inner shore.

locations.name: Crescent Island Fire Temple
locations.info:
[Recommended Level: 10-24 · Danger: High]

The Fire Sages' five-tiered pagoda on the crag of Crescent Island, kept for Avatar Roku, who studied the Avatar State here. Its doors open only to firebending, five blasts at once, and its sanctuary holds Roku's statue. A traveller is met by sages who serve the Fire Lord.

areas.name: The Sanctuary
areas.text: The sealed hall with Roku's statue and the window where the solstice light falls.

locations.name: Drill Site
locations.info:
[Recommended Level: 12-30 · Danger: Severe]

The ground outside the Outer Wall where the Fire Nation drill came across the plain in the spring of 100 AG with Azula and the war minister Qin aboard, and where it stopped. A traveller sees the wreck from the wall.

areas.name: The Wreck
areas.text: The dead drill under the wall.

locations.name: Drowned Road
locations.district: The Lakes and the Serpent's Pass
locations.info:
[Recommended Level: 12-24 · Danger: High]

The gap in the middle of the Serpent's Pass where the rock dips under the lake and the path is drowned, crossed by waterbending a tunnel or by swimming and praying. A traveller without a bender turns back here.

areas.name: Drowned Gap
areas.text: The drowned road.

locations.name: Earth Kingdom Royal Palace
locations.info:
[Recommended Level: 12-30 · Danger: Severe]

The home of the Earth King and the seat of the Earth Kingdom's government, at the centre of the Upper Ring, of a scale unlike anything else in the world. The king sits on his throne and has never left the palace; Long Feng speaks for him. A traveller is received by the Dai Li first.

areas.name: Earth Throne
areas.text: The long hall to the Earth King and his bear.

areas.name: Palace Grounds
