items.name: Scout's Zip Line Glove
items.info: A leather glove for the hideout's lines.

items.name: Se Tu Fish
items.info: A big green river fish with whiskers under its eyes and blue stripes down its flanks, caught in the south and west where it leaps out of the water as if to taunt the angler. Grilled whole it feeds a family and restores a little strength. 3 Pieces, sold at any Earth Kingdom market.

items.name: Sea Prune Stew
items.info: A pot of dark sea prunes stewed soft, the dish every southern grandmother serves and every southern child pretends to like. It warms a cold body and eases hunger. 2 Pieces, sold at any Water Tribe village.

items.name: Seal Jerky
items.info: Tough strips of seal meat smoked and dried by hunters and carried in a pouch on long trips over the ice. A handful holds off hunger for half a day. 2 Pieces, sold at any Water Tribe village.

items.name: Seal Pelt
items.info: A tanned pelt from a seal of the polar bays. Tribe tailors line parkas, mittens and boots with it. 6 Pieces, sold at any Water Tribe village.

items.name: Senior Agent's Lamp
items.info: A small oil lamp of the kind that circles in the dark.
items.where: Dai Li Senior Agent, Dai Li

items.name: Senior Joo Dee's Itinerary Scroll
items.info: A scroll of a guest's permitted hours.

items.name: Sergeant's Shoulder Flame
items.info: A red flame badge sewn to the shoulder of a sergeant's armour.

items.name: Si Wong Desert Robes
items.info: Several layers of loose tan cloth in the sandbender style, worn against the sun that burns the desert's people. They keep a traveller cooler than bare skin would. 14 Pieces, sold at Beetle-Head Caravanserai.

items.name: Sky Bison Fur
items.info: Tufts of thick white fur shed by flying bison and still caught in the temple's old stables. Warmer and softer than any wool, it spins into cloth fit for a monk or a lord. Found, never sold: Eastern Air Temple.

items.name: Smoked Elephant Koi
items.info: Thick slabs of the giant bright-scaled koi that is Kyoshi Island's chief export, smoked over the island's fires. Rich and oily, one slab is a full meal and keeps a traveller fed and warm through a cold day at sea. 4 Pieces, sold at Kyoshi Island.

items.name: Snow Sled
items.info: A light sled of bone runners and hide lashings for hauling gear over the ice, or for riding downhill when no one is watching. 5 Pieces, sold at any Water Tribe village.

items.name: Society Poet's Brush
items.info: A brush of the society's pattern.

items.name: Southern Raider Helm
items.info: A black helm with a red eye shield that sweeps back into spikes like wings, worn only by the Southern Raiders. The villagers kept the ones knocked off raiders' heads; wearing one in the South invites a spear. Found, never sold: Old Southern Harbour.

items.name: Southern Tribesman's Fur Hood
items.info: A fur hood of the South's pattern.

items.name: Spark Rocks
items.info: A pair of jagged green stones mined from two facing cliffs south of Ba Sing Se, where legend says benders once fought so fiercely the ground drank their power. Struck together they throw sparks to light a fire; every household has a set. 1 Pieces, sold at any Earth Kingdom market.

items.name: Speaker's Carved Cup
items.info: A carved cup the tribe's speaker drinks from.

items.name: Spiked Skull Armor
items.info: A vintage full suit hung with hooks, chains, blades and skull faces, on display at the big weapons shop. It stops almost anything and is so heavy that a wearer falls over trying to fight in it. 90 Pieces, sold at Shu Jing.

items.name: Spring Trap
items.info: A spring-loaded iron snare that locks on whatever steps in and hoists it into the branches; only someone outside can open it. Hunters bait it with berries and hide it under leaves. 8 Pieces, sold at any Fire Nation market.

items.name: Spring-Loaded Stilettos
items.info: Wrist holsters that fire small, arrow-like darts with a flick of the hand. They pin a sleeve to a wall, punch through wood and leave ice whole, and they hide well under a noble's robe. 38 Pieces, sold at Fire Nation bazaar.

items.name: Spyglass
items.info: A brass tube of ground lenses that pulls distant ships and riders close. Navy officers carry them; anyone else with one is assumed to be watching something. 25 Pieces, sold at any port.

items.name: Squad Leader's Stone
items.info: A smooth stone cut with the platoon's mark.

items.name: Staff Officer's Jade Pin
items.info: A jade pin of five linked rings.

items.name: Star Chart
items.info: A chart of the stars and constellations kept on the spirit library's shelves, with the north star at its centre. Anyone who can read it can find true north by night in a desert or at sea. Found, never sold: Wan Shi Tong's Library.

items.name: Star's Rope Shoes
items.info: A pair of rope walker's shoes.
items.where: Star of the Ring, Fire Nation circus

items.name: Steamed Buns
items.info: Soft white buns stuffed with pork or bean paste, sold from bamboo steamers at every busy crossroad. Two make a quick meal. 1 Pieces, sold at any Earth Kingdom market.

items.name: Steel War Fans
items.info: A pair of steel war fans of the Kyoshi pattern.

items.name: Studded Bracers of Omashu
items.info: Gray studded gauntlets covering the forearm to the knuckles, as worn by the city's earthbending guards. They take a blade and leave the fingers free to shape stone. 16 Pieces, sold at Omashu.

items.name: Studded Kanabo
items.info: A long, heavy club bound with iron and studded in vertical rows. It breaks bones through a shield, and only a strong back swings it twice in a row. 42 Pieces, sold at Shu Jing.

items.name: Sun Keeper's Sun Stone Chip
items.info: A chip of the sun stone's rock.

items.name: Sun Warrior's Gold Sash
items.info: A gold sash of the warriors.

items.name: Sun-and-Moon Blade
items.info: A single hook-sword variant whose two ends are semicircles, one like the sun and one like the moon. Pirates carry it; it traps a blade and opens a guard. 55 Pieces, sold at Seedy merchants pier.

items.name: Sunstone Crystal
items.info: A small, clear red gem of the Fire Nation that gathers sunlight and throws it in a beam. The fire temple on Crescent Island sets one at its summit to light its highest chamber, and the sages keep the few they hold close. Found, never sold: Crescent Island.

items.name: Swamp Bark Shield
items.info: A light shield of lashed wood and bark, made by the swamp folk who fight with spears instead of water. It floats when dropped in the marsh. 8 Pieces, sold at Foggy Swamp Tribe.

items.name: Swamp Elder's Carved Root
items.info: A carved root of the banyan.

items.name: Swamp Tribesman's Leaf Skirt
items.info: A skirt of swamp leaves.

items.name: Swamp Wood Chest Guard
items.info: A breastplate of carved wood lashed together with vine, which is all the armour the swamp folk wear to a fight. 6 Pieces, sold at Foggy Swamp Tribe.

items.name: Tax Farmer's Seal Ring
items.info: A ring that seals a seizure in the governor's name.

items.name: Tent and Bedroll
items.info: A canvas tent, its poles, and a padded bedroll. A night under it in rain or snow is a night of real rest. 8 Pieces, sold at any town market.

items.name: Terra Captain's Green Helm
items.info: The captain's green helm with its crest.

items.name: Terra Team Helm Band
items.info: A band of the platoon's colour for the helm.

items.name: Three-Finger Mittens
items.info: Fur-lined mittens in the Water Tribe cut, with the thumb, two fingers and the last two fingers in separate pockets. A hunter can hold a spear in them on the coldest night. 6 Pieces, sold at any Water Tribe village.

items.name: Throne Guard's Black Pauldron
items.info: A black pauldron with the Fire Lord's flame in gold.

items.name: Throne's Signet
items.info: A signet of the Fire Lord's own flame, given to the one who speaks for the throne.
items.where: Voice of the Throne, Fire Nation Royal Family

items.name: Throwing Knives
items.info: A bandolier of balanced knives and darts.

items.name: Time Candle
items.info: A tall candle with spark powder packed in at marked lines. Each hour after midday it flashes once for every hour gone, so its owner always knows the time. 2 Pieces, sold at Northern Air Temple.

items.name: Tinker's Kit
items.info: Springs, wire, a smoke pot and a grappling line in a leather roll.

items.name: Topknot Ring
items.info: A plain green or gold metal ring that holds an Earth Kingdom topknot in place. The plainer the ring, the humbler the wearer, and it marks a stranger as a local. 2 Pieces, sold at any Earth Kingdom market.

items.name: Tracker's Mongoose Lizard Bridle
items.info: A bridle of the team's mounts.

items.name: Train Attendant's Key
items.info: A brass key of the princess's train.

items.name: Trap Setter's Jelly Pot
items.info: A pot of blasting jelly from a Fire Nation store.

items.name: Traveller's Oilcloth Cloak
items.info: A long brown cloak of oiled cloth with a hood, worn on the roads by refugees and merchants. It keeps off the rain and hides what the wearer carries. 8 Pieces, sold at any Earth Kingdom market.

items.name: Tribal Bracers
items.info: Gray forearm guards painted with a small white circle, laced over the sleeve. Water Tribe warriors catch club blows on them. 12 Pieces, sold at Old Southern Harbour.

items.name: Tribal Greaves
items.info: Gray lower-leg guards with a white circle, strapped over fur boots, the Water Tribe warrior's shin protection. 14 Pieces, sold at Wolf Cove.

items.name: Tribe Elder's Water Skin
items.info: A water skin cut with a tribe's mark.

items.name: Tribe Warrior's Club
items.info: A bone club of the tribe's warriors.

items.name: Tsungi Horn
items.info: A curved, highly polished horn cast in metal, thought to have come from the Fire Nation. Its low voice carries across a ship's deck, and it takes years to play well. 20 Pieces, sold at any Fire Nation market.

items.name: Two-Headed Fish
items.info: A river fish that grew a second head in the factory's sludge, sold beside the ordinary catch. Thrifty buyers say two heads means more fish for the money. Cooked, it feeds as well as any fish, and almost nobody enjoys it. 1 Pieces, sold at Jang Hui.

items.name: Understudy's Script
items.info: A hand-copied script with the understudy's notes.

items.name: University Student's Tablet
items.info: A clay tablet of the university's seal.

items.name: Vine Bender's Cord
items.info: A cord of living vine that does not dry.

items.name: Voice's Seal of Omashu
items.info: The old seal of Omashu, carried by the resistance's voice.
items.where: Voice of the Resistance, Omashu Resistance

items.name: Wall Bender's Blue Sash
items.info: A blue sash of the wall's waterbenders.

items.name: Wall Gate Sergeant's Baton
items.info: A green lacquer baton of the gates.
items.where: Wall Gate Sergeant, Royal Earthbender Guards

items.name: Wall Sergeant's Chalk
items.info: A stick of wall chalk for marking the seams.

items.name: War Leader's Wolf Helm
items.info: A wolf's-head helm of the tribe's leaders.

items.name: Warder's Iron Key
items.info: A heavy iron key that opens one prison's outer door and marks its keeper.

items.name: Warrior's Face Paint
items.info: A pot of the warriors' black and white paint.
items.where: Warrior of the South, Southern Water Tribe

items.name: Watch Sergeant's Baton
items.info: A short black baton with the home guard's flame on the pommel.

items.name: Water Skin
items.info: A light leather pouch worn on the hip. Anyone can drink from it; a waterbender carries it as a weapon, drawing the water out to fight and bending it back in when the fight is done. 3 Pieces, sold at any Water Tribe village.

items.name: Water Tribe Hair Bead
items.info: A blue bead of carved bone or shell threaded into a braid or a warrior's tail of hair. Water Tribe folk wear beads and ties rather than ornaments. 1 Pieces, sold at any Water Tribe village.

items.name: Water Tribe Parka
items.info: A heavy hooded coat lined and trimmed with soft fur, with wave patterns stitched on the outside. Without one, a southerner caught on the ice at night loses fingers. 18 Pieces, sold at any Water Tribe village.

items.name: Water Tribe Wolf Armor
items.info: Navy blue battle gear trimmed with white fur, a waning moon on the chest, and metal plates at the shoulders, forearms and feet. The warriors who wear it charge like a wolf pack; spare sets wait in the village since the men sailed. Found, never sold: Wolf Cove.

items.name: Waterbending Scroll
items.info: An ancient illustrated scroll of waterbending forms, stolen from the northern tribe by pirates who keep it for a rich buyer. A waterbender with no teacher can learn real techniques from it. 300 Pieces, sold at Seedy merchants pier.

items.name: Weighted War Chain
items.info: A heavy iron weight on a long chain with a handle, swung to batter walls and wrap a fleeing enemy. The pattern comes from the Rough Rhinos, and colony smiths copy it. 20 Pieces, sold at Fire Nation colonial village.

items.name: Whale Bone
items.info: Long pale bone from a whale taken by the tribe's hunters. Carvers make club hafts, combs, needles and sled runners of it. 5 Pieces, sold at any Water Tribe village.

items.name: Whale Tooth Comb
items.info: A comb carved from whale tooth and scratched with scrimshaw pictures of the hunt, an old southern craft. Carvers make them in the long winter dark, and they are prized as gifts. 15 Pieces, sold at any Water Tribe village.

items.name: Whale Tooth Pendant
items.info: A polished whale tooth on a sinew cord, worn by southern hunters for luck on the ice. 4 Pieces, sold at any Water Tribe village.

items.name: Whale's Tooth Scimitar
items.info: A whale's tooth lashed to the end of a short wooden stick. It looks crude, but in close quarters it cuts as deep as steel, and warriors of both polar tribes carry it. 22 Pieces, sold at any Water Tribe village.

items.name: Whale-Tooth Machete
items.info: A long, cleaver-like blade with whale teeth set along its dull side. Southern hunters clear brush and butcher seal with it, and the warriors carry it into battle. 16 Pieces, sold at Old Southern Harbour.

items.name: White Lotus Tile
items.info: A tile of the old board game, carved with a white lotus.

items.name: Wolf Jaw Blade
items.info: The sharpened jawbone of an arctic wolf, teeth still in, with a leather-wrapped grip: one edge saws, the other scrapes hides. Pressed to ice or earth, it hums with distant footsteps. 12 Pieces, sold at any Water Tribe village.

items.name: Yuyan Archer's Leathers
items.info: A short jacket and loose trousers in Fire Nation red and black, fitted for silent crouching and a full draw. The Yuyan Archers keep them in the stronghold's stores. Found, never sold: Pohuai Stronghold.

items.name: Yuyan Arrow
items.info: An arrow of the Yuyan pattern, red-fletched, given at the first oath.

items.name: Yuyan Captain's Bow Case
items.info: A lacquered bow case with the company's mark.

items.name: Yuyan Composite Bow
items.info: A short composite bow of laminated horn and wood of the pattern the Yuyan Archers draw. It is accurate enough to pin a man by his sleeve at a long distance, and the stronghold never sells one. Found, never sold: Pohuai Stronghold.

items.name: Yuyan Master's Fletching
items.info: A set of red and black fletchings only a master may use.

items.name: Zhang Rough Cloth
items.info: A patched cloth of the tribe's pattern.

abilities.name: A Word to the Secretariat
abilities.info:
You can make an official problem disappear, once. Greatly improves the next intrigue action to quash an arrest or an order.
[Skill: intrigue 24]

abilities.name: Acolyte's Flame Rite
abilities.info:
The rite that lights and holds a temple's flame. Greatly improves the next firebending action to light, hold or shape a ceremonial fire.
[Trait: Fire Sages: Temple Acolyte]

abilities.name: Admiral's Command
abilities.info:
The fleet moves at your word. Greatly improves the next action to command, position or commit Fire Navy ships.
[Trait: Fire Navy: Admiral]

abilities.name: Agent Spotter
abilities.info:
You see the green robes before they see you. Greatly improves the next streetwise action to spot or evade secret police.
[Skill: streetwise 18]

abilities.name: Agent Under the Wall
abilities.info:
You know the agents' ways under the rings. Greatly improves the next stealth action inside Ba Sing Se.

traits.name: Barred
traits.info: The wanted notices carry your description. The ferries, the coaches and every respectable door are closed to you.

traits.name: Bloodbender
traits.info:
You found the water in living things, and under the full moon you can move a body like a puppet. Hama invented it in a prison and every people calls it a crime.

Gives: Chi +1; Waterbending +1; unlocks as you train: Draw from the Living (Waterbending 6), Puppet's Twitch (Waterbending 12), Bloodbending (Waterbending 18), The Puppetmaster's Lesson (Waterbending 18, with Southern Water Tribe Born), Bending Without the Moon (Waterbending 24).
Pairs well with: Southern Water Tribe Born, Colony Born. The South's stolen benders and the prisons they came from.

Primary Attribute: Chi

traits.name: Born of Air
traits.info:
You were born to the Air Nomads, or what is left of them, and air came to you first.

Gives: Airbending +2; unlocks as you train: First Element Air (Airbending 6), Light as a Leaf (Airbending 12), Monk's Freedom (Airbending 18), Yangchen's Stillness (Airbending 24).
Pairs well with: Air Temple Born, Kyoshi Island Born. The cartoon's own Avatar's art.

Primary Attribute: Chi

traits.name: Born of Earth
traits.info:
You were born to the Earth Kingdom, and earth came to you first.

Gives: Earthbending +2; unlocks as you train: First Element Earth (Earthbending 6), Stubborn Stance (Earthbending 12), Mountain's Patience (Earthbending 18), Kyoshi's Strength (Earthbending 24).
Pairs well with: Kyoshi Island Born, Kolau Born. Kyoshi's own birth art.

Primary Attribute: Chi

traits.name: Born of Fire
traits.info:
You were born to the Fire Nation, and fire came to you first.

Gives: Firebending +2; unlocks as you train: First Element Fire (Firebending 6), Sun's Breath (Firebending 12), Roku's Restraint (Firebending 18), Volcano's Heart (Firebending 24).
Pairs well with: Capital Island Born, Outer Islands Born. Roku's birth art.

Primary Attribute: Chi

traits.name: Born of Water
traits.info:
You were born to the Water Tribes, and water came to you first.

Gives: Waterbending +2; unlocks as you train: First Element Water (Waterbending 6), Tide in the Blood (Waterbending 12), Moon's Favour (Waterbending 18), Ocean's Ally (Waterbending 24).
Pairs well with: Southern Water Tribe Born, Northern Water Tribe Born. The Avatar after an air cycle.

Primary Attribute: Chi

traits.name: Breath of Fire
traits.info:
You fight from the breath: fire from the mouth, heat held in the body against cold, flames that never gutter.

Gives: Chi +1; Firebending +1; unlocks as you train: Stoker's Breath (Firebending 6, with Outer Islands Born), Warm Breath (Firebending 6), Fire Gout (Firebending 12), Dragon's Roar (Firebending 18), Breath Like a Furnace (Firebending 24).
Pairs well with: Outer Islands Born, Northern Mountains Born. Cold places a firebender must survive.

Primary Attribute: Chi

traits.name: Capital Island Born
traits.info:
You grew up in the crater city of the Fire Nation Capital, where the Fire Lord's banners hang on every avenue and a child learns the war's victories before their letters.

Gives: Wit +1; Intrigue +1, Lore +1; unlocks as you train: Agni Kai Courtesy (Resolve 6, with Agni Kai Veteran), Court Manners (Intrigue 6), Blue Spirit Dao (Swordsmanship 12, with Sword School), Circus Acrobat Strike (Chi Blocking 12, with Chi-Blocker), Palace Rumour (Intrigue 12), Royal Tutor's Lesson (Firebending 12, with Lightning Redirection), Sleeve Knives (Thrown Weapons 12, with Thrown Blades), Yuyan Pin Shot (Archery 12, with Yuyan Eye), Patron's Favour (Intrigue 18), Royal Lightning (Firebending 18, with Lightning Generation), The Fire Lord's Ear (Intrigue 24).
Pairs well with: Firebender, Noble's Page. A courtier's upbringing.

Primary Attribute: Wit

traits.name: Chaos at the Comet
traits.info:
Sozin's Comet burns so bright that it splits the Avatar spirit. When it passes, you are one of many Avatars, and the Fire Lord knows it.

Gives: no bonus at creation; what it does comes in the story.
Pairs well with: Firebender, Colony Born. The comet's fire turned against its makers.

traits.name: Chaos at the Eclipse
traits.info:
When the sun goes dark the Avatar spirit goes dark with it, and wakes again in many people at once, you among them.

Gives: no bonus at creation; what it does comes in the story.
Pairs well with: Waterbender, Lower Ring Born. The day the Fire Nation is helpless.

traits.name: Chaos at the Solstice
traits.info:
At the next solstice the line between the worlds thins too far, and the Avatar spirit breaks into pieces. One of them lands on you.

Gives: no bonus at creation; what it does comes in the story.
Pairs well with: Airbender, Air Temple Born. The spirits come closest at the solstice.

traits.name: Chi-Blocker
traits.info:
You strike the chi paths: quick jabs that numb a limb and shut a bender's art off. Ty Lee learned it in the circus; the Kyoshi Warriors learned it from her.

Gives: Body +1; Chi Blocking +1; unlocks as you train: Numb the Arm (Chi Blocking 6), Block the Bending (Chi Blocking 12), Circus Acrobat Strike (Chi Blocking 12, with Capital Island Born), Drop to the Ground (Chi Blocking 18), Ty Lee's Sequence (Chi Blocking 24).
Pairs well with: Kyoshi Island Born, Capital Island Born. Taught by a princess's friend, then by the warriors.

Primary Attribute: Body

traits.name: Club and Boomerang
traits.info:
You fight as the Water Tribe's warriors do: a bone club up close and a boomerang that comes back.

Gives: Thrown Weapons +1, Polearms +1; technique Club and Boomerang Opening (The first move your training gives you. Greatly improves the next thrown weapons action with a boomerang that comes back); unlocks as you train: Boomerang Returns (Thrown Weapons 6, with Southern Water Tribe Born), Boomerang Throw (Thrown Weapons 6), Club Swing (Thrown Weapons 12), Behind the Target (Thrown Weapons 18), Boomerang! (Thrown Weapons 24); starts with Bone Club and Boomerang (damage +1 while equipped).
Pairs well with: Southern Water Tribe Born, Nonbender. A warrior of the South.

Primary Attribute: Wit

traits.name: Colony Born
traits.info:
You were born in the Fire Nation colonies on the continent, Fire Nation by blood and Earth Kingdom by every street you ran down, trusted fully by neither.

Gives: Wit +1; Streetwise +1, Deception +1; unlocks as you train: Two Tongues (Streetwise 6), Borrowed Flame (Firebending 12, with Flame Redirection), Garrison Habits (Streetwise 12), Two Flags (Deception 12, with Deserter), Festival Crowd (Streetwise 18), Both Sides Owe You (Streetwise 24).
Pairs well with: Firebender, Earthbender. Two peoples in one street.

Primary Attribute: Wit

traits.name: Combustionbender
traits.info:
A third eye was tattooed on your forehead and the fire answers it: you can blast from the mind, an explosion where you look. Combustion Man was the only one anyone knew.

Gives: Chi +1; Firebending +2; unlocks as you train: Spark of the Eye (Firebending 6), Long Shot (Firebending 12), Wall Breaker (Firebending 18), Combustion Barrage (Firebending 24).
Pairs well with: Capital Island Born, Colony Born. Where a hired weapon is made.

Primary Attribute: Chi

traits.info:
You were trained by the Dai Li beneath Ba Sing Se: the stone gloves, the rooftops, the silence, and lessons in obedience you are still unlearning.

Gives: Wit +1; Stealth +1, Intrigue +1; unlocks as you train: Silent Step (Stealth 6), Agent Under the Wall (Stealth 12, with Lower Ring Born), Rock Glove Snare (Earthbending 12, with Upper Ring Born), Stone Fist Seizure (Stealth 12), Lake Laogai Way (Stealth 18), Brainwash the Mind (Stealth 24).

traits.name: Deserter
traits.info:
You walked away from an army, and that army has not forgotten. Jeong Jeong did it first and lived.

Gives: Wit +1; Stealth +1, Deception +1; unlocks as you train: Hide the Uniform (Stealth 6), Know the Patrols (Stealth 12), Two Flags (Deception 12, with Colony Born), Old Comrade (Stealth 18), Disappear Completely (Stealth 24).
Pairs well with: Colony Born, Outer Islands Born. The Fire Nation's first deserters.

Primary Attribute: Wit

traits.name: Doubt
traits.info:
You are not sure you deserve to win, or that your side should. It slows your hand when it matters.

Gives: Persuasion +1.
Pairs well with: Firebender, Upper Ring Born. A firebender's drive gutters.

traits.name: Dragon-Taught Fire
traits.info:
Your family descends from the people who first learned fire from the dragons, and the fire in you burns from the breath, not from rage.

Gives: Spirit +1; Firebending +1, Meditation +1; unlocks as you train: Breath of Life (Firebending 6), Dragon's Warmth (Firebending 12, with Outer Islands Born), The Two Dragons' Form (Firebending 12), Colours of Fire (Firebending 18), Flame That Never Dies (Firebending 24).
Pairs well with: Firebender, Outer Islands Born. The dragons' people.

Primary Attribute: Spirit

traits.name: Earth Armour
traits.info:
You pull the ground onto your body: stone plates, gauntlets and a helm that turn blows.

Gives: Body +1; Earthbending +1; unlocks as you train: Rock Gauntlet (Earthbending 6), Earth Rumble Showman (Earthbending 12, with Southern Coast Born), Stone Shell (Earthbending 12), Crystal Armour (Earthbending 18), Walking Mountain (Earthbending 24).
Pairs well with: Kolau Born, Northern Mountains Born. Soldiers of the mountain passes.

Primary Attribute: Body

traits.name: Earth Wave
traits.info:
You make the ground move under people: waves to ride, holes to sink a foe in, a road that carries you.

Gives: Chi +1; Earthbending +1; unlocks as you train: Rolling Ground (Earthbending 6), Village Rally (Earthbending 6, with Western Earth Kingdom Born), Dune Surge (Earthbending 12, with Si Wong Born), Mail Chute Rush (Earthbending 12, with Kolau Born), Trench (Earthbending 12), Rock Slide (Earthbending 18), Split the Earth (Earthbending 24).
Pairs well with: Si Wong Born, Western Earth Kingdom Born. Open country.

Primary Attribute: Chi

traits.name: Earthbender
traits.info:
You bend earth: the rooted stance, the patient wait, then the whole hillside moves. Earthbenders come from every corner of the Earth Kingdom, and the art is as stubborn as its people.

Gives: Chi +2, Body +1; Earthbending +2, Might +1; Chi +10 (maximum and starting); technique Rock Throw (A stone lifted from the ground and thrown in one motion. Greatly improves the next earthbending action to strike at range with stone); technique Earth Wall (A wall raised from the ground between you and the blow. Greatly improves the next earthbending action to block or take cover); unlocks as you train: Feel the Ground (Earthbending 6), Stone Skin (Earthbending 12), Ride the Earth (Earthbending 18), Metalbending (Earthbending 24).
Pairs well with: Kolau Born, Lower Ring Born, Si Wong Born. The kingdom's hard country.

Primary Attribute: Chi

You fight with what you built: a spring trap, a smoke pot, a grappling line.

Greatly improves the next engineering action to spring a device in a fight); unlocks as you train: Field Repair (Engineering 6), Trap Mechanism (Engineering 12), Siege Engine (Engineering 18), Machine Saboteur (Engineering 24); starts with Tinker's Kit.
Pairs well with: Mechanist, Mechanist's Apprentice. The workshop goes to war.

Primary Attribute: Wit

traits.name: Era: After the Comet
traits.info:
The war is over. Everyone who fought it now has to live beside everyone they fought.

Gives: no bonus at creation; what it does comes in the story.
Pairs well with: Nonbender, Colony Born. The peace has to be built.

traits.name: Era: Before the Iceberg
traits.info:
The war is ninety-five years old and the world has stopped expecting it to end. The Air Nomads are a memory, the Avatar is lost, and the Fire Nation pushes a little further every year.

Gives: no bonus at creation; what it does comes in the story.
Pairs well with: Nonbender, Lower Ring Born. Refugees on every road and no Avatar coming.

traits.name: Era: Book One, Water
traits.info:
The winter the Avatar came back. Word runs from village to village, and the Fire Navy turns north.

Gives: no bonus at creation; what it does comes in the story.
Pairs well with: Waterbender, Southern Water Tribe Born. The year opens on the southern ice.

traits.name: Era: Book Three, Fire
traits.info:
The last summer of the war. Ba Sing Se has fallen, the Avatar is thought dead, and the comet is coming.

Gives: no bonus at creation; what it does comes in the story.
Pairs well with: Firebender, Capital Island Born. The war comes home to the Fire Nation.

traits.name: Era: Book Two, Earth
traits.info:
The spring and summer the war came to the Earth Kingdom's heart. Omashu has fallen, refugees crowd the roads to the capital, and the princess is hunting.

Gives: no bonus at creation; what it does comes in the story.
Pairs well with: Earthbender, Lower Ring Born. Ba Sing Se's year.

traits.name: Farmhand
traits.info:
You worked fields and animals from dawn to dusk.

Gives: Might +1, Riding +1; technique Farmhand Habit (A habit from the life before. Greatly improves the next action to handle livestock or heavy labour).
Pairs well with: Southern Coast Born, Kolau Born. The plains' farms.

Primary Attribute: Body

traits.name: Firebender
traits.info:
You bend fire: the only art that makes its own element, from breath and drive. Firebenders are the pride of the Fire Nation and its war, and the art burns as hot as the bender's temper.

Gives: Chi +2, Body +1; Firebending +2, Resolve +1; Chi +10 (maximum and starting); technique Fire Blast (A punch or a kick that leaves as flame. Greatly improves the next firebending action to strike at range); technique Fire Whip (A sustained line of flame swung like a rope. Greatly improves the next firebending action to strike several foes or hold them back); unlocks as you train: Hot Breath (Firebending 6), Turn the Flame (Firebending 12), Take the Lightning (Firebending 18), Fire at Noon (Firebending 24).
Pairs well with: Capital Island Born, Outer Islands Born, Colony Born. The Fire Nation's own.

Primary Attribute: Chi

traits.name: Fisher
traits.info:
You worked the boats and the nets before the story found you.

Gives: Sailing +1, Wildcraft +1; technique Fisher Habit (A habit from the life before. Greatly improves the next action to read the weather or the sea).
Pairs well with: Southern Water Tribe Born, Kyoshi Island Born. Lives on the water.

Primary Attribute: Spirit

traits.name: Foggy Swamp Born
traits.info:
You grew up in the Foggy Swamp among its tribe, where the swamp is one tree, the fog shows visions and possum chicken is a fine dinner.

Gives: Spirit +1; Wildcraft +1, Spirit Sense +1; unlocks as you train: Fog Walker (Spirit Sense 6), Swamp Skimmer (Waterbending 12, with Tidecraft), Swamp Visions (Spirit Sense 12), One Big Tree (Spirit Sense 18), Swamp Colossus (Waterbending 18, with Plantbender), Banyan Root (Spirit Sense 24).

traits.name: Good with Children
traits.info:
Children trust you, and you them.

Gives: Spirit +1; Persuasion +1.
Pairs well with: Refugee, Monk's Ward. The war's orphans.

traits.name: Grief
traits.info:
You lost someone, and it sits in your centre where the calm should be.

Gives: Spirit +1.
Pairs well with: Airbender, Avatar. The monks' teaching about attachment.

traits.name: Grudge
traits.info:
Someone wronged you and you have not let it go. It steers you whether you mean it to or not.

Gives: Resolve +1.
Pairs well with: Southern Water Tribe Born, Colony Born. The war leaves grudges.

traits.name: Gullible
traits.info:
You believe what people tell you, and people have noticed.

Gives: Artistry +1.
Pairs well with: Southern Coast Born, Middle Ring Born. A sheltered upbringing.

traits.name: Healing
traits.info:
You heal with water: it glows in your hands and follows the body's chi paths to close a wound or calm a fever.

Gives: Spirit +1; Waterbending +1; unlocks as you train: Soothing Touch (Waterbending 6), Clean the Wound (Waterbending 12), Healers' Hut Craft (Waterbending 12, with Northern Water Tribe Born), Spirit Water Mending (Waterbending 18), Mend the Chi Paths (Waterbending 24).
Pairs well with: Northern Water Tribe Born, Foggy Swamp Born. Where healers are taught.

Primary Attribute: Spirit

traits.name: Homesick
traits.info:
You left a place you loved, and part of you never stopped walking back.

Gives: Wit +1.
Pairs well with: Southern Water Tribe Born, Air Temple Born. The homes the war took.

traits.name: Ice Forms
traits.info:
You favour water frozen: spikes, walls, prisons and slides of ice made faster than a foe can step back.

Gives: Chi +1; Waterbending +1; unlocks as you train: Ice Darts (Waterbending 6), Igloo Raising (Waterbending 6, with Southern Water Tribe Born), Ice Prison (Waterbending 12), Wall of the North (Waterbending 12, with Northern Water Tribe Born), Frozen Bridge (Waterbending 18), Glacier Wall (Waterbending 24).
Pairs well with: Northern Water Tribe Born, Southern Water Tribe Born. The polar tribes' first art.

Primary Attribute: Chi

traits.name: Iron Stomach
traits.info:
You can eat sea prunes, swamp food and army rations without complaint.

Gives: Body +1; Stamina +1.
Pairs well with: Soldier, Southern Water Tribe Born. Hard rations.

traits.name: Kill on Sight
traits.info: There is a price on your head in every nation. Guards attack on sight and bounty hunters follow you.

traits.name: Kolau Born
traits.info:
You grew up in the mountains of the south-west, in the shadow of Omashu's peak, where earthbending was born and the passes decide who eats.

Gives: Body +1; Athletics +1, Might +1; unlocks as you train: Mountain Goat (Athletics 6), Tunnel Hearing (Earthbending 6, with Seismic Sense), Mail Chute Rush (Earthbending 12, with Earth Wave), Pass Runner (Athletics 12), Chute Rider (Athletics 18), Badgermole Ways (Athletics 24).
Pairs well with: Earthbender, Patient. The mountains' patience.

Primary Attribute: Body

traits.name: Kyoshi Island Born
traits.info:
You grew up on Kyoshi Island, among villages that kept apart from the war and the warriors who keep Kyoshi's name.

Gives: Body +1; Sailing +1, Awareness +1; unlocks as you train: Islander's Suspicion (Awareness 6), Turn Their Force (Unarmed 6, with Unarmed), Kyoshi Warrior Form (Fans 12, with War Fans), Unagi Watch (Awareness 12), Dojo Discipline (Awareness 18), Kyoshi's Watchfulness (Awareness 24).
Pairs well with: Nonbender, Kyoshi Warrior Trained. The island's own warriors.

Primary Attribute: Body

traits.name: Kyoshi Warrior Trained
traits.info:
You trained in the dojo on Kyoshi Island: the fans, the paint, the footwork that uses a foe's strength.

Gives: Body +1; Fans +2; unlocks as you train: Fan Parry (Fans 6), Fan Throw (Fans 12), Warrior Formation (Fans 18), Suki's Lesson (Fans 24).
Pairs well with: Kyoshi Island Born, Nonbender. The island's warriors.

Primary Attribute: Body

traits.name: Light Sleeper
traits.info:
You wake at a footstep.

Gives: Wit +1; Awareness +1.
Pairs well with: Refugee, Soldier. Nights on the road.

traits.name: Lightning Generation
traits.info:
You make lightning: the cold-blooded fire, energy split into yin and yang and released. It needs peace of mind, and a raging bender cannot do it.

Gives: Chi +1; Firebending +1; unlocks as you train: Spark (Firebending 6), Bolt (Firebending 12), Lightning Volley (Firebending 18), Royal Lightning (Firebending 18, with Capital Island Born), Lightning Under the Comet (Firebending 24).
Pairs well with: Capital Island Born, Upper Ring Born. The royal family's art.

Primary Attribute: Chi

traits.name: Lightning Redirection
traits.info:
You learned Iroh's art from the waterbenders: lightning taken in through the fingers, down past the heart, and out through the other hand.

Gives: Spirit +1; Firebending +1; unlocks as you train: Grounded Stance (Firebending 6), Royal Tutor's Lesson (Firebending 12, with Capital Island Born), Through the Stomach (Firebending 12), Send It Back (Firebending 18), Take the Storm (Firebending 24).
Pairs well with: Capital Island Born, Northern Water Tribe Born. An art taken from the water.

Primary Attribute: Spirit

traits.name: Locked Avatar State
traits.info:
The Avatar State is sealed in you behind a blocked chakra; until you open it, the state cannot come. When it does, it is stronger for the wait.

Gives: Spirit +1; Meditation +1, Resolve +1; unlocks as you train: Feel the Lock (Meditation 6), Speak to the Past (Meditation 12), Crack the Lock (Meditation 18), Rock Strikes the Back (Meditation 24).
Pairs well with: Born of Earth, Northern Mountains Born. Pathik's lesson.

Primary Attribute: Spirit

traits.name: Lower Ring Born
traits.info:
You grew up in the Lower Ring of Ba Sing Se, crowded, poor and watched, where the walls keep the war out and keep you in.

Gives: Wit +1; Streetwise +1, Awareness +1; unlocks as you train: Alley Sense (Streetwise 6), Ferry Ticket Hustle (Streetwise 6, with War Orphan), Agent Under the Wall (Stealth 12, with Dai Li Trained), Tea House Talk (Streetwise 12), Agent Spotter (Streetwise 18), Under the Wall (Streetwise 24).
Pairs well with: Earthbender, Nonbender. A city's hard bottom.

Primary Attribute: Wit

traits.name: Map Memory
traits.info:
You never forget a road you have walked.

Gives: Wit +1; Wildcraft +1.
Pairs well with: Smuggler, Si Wong Born. Long journeys.

traits.name: Mastered Avatar State
traits.info:
You can enter the Avatar State at will once the power is there, and you choose what it does.

Gives: Spirit +1; Meditation +1, Resolve +1; unlocks as you train: Open a Chakra (Meditation 6), Enter at Will (Meditation 12), Let Go of Earthly Attachment (Meditation 18), Balance the State (Meditation 24).
Pairs well with: Born of Fire, Capital Island Born. Roku's mastery.

Primary Attribute: Spirit

traits.name: Mechanist
traits.info:
You build: gliders, locks, balloons, a cart that runs by itself. The war runs on people like you.

Gives: Wit +1; Engineering +1; unlocks as you train: Make Do (Engineering 6), Glider Workshop (Engineering 12, with Northern Mountains Born), War Balloon Design (Engineering 12), Submarine Plans (Engineering 18), Invention of the Day (Engineering 24).
Pairs well with: Northern Mountains Born, Colony Born. The temple's workshops and the colonies' factories.

Primary Attribute: Wit

traits.name: Mechanist's Apprentice
traits.info:
You worked in the mechanist's workshop at the Northern Air Temple, among gliders, pipes and the war balloon's first drawings.

Gives: Wit +1; Engineering +1, Tinkering +1; unlocks as you train: Balloon Rigging (Engineering 6, with Northern Mountains Born), Small Repairs (Tinkering 6), Glider Tuning (Tinkering 12), Smoke Bomb (Tinkering 18), Teo's Wings (Tinkering 24).
Pairs well with: Northern Mountains Born, Nonbender. The temple's workshop.

Primary Attribute: Wit

traits.name: Merchant's Child
traits.info:
You grew up behind a counter, learning prices before letters.

Gives: Trade +1, Persuasion +1; technique Merchant's Child Habit (A habit from the life before. Greatly improves the next action to price, haggle or spot a fake).
Pairs well with: Southern Coast Born, Middle Ring Born. Market towns.

Primary Attribute: Wit

traits.name: Metalbender
traits.info:
You found the earth inside metal and can bend it: a cell's door, a tank's plate, a chain. Toph was the first anyone heard of; you found it yourself.

Gives: Chi +1; Earthbending +1; unlocks as you train: Bend the Lock (Earthbending 6), Peel the Plate (Earthbending 12), Cage Breaker (Earthbending 18), Hammer of Iron (Earthbending 24).
Pairs well with: Southern Coast Born, Colony Born. Where the war's metal is.

Primary Attribute: Chi

traits.name: Middle Ring Born
traits.info:
You grew up in the Middle Ring of Ba Sing Se among merchants, scholars and craftsmen, comfortable, educated and taught very carefully what not to ask.

Gives: Wit +1; Lore +1, Trade +1; unlocks as you train: Library Card (Lore 6), Polite Fiction (Lore 12), Guild Connection (Lore 18), The Archive's Back Room (Lore 24).
Pairs well with: Nonbender, Scholar's Copyist. A scholar's city.

Primary Attribute: Wit

traits.name: Monk's Ward
traits.info:
You were raised by monks or nuns, in an abbey or a temple, among chores and stillness.

Gives: Meditation +1, Lore +1; technique Monk's Ward Habit (A habit from the life before. Greatly improves the next action to keep calm or recall a rite).
Pairs well with: Air Temple Born, Western Earth Kingdom Born. The abbey's quiet.

Primary Attribute: Spirit

traits.name: Noble's Page
traits.info:
You served a noble house, carrying messages and learning manners.

Gives: Intrigue +1, Awareness +1; technique Noble's Page Habit (A habit from the life before. Greatly improves the next action to carry a message or read a court).
Pairs well with: Upper Ring Born, Capital Island Born. Great houses on both sides.

Primary Attribute: Wit

traits.name: Nonbender
traits.info:
You bend nothing, and you have stopped being sorry about it. Most people in the four nations cannot bend, and the war has taught them that steel, wits and nerve can beat a bender who forgets them.

Gives: Body +2, Wit +1; Awareness +2, Stamina +1; Health +10 (maximum and starting); technique Read the Stance (You read a bender's form before it lands. Greatly improves the next action to dodge, interrupt or close on a bender); technique Inside the Form (You step inside a bender's reach where their art is clumsy. Greatly improves the next unarmed or weapon action against a bender at close range); unlocks as you train: See It Coming (Awareness 6), Bender's Blind Side (Awareness 12), Break the Form (Awareness 18), The Unbendable (Awareness 24).
Pairs well with: Southern Water Tribe Born, Kyoshi Island Born, Lower Ring Born. Places where nonbenders hold the line.

Primary Attribute: Spirit

traits.name: Northern Mountains Born
traits.info:
You grew up in the Taihua Mountains of the north, cold and high, among villages that keep to themselves and a temple full of steam and gliders.

Gives: Body +1; Athletics +1, Engineering +1; unlocks as you train: Balloon Rigging (Engineering 6, with Mechanist's Apprentice), Thin Air Lungs (Athletics 6), Glider Launch (Athletics 12), Glider Workshop (Engineering 12, with Mechanist), Avalanche Sense (Athletics 18), Summit Watch (Athletics 24).
Pairs well with: Nonbender, Earthbender. High country and new machines.

Primary Attribute: Body

traits.name: Northern Water Tribe Born
traits.info:
You grew up in Agna Qel'a among the Northern Water Tribe, in a city of ice that has never fallen and keeps customs older than the war.

Gives: Spirit +1; Lore +1, Sailing +1; unlocks as you train: Canal Navigator (Lore 6), Healers' Hut Craft (Waterbending 12, with Healing), Oasis Calm (Spirit Sense 12, with Spirit Sense), Tribal Custom (Lore 12), Wall of the North (Waterbending 12, with Ice Forms), Moon Lore (Lore 18), Octopus Form (Waterbending 18, with Tidecraft), Spirit Oasis Keeper (Lore 24).
Pairs well with: Waterbender, Nonbender. The North's traditions.

Primary Attribute: Spirit

You grew up on the Fire Islands far from the capital, among volcanoes, fishing towns and factories, where the war is a son's letter and a ration of rice.

Gives: Body +1; Sailing +1, Stamina +1; unlocks as you train: Island Hopper (Sailing 6), Stoker's Breath (Firebending 6, with Breath of Fire), Dragon's Warmth (Firebending 12, with Dragon-Taught Fire), Piandao's Lesson (Swordsmanship 12, with Sword School), Volcano Weather (Sailing 12), Fishing Town Friends (Sailing 18), Blockade Runner (Sailing 24).

Primary Attribute: Body

traits.name: Patient
traits.info:
You can wait as long as it takes, the earthbender's virtue.

Gives: Spirit +1; Resolve +1.
Pairs well with: Earthbender, Seismic Sense. Neutral jing.

traits.name: Pirate's Deckhand
traits.info:
You crewed a pirate ship and learned the trade from the bottom.

Gives: Sailing +1, Streetwise +1; technique Pirate's Deckhand Habit (A habit from the life before. Greatly improves the next action to fight or climb on a ship).
Pairs well with: Western Earth Kingdom Born, Nonbender. The river village's pirates.

traits.info:
You bend the water inside living plants: vines that grab, roots that walk, a swamp that rises as one body. Huu taught it in the swamp.

Gives: Spirit +1; Waterbending +1, Wildcraft +1; unlocks as you train: Vine Whip (Waterbending 6), Root Snare (Waterbending 12), Swamp Colossus (Waterbending 18, with Foggy Swamp Born), Vine Body (Waterbending 18), Green Wall (Waterbending 24).
Pairs well with: Foggy Swamp Born, Western Earth Kingdom Born. The swamp's own art.

Primary Attribute: Spirit

traits.name: Proud
traits.info:
You will not be seen to bow, ask or lose, even when you should.

Gives: Chi +1.
Pairs well with: Capital Island Born, Northern Water Tribe Born. Honour and face.

traits.name: Quick Learner
traits.info:
You pick up a skill faster than anyone expects.

Gives: Wit +1; Lore +1.
Pairs well with: Scholar's Copyist, Avatar. A teacher's favourite.

traits.name: Rage
traits.info:
Your anger is a fire you have not learned to bank. It makes you strong for a moment and stupid for longer.

Gives: Body +1.
Pairs well with: Firebender, Capital Island Born. Zuko's own trouble.

traits.name: Reckless
traits.info:
You go first, fast and without a plan, and so far it has mostly worked.

Gives: Athletics +1.
Pairs well with: Nonbender, Kyoshi Island Born. Brave and unwise.

traits.name: Reflexive Avatar State
traits.info:
The Avatar State comes to you unbidden: in mortal danger or grief it takes you, and you wake to what it did.

Gives: Spirit +1; Meditation +1, Resolve +1; unlocks as you train: Glowing Warning (Meditation 6), Hold Back the Glow (Meditation 12), Wake Without Harm (Meditation 18), Learn from the Storm (Meditation 24).
Pairs well with: Born of Air, Air Temple Born. The cartoon's own Avatar at the start.

Primary Attribute: Spirit

traits.name: Refugee
traits.info:
You walked the road to Ba Sing Se or somewhere like it, with a bundle and no papers.

Gives: Stamina +1, Streetwise +1; technique Refugee Habit (A habit from the life before. Greatly improves the next action to find food, shelter or a way through a checkpoint).
Pairs well with: Western Earth Kingdom Born, Lower Ring Born. The road north.

Primary Attribute: Wit

You sail the dunes on a sand-sailer and fight from its deck with a pole and a rope.

Gives: Sailing +2; technique Sand-Sailing Opening (The first move your training gives you. Greatly improves the next sailing action to outrun or ram on sand); unlocks as you train: Catch the Wind (Sailing 6), Dune Tack (Sailing 6, with Si Wong Born), Tack Through Dunes (Sailing 12), Sand-Sailer Chase (Sailing 18), Ride the Storm (Sailing 24); starts with Sailer Pole (damage +1 while equipped).

Primary Attribute: Body

traits.name: Sandbender
traits.info:
You bend sand the way the Si Wong tribes do: loose, flowing, a sail's wind, a storm that hides a camp.

Gives: Chi +1; Earthbending +1, Wildcraft +1; unlocks as you train: Sand Lift (Earthbending 6), Sand Funnel (Earthbending 12, with Si Wong Born), Sand Sailer Wind (Earthbending 12), Sand Cloud (Earthbending 18), Sand Sculpture (Earthbending 24).
Pairs well with: Si Wong Born, Sand-Sailing. The desert's art.

Primary Attribute: Chi

traits.name: Scholar's Copyist
traits.info:
You copied scrolls for a scholar and read everything you copied.

Gives: Lore +1, Tinkering +1; technique Scholar's Copyist Habit (A habit from the life before. Greatly improves the next action to read an old script or remember a text).
Pairs well with: Middle Ring Born, Northern Water Tribe Born. Libraries and their keepers.

Primary Attribute: Wit

traits.name: Sea Legs
traits.info:
A deck is as good as ground to you.

Gives: Body +1; Sailing +1.
Pairs well with: Fisher, Pirate's Deckhand. A life aboard.

traits.name: Seismic Sense
traits.info:
You feel the ground with your feet: footsteps, heartbeats in the floor, the hollow under a street. Toph sees this way.

Gives: Spirit +1; Earthbending +1; unlocks as you train: Footstep Count (Earthbending 6), Tunnel Hearing (Earthbending 6, with Kolau Born), Blind Bandit's Trick (Earthbending 12, with Southern Coast Born), Lie in the Pulse (Earthbending 12), Hollow Earth (Earthbending 18), Sense the Whole Field (Earthbending 24).
Pairs well with: Southern Coast Born, Kolau Born. The badgermoles' way.

Primary Attribute: Spirit

traits.name: Shard of Air
traits.info: The chaos woke air in you: the wind follows you, and you can step lighter than you should.

traits.name: Shard of Earth
traits.info: The chaos woke earth in you: the ground hums under your feet and sometimes moves when you are angry.

traits.name: Shard of Fire
traits.info: The chaos woke fire in you: heat gathers in your breath, and it wants out.

traits.name: Shard of the Avatar
traits.info: At the world's turning a piece of the Avatar spirit fell on you, and for now you are one of many Avatars.

traits.name: Shard of Water
traits.info: The chaos woke water in you: it leans toward your hands now, and you do not know how to stop it.

traits.name: Si Wong Born
traits.info:
You grew up in the Si Wong Desert, on a sand-sailer among the tribes, where water is the law and nobody's king reaches.

Gives: Body +1; Wildcraft +1, Stamina +1; unlocks as you train: Dune Tack (Sailing 6, with Sand-Sailing), Water Discipline (Wildcraft 6), Dune Reading (Wildcraft 12), Dune Surge (Earthbending 12, with Earth Wave), Library Seeker (Lore 12, with Spirit Sense), Sand Funnel (Earthbending 12, with Sandbender), Guest Right (Wildcraft 18), Storm Walker (Wildcraft 24).
Pairs well with: Earthbender, Nonbender. The desert's own.

traits.name: Soldier

You served in an army, whichever one, long enough to learn its drill and its fear.

Gives: Command +1, Stamina +1; technique Soldier Habit (A habit from the life before. Greatly improves the next action to follow or give orders under fire).
Pairs well with: Colony Born, Kolau Born. The war's ranks.

Primary Attribute: Spirit

traits.name: Southern Coast Born
traits.info:
You grew up in the towns of the Earth Kingdom's south coast, Gaoling and its like, where the war has not come and the people pretend it never will.

Gives: Wit +1; Trade +1, Persuasion +1; unlocks as you train: Market Eye (Trade 6), Blind Bandit's Trick (Earthbending 12, with Seismic Sense), Earth Rumble Showman (Earthbending 12, with Earth Armour), Tournament Wager (Trade 12), Rich House Gate (Trade 18), Coast Road Credit (Trade 24).

traits.name: Southern Water Tribe Born

You grew up at the South Pole among the Southern Water Tribe, a people the raids stripped of benders and the war of its men, who still keep the village whole.

Gives: Polearms +2; technique Spear and Staff Opening (The first move your training gives you. Greatly improves the next polearms action to hold a foe at reach); unlocks as you train: Glider Staff Strike (Polearms 6, with Air Temple Born), Staff Sweep (Polearms 6), Keep Them Back (Polearms 12), Vault (Polearms 18), Spear Wall (Polearms 24); starts with Long Spear (damage +1 while equipped).

traits.name: Spirit Sense
traits.info:
You feel what others miss: a spirit's mood, a haunted forest, the veil thinning at a solstice. Bending never came; this did.

Gives: Spirit +1; Spirit Sense +1; unlocks as you train: Feel the Spirit (Spirit Sense 6), Library Seeker (Lore 12, with Si Wong Born), Name the Spirit (Spirit Sense 12), Oasis Calm (Spirit Sense 12, with Northern Water Tribe Born), Speak Respectfully (Spirit Sense 18), Walk the Edge (Spirit Sense 24).
Pairs well with: Foggy Swamp Born, Air Temple Born. The places where the veil is thin.

Primary Attribute: Spirit

traits.name: Spirit-Touched
traits.info:
A spirit marked you once, in a forest, a dream or a solstice, and the Spirit World has never quite let go.

Gives: Spirit +1; Spirit Sense +2; unlocks as you train: Spirit Glimpse (Spirit Sense 6), Spirit Friend (Spirit Sense 12), Solstice Sight (Spirit Sense 18), Spirit Ally (Spirit Sense 24).

categories.name: Bending
categories.info: Can you bend, and what? Bending is a gift any child of any nation might have; most people have none.

categories.name: Nation and Home
categories.info: Where you grew up: the people, the manners and the country you know best.

categories.name: Discipline
categories.info: Your focus within your art: the part of it you have given your life to. Each opens its own ladder of techniques.

categories.name: Birth
categories.info: A rare gift, a training or a scar from before your story starts. The Avatar chooses how the Avatar State comes.

categories.name: Weapon Art
categories.info: The weapon you trained with, bender or not. It comes with the weapon and opens its own ladder.

categories.name: Background
categories.info: What you did before your story starts.

categories.name: Perk
categories.info: A small advantage you were born with or earned.

categories.name: Flaw
categories.info: The weakness you carry. The narrator holds you to it, and it pays you back a little.

categories.name: Era
categories.info: When your story starts: the year of the war it opens in. Each start opens in one year; Write Your Own lets you choose.

categories.name: Run
categories.info: How the story bends: the cycle as it was, or a cycle broken at a great event. An Avatar start keeps the canon cycle.

skills.name: airbending
skills.info:
The art of evasion and momentum: air moved in circles, never met head on, the bender always where the blow is not. A basic success turns a strike or clears a gap; a great success carries the bender or a foe across a courtyard.

Covers: air moved in circles: gusts, blades, the scooter, the spout, a leap carried on the wind; the art's ladders open the rest. Not: a glider's launch, which is athletics, and reading a spirit, which is spirit-sense. Easy: blow out every candle in a hall. Medium: leap a chasm on a gust. Hard: scatter a squad with one sweep. Very hard: ride an air scooter up the wall of Omashu. Extremely hard: stand in the eye of a tornado of your own making.

Primary Attribute: Chi

skills.name: archery
skills.info:
The bow and the stillness it asks for. A basic success hits what was aimed at; a great success pins a sleeve to a wall at a hundred paces.

Covers: the bow on foot or mounted, the aimed shot and the volley; the eye the Yuyan Archers are famous for. Not: a thrown dart, which is thrown weapons, and spotting a target, which is awareness. Easy: hit a target at thirty paces. Medium: shoot a rope from a bridge. Hard: pin a running man's sleeve to a tree. Very hard: match a Yuyan archer shot for shot. Extremely hard: shoot a leaf from a falling branch in the dark.

Primary Attribute: Wit

skills.name: artistry
skills.info:
Music, dance, theatre, calligraphy, the tea ceremony, the things each people reads a stranger by. A basic success pleases; a great success moves a hall to tears or to laughter.

Covers: music, dance, theatre, calligraphy, the tea ceremony, the arts each people reads a stranger by. Not: a lie on stage, which is deception, and cooking, which is cooking. Easy: play a tune at a camp fire. Medium: dance at a Fire Nation school party. Hard: write a letter in a fine hand. Very hard: hold a hall at the Ember Island Players. Extremely hard: pour tea at the Jasmine Dragon so that Iroh nods.

Primary Attribute: Spirit

skills.name: Athletics
skills.info:
Running, climbing, leaping, swimming, a glider's launch, a wall at a run. A basic success gets there; a great success gets there first, or where nobody thought a person could.

Covers: running, climbing, leaping, swimming, a glider's launch, a wall at a run. Not: enduring, which is stamina, and strength, which is might. Easy: climb a village wall. Medium: leap roof to roof in the Lower Ring. Hard: swim the moat of a stronghold. Very hard: launch a glider from the Northern Air Temple. Extremely hard: climb the Outer Wall of Ba Sing Se by hand.

Primary Attribute: Body

skills.name: awareness
skills.info:
Noticing: the ambush in the pass, the agent in the tea house, the loose stone, the thing out of place. A basic success spots the obvious before it lands; a great success spots what was hidden on purpose.

Covers: noticing: the ambush in the pass, the agent in the tea house, the loose stone, the thing out of place. Not: feeling a spirit, which is spirit-sense, and following a trail, which is tracking. Easy: spot a pickpocket in a market. Medium: see the ambush before the rocks fall. Hard: notice the Joo Dee who is not smiling. Very hard: spot the Dai Li agent in a crowded tea house. Extremely hard: see Azula's feint before she throws the lightning.

Primary Attribute: Spirit

skills.name: chi-blocking
skills.info:
Quick jabs on the body's pressure points that stop the flow of chi: limbs go slack, bending stops for a while. A basic success numbs an arm or a leg; a great success shuts a bender's art off until their chi returns.

Covers: quick strikes on the pressure points that stop chi: a limb numbed, bending shut off for a while. Not: a fist fight, which is unarmed, and a hold, which is also unarmed. Easy: numb a guard's sword arm. Medium: drop a soldier with two jabs. Hard: shut off an earthbender mid-stance. Very hard: take a master firebender's art away in a dark corridor. Extremely hard: block the forehead of Combustion Man before the blast.

Primary Attribute: Body

skills.name: command
skills.info:
Leading people in the open: soldiers, a crew, a village militia, a band of warriors. A basic success is obeyed; a great success holds a line that was breaking.

Covers: leading people in the open: soldiers, a crew, a militia, a band of warriors. Not: courtly manoeuvring, which is intrigue, and a lie, which is deception. Easy: get a ferry crew rowing together. Medium: rally a village against raiders. Hard: hold a militia line through a charge. Very hard: lead the Southern Water Tribe's men as Hakoda does. Extremely hard: command the invasion's line on the Day of Black Sun.

Primary Attribute: Spirit

skills.name: cooking
skills.info:
Food on the road and tea done properly: sea prunes, roast duck, egg custard tarts, the pot that makes a camp a home. A basic success feeds the party; a great success wins a friend or a hearing over the pot.

Covers: food on the road and tea done properly: sea prunes, roast duck, the pot that makes a camp a home. Not: the tea ceremony as art, which is artistry, and herbs for the sick, which is medicine. Easy: boil rice that is not burnt. Medium: feed six people from one fish. Hard: cook sea prunes a Water Tribe grandmother would eat. Very hard: brew tea for a Fire Nation general's table. Extremely hard: brew the jasmine that Iroh would call the best in Ba Sing Se.

Primary Attribute: Spirit

skills.name: deception
skills.info:
Lies, false names, forged passports, a disguise held through a ferry inspection. A basic success is believed; a great success is believed by someone who was warned.

Covers: lies, false names, forged passports, a disguise held through an inspection. Not: moving unseen, which is stealth, and an honest plea, which is persuasion. Easy: lie to an innkeeper about your name. Medium: pass as a refugee at the Earth Kingdom ferry. Hard: hold a Fire Nation school uniform's story for a week. Very hard: fool a Dai Li agent face to face. Extremely hard: convince Long Feng's people the war is not being mentioned.

Primary Attribute: Wit

skills.name: earthbending
skills.info:
The art of the rooted stance: rock, sand, mud and dust moved by a bender who listens and waits for the moment. A basic success lifts or throws what was aimed at; a great success shapes it, a wall, a pillar, a wave of ground.

Covers: rock, sand, mud and dust thrown, raised, shaped or sunk; the rooted stance; the art's ladders open seismic sense and the rest. Not: a sandbender's sail, which is sailing, and lifting a stone by hand, which is might. Easy: throw a stone the size of a head. Medium: raise a wall before a cavalry charge. Hard: sink a tank to its axles. Very hard: ride a wave of earth across the Si Wong Desert. Extremely hard: tear the Fire Nation drill open from inside.

Primary Attribute: Chi

skills.name: engineering
skills.info:
Machines large enough to change a war: tanks, balloons, airships, drills, the monorail, the gliders of the northern temple. A basic success keeps a machine running; a great success builds or breaks one.

Covers: machines that change a war: tanks, balloons, airships, drills, submarines, the monorail, the gliders of the Northern Air Temple. Not: a lock or a small trap, which is tinkering, and a forge, which is smithing. Easy: keep a cart's axle turning. Medium: repair a glider's wing. Hard: stop a tank with what is in a village. Very hard: fly a hot air balloon through a storm. Extremely hard: find the one weakness of the Fire Nation drill.

Primary Attribute: Wit

skills.name: firebending
skills.info:
The art of breath and drive: fire made from the bender's own chi and pushed through fists, feet and breath. A basic success sends the flame where it was aimed; a great success shapes it, sustains it and keeps the temper that fuels it.

Covers: fire from breath and drive, blasts, whips, rings and shields of flame; the art's ladders open lightning and the rest. Not: keeping a temper, which is resolve, and lighting a lamp, which anyone can do. Easy: light a torch with a breath. Medium: blast a door off its hinges. Hard: hold a ring of fire against three earthbenders. Very hard: win an Agni Kai before the Fire Nation Royal Palace. Extremely hard: fight under Sozin's Comet and keep the flame yours.

Primary Attribute: Chi

skills.name: intrigue
skills.info:
Courts, ministries and secret police: who owes whom, what may not be said, which door a bribe opens. A basic success reads the room; a great success turns a minister or outwits an agent.

Covers: courts, ministries and secret police: who owes whom, what may not be said, which door a favour opens. Not: a lie to a stranger, which is deception, and the street's rules, which is streetwise. Easy: learn which minister takes gifts. Medium: get an audience at the Omashu Royal Palace. Hard: read the game in the Upper Ring. Very hard: turn a Dai Li agent. Extremely hard: outplay Long Feng in his own city.

Primary Attribute: Wit

skills.name: lore
skills.info:
The four nations' histories, the Avatar cycle, the war, the spirits and the customs of each people. A basic success recalls what any scholar would; a great success recalls what the sages tried to bury.

Covers: the four nations' histories, the Avatar cycle, the war, the spirits, the customs of each people. Not: a town's gossip, which is streetwise, and a court's debts, which is intrigue. Easy: name the four nations and their arts. Medium: tell the story of the Hundred Year War's first day. Hard: recall how the Avatar cycle turns. Very hard: read a scroll in Wan Shi Tong's Library. Extremely hard: know what the Fire Sages hid about Roku.

Primary Attribute: Spirit

skills.name: medicine
skills.info:
Herbs, bandages, bone-setting, the herbalist's craft and field care in a war; not the healing a waterbender does. A basic success stabilises; a great success brings someone back from the edge.

Covers: herbs, bandages, bone-setting, field care in a war, the craft of the Herbalist. Not: waterbending healing, which is waterbending, and the sick mind, which is resolve. Easy: bind a cut. Medium: set a broken arm. Hard: pull a fever down with the right herbs. Very hard: keep a burned soldier alive through the night. Extremely hard: treat a lightning strike without a waterbender.

Primary Attribute: Spirit

skills.name: meditation
skills.info:
Stillness, breath, the chakras, the long sit that opens the way to the Spirit World. A basic success steadies the mind or chi; a great success crosses over or sees what a guru would see.

Covers: stillness, breath, the chakras, the sit that steadies chi or opens the Spirit World. Not: feeling a spirit, which is spirit-sense, and holding against fear, which is resolve. Easy: steady your breath after a fight. Medium: recover chi in a cold camp. Hard: sit through a night in a haunted temple. Very hard: open a blocked chakra with Pathik's method. Extremely hard: cross into the Spirit World at a solstice.

Primary Attribute: Spirit

skills.name: might
skills.info:
Raw strength: lifting, breaking, holding a gate, dragging a cart out of the mud. A basic success moves what one person should; a great success moves what three should.

Covers: raw strength: lifting, breaking, holding, dragging. Not: a fist fight, which is unarmed, and keeping going, which is stamina. Easy: carry a wounded friend a mile. Medium: force a barred door. Hard: hold a gate against a ram. Very hard: lift a cart off a trapped child. Extremely hard: hold the Earth Rumble ring's champion in a lock.

Primary Attribute: Body

skills.name: Persuasion
skills.info:
Honest talk: a plea, a bargain, a cup of tea and a reason. A basic success gets a hearing; a great success changes a mind that was made up.

Covers: honest talk: a plea, a bargain, a reason given over tea. Not: a lie, which is deception, and an order, which is command. Easy: talk a shopkeeper into a loan. Medium: talk a frightened village into opening its gate. Hard: talk a deserter out of a bad plan. Very hard: talk a Fire Nation captain into letting a prisoner go. Extremely hard: talk a spirit out of its anger as Iroh might.

Primary Attribute: Spirit

skills.name: polearms
skills.info:
Spears, the bone spear and the club of the tribes, staves and the glider staff used as one. A basic success holds a line or lands a thrust; a great success sweeps three foes from their feet.

Covers: spears, the bone spear and the club of the tribes, staves, the glider staff used as a staff. Not: a sword, which is swordsmanship, and a thrown spear, which is thrown weapons. Easy: hold a spear line against wolves. Medium: take a soldier's legs with a staff. Hard: hold a pass alone with a spear. Very hard: fight a komodo rhino rider from the ground. Extremely hard: stand at the front of the Southern Water Tribe's line on the Day of Black Sun.

Primary Attribute: Body

skills.name: resolve
skills.info:
Holding steady: fear, pain, a lamp and a voice in a dark chamber, a royal's stare. A basic success holds; a great success holds and acts anyway.

Covers: holding steady against fear, pain, a lamp and a voice in a dark chamber, a royal's stare. Not: a steady breath, which is meditation, and enduring the road, which is stamina. Easy: keep your nerve under a sergeant's shouting. Medium: face a komodo rhino charge without running. Hard: sit through a night under Lake Laogai and keep your name. Very hard: meet Azula's eyes and lie. Extremely hard: hold your mind against the Dai Li's lamp.

Primary Attribute: Spirit

skills.name: riding
skills.info:
Ostrich horses, komodo rhinos, eel hounds, a sky bison that permits it. A basic success stays mounted and arrives; a great success fights from the saddle or outruns a patrol.

Covers: ostrich horses, komodo rhinos, eel hounds, a sky bison that allows it: staying on, arriving, fighting mounted. Not: a cart's repair, which is engineering, and a beast's trust, which is wildcraft. Easy: ride an ostrich horse to the next village. Medium: ride through a crowd without trampling anyone. Hard: outrun a Fire Nation patrol on a mountain road. Very hard: fight from a komodo rhino's back. Extremely hard: ride an eel hound across the plains without rest.

Primary Attribute: Body

skills.name: sailing
skills.info:
Boats and ships: the cutters of the South, the double-hulled boats of the North, Fire Navy steel, a sand-sailer on the dunes. A basic success makes the crossing; a great success runs a blockade or rides a storm.

Covers: boats and ships: the cutters of the South, the northern boats, Fire Navy steel, the refugee ferry, a sand-sailer on the dunes. Not: swimming, which is athletics, and reading the weather on land, which is wildcraft. Easy: row a canoe across a calm bay. Medium: sail a cutter through the Southern Archipelago. Hard: run a sand-sailer across the Si Wong Desert at night. Very hard: slip a stolen ship past the Great Gates of Azulon. Extremely hard: bring a cutter through the Northern Sea in the siege's storm.

Primary Attribute: Body

skills.name: smithing
skills.info:
Forge, anvil and whetstone: making, sharpening and mending steel and armour. A basic success repairs or sharpens; a great success forges a blade a master would sign.

Covers: forge, anvil and whetstone: making, sharpening and mending steel and armour. Not: a machine, which is engineering, and the sword's use, which is swordsmanship. Easy: sharpen a dull blade. Medium: mend a dented helm. Hard: forge a serviceable sword in a village forge. Very hard: forge armour a komodo rhino cannot bite through. Extremely hard: forge a sword from a fallen star at Piandao's castle.

Primary Attribute: Body

skills.name: spirit-sense
skills.info:
Feeling where the Spirit World presses close: a haunted forest, a solstice, a spirit's mood, the edge of a portal. A basic success knows a spirit is near; a great success reads what it wants.

Covers: feeling where the Spirit World presses close: a haunted forest, a solstice, a spirit's mood, the edge of a crossing. Not: crossing over, which is meditation, and knowing a spirit's story, which is lore. Easy: feel that a forest is angry. Medium: know which night of the year the veil is thin. Hard: feel Hei Bai before the trees move. Very hard: find the Spirit Oasis's far side. Extremely hard: feel Koh watching before he speaks.

Primary Attribute: Spirit

skills.name: stamina
skills.info:
Enduring: the desert, the tundra, a long march, hunger, a long fight. A basic success keeps going; a great success keeps going when everyone else has stopped.

Covers: enduring the desert, the tundra, a long march, hunger, a long fight. Not: strength, which is might, and living off the land, which is wildcraft. Easy: walk a day on the refugee road. Medium: stand a night watch in the snow. Hard: cross the Si Wong Desert on foot. Very hard: march with the Fire Army for a week. Extremely hard: cross the South Pole continent's ice without a sled.

Primary Attribute: Body

skills.name: stealth
skills.info:
Moving unseen and unheard: a rooftop at night, a crowd, a mask, a dark corridor in a stronghold. A basic success passes the careless; a great success walks past the Dai Li.

Covers: moving unseen and unheard: rooftops, crowds, masks, dark corridors in a stronghold. Not: a false name, which is deception, and reading the guard rota, which is intrigue. Easy: slip out of an inn at night. Medium: cross a lit courtyard unseen. Hard: pass a Fire Nation checkpoint in the dark. Very hard: walk the halls of Pohuai Stronghold masked. Extremely hard: move through the Earth Kingdom Royal Palace past the Dai Li.

Primary Attribute: Wit

skills.name: streetwise
skills.info:
Markets, docks, the Lower Ring, pirates and smugglers: where to buy, who to ask, what a stranger must not do. A basic success finds the right stall or the right boat; a great success finds the thing nobody sells.

Covers: markets, docks, the Lower Ring, pirates, smugglers and the rules a stranger must not break. Not: a palace, which is intrigue, and a fair price, which is trade. Easy: find the black market in a port. Medium: find a bed in the Lower Ring without papers. Hard: find a smuggler who will carry you north. Very hard: buy a waterbending scroll from pirates and keep your purse. Extremely hard: move a fugitive through Ba Sing Se without the Dai Li hearing.

Primary Attribute: Wit

skills.name: swordsmanship
skills.info:
The sword, taught as an art: stance, cut, the strike that is also a defence. A basic success lands or turns a cut; a great success wins the exchange with one stroke.

Covers: swords: stance, cut, parry, the single stroke that ends an exchange, a master's lessons kept. Not: a staff or a spear, which is polearms, and a thrown knife, which is thrown weapons. Easy: cut a rope in one stroke. Medium: hold a doorway against two soldiers. Hard: beat a Fire Nation officer blade to blade. Very hard: pass the test at Piandao's castle. Extremely hard: cross swords with Zuko and live to tell it.

Primary Attribute: Body

skills.name: thrown-weapons
skills.info:
Knives, darts, shuriken, arm-blades, a boomerang that comes back. A basic success hits or pins; a great success hits from a hidden hand before anyone saw the throw.

Covers: knives, darts, shuriken, arm-blades and the boomerang: a hit from a hidden hand, a pin, a throw that comes back. Not: the bow, which is archery, and a knife in the hand, which is unarmed. Easy: pin a sleeve to a wall. Medium: cut a rope across a room with one throw. Hard: drop a runner at forty paces. Very hard: pin Mai's own sleeve before she pins yours. Extremely hard: bring a boomerang back through the crowd at a Fire Nation festival.

Primary Attribute: Wit

skills.name: tinkering
skills.info:
Locks, traps, small mechanisms, the chutes and counterweights of a delivery system. A basic success opens, sets or disarms the simple kind; a great success beats a royal vault or rigs a trap nobody sees.

Covers: locks, traps, small mechanisms, chutes and counterweights, the clever small device. Not: a war machine, which is engineering, and forging a part, which is smithing. Easy: open a merchant's strongbox. Medium: set a snare that holds a man. Hard: jam the Omashu delivery system at the right chute. Very hard: pick the lock of a Fire Nation prison cell. Extremely hard: beat the vault of the Earth Kingdom Royal Palace.

Primary Attribute: Wit

skills.name: tracking
skills.info:
Following a trail by sign, scent and broken twig, the bounty hunter's craft, with or without a shirshu. A basic success finds the trail; a great success finds the quarry.

Covers: following a trail by sign, scent and broken twig, the bounty hunter's craft, with or without a shirshu. Not: noticing an ambush, which is awareness, and the land's food, which is wildcraft. Easy: follow boot prints to a camp. Medium: follow a cart's track after rain. Hard: track a fugitive through a town. Very hard: track a sky bison across the plains. Extremely hard: track the way June does, by a single scent.

Primary Attribute: Wit

skills.name: trade
skills.info:
Bargaining, prices, cargo, cabbages, what a thing is worth in each nation's coin. A basic success gets a fair price; a great success gets the merchant's own price.

Covers: bargaining, prices, cargo, what a thing is worth in each nation's coin. Not: the black market, which is streetwise, and a bribe, which is intrigue. Easy: buy a cabbage at a fair price. Medium: sell a pelt in a strange town. Hard: buy passage north without being cheated. Very hard: outbargain a Fire Nation quartermaster. Extremely hard: sell the Cabbage merchant his own cabbages.

Primary Attribute: Wit

skills.name: unarmed
skills.info:
Fists, throws, wrestling and the holds of the ring. A basic success lands or escapes; a great success pins, disarms or throws someone through a door.

Covers: fists, throws, wrestling, the holds and slams of the ring and the street. Not: the pressure-point strikes, which are chi-blocking, and the war fans, which are fans. Easy: win a tavern scuffle. Medium: pin a thief. Hard: throw a soldier through a door. Very hard: last a round in Earth Rumble without bending. Extremely hard: put The Boulder on his back.

Primary Attribute: Body

skills.name: waterbending
skills.info:
The art of push and pull: water drawn from a pouch, a river, the rain or the air, shaped, frozen, thawed and sent back. A basic success moves the water where it was meant to go; a great success changes its state mid-motion and turns a defence into a strike.

Covers: water, ice and snow moved, shaped and frozen; the push and pull of a fight; the state changes; the art's ladders open healing and the rest. Not: chi-blocking, which stops the art, and medicine, which is a healer without water. Easy: draw water from a pouch into a whip. Medium: freeze a doorway shut. Hard: turn a firebender's blast with a wall of water. Very hard: fight on an iceberg in the dark of the moon. Extremely hard: hold the sea back as the Siege of the North breaks.

Primary Attribute: Chi

skills.name: wildcraft
skills.info:
Living off the land: the swamp, the ice, the desert, a forest in winter; shelter, fire, water, the way without a road. A basic success keeps a party fed and dry; a great success crosses the worst ground alive.

Covers: living off the land: the swamp, the ice, the desert, a winter forest; shelter, fire, water, the way without a road. Not: a trail, which is tracking, and the weather at sea, which is sailing. Easy: find water on a hillside. Medium: build a dry shelter in the Foggy Swamp. Hard: find the way through the Great Divide without a guide. Very hard: keep a party alive a week in the Si Wong Desert. Extremely hard: cross the ice to Agna Qel'a without a boat.

Primary Attribute: Spirit

lowText.body: A frail frame. You tire on a day's march, a blow lands hard, and weapons, earthbending stances and firebending forms all come harder; a hard fight ends early for you.
lowText.chi: A thin reserve. Your bending gutters after a few forms, your breath runs short, and every technique costs you more than it costs the next bender; chi-blockers barely need to touch you.
lowText.spirit: A closed mind. Meditation will not settle, the Spirit World stays shut to you, and the Dai Li's lamp or a spirit's whisper finds nothing in you that pushes back.
lowText.wit: A slow tongue. Lies show on your face, a bargain goes against you, a trap is sprung before you see it, and the mechanist's workshop is a room full of things you cannot name.

lore.name: Agni Kai
lore.info: An Agni Kai is a Fire Nation duel of honour, centuries old. A challenger names the dispute; if the challenge is accepted, the two meet in an arena, a plaza or a parade ground, kneel with their backs turned, rise, shed their shoulder mantles and turn to fight at the sound of a gong. The duel ends when one burns the other, or stands at the other's mercy. The winner wins the feud with it, and the loser must keep whatever was sworn. The palace of the Fire Lord has its own dueling chamber. Once these duels seldom ended in death; since Sozin's day, sparing a beaten rival is called weakness. A foreigner who accepts an Agni Kai has made a promise in fire and will be held to it, win or lose.

lore.name: Air Nomad Genocide
lore.info: The Air Nomads lived in four temples high in the mountains, places only a sky bison seemed able to reach, and the world believed them safe. The Fire Army reached them anyway, in the comet's year, while the Earth Kingdom and the Water Tribes were too busy defending their own shores to send help. Sozin knew the next Avatar would be born an Air Nomad, and the attack was aimed at that child. The monks and nuns fought harder than anyone expected of a peaceful people; at the Southern Air Temple soldiers' bones still lie in heaps where they fell. It changed nothing. The temples were emptied, their relics carried off to the Fire Islands or broken, and the few nomads who escaped were hunted down in the years after. A century on, the temples stand empty, flying bison are a tale for children, and many in the Earth Kingdom doubt airbenders were ever more than legend.
