📍 Pass Southern Gate, The Four Nations. The southern end of the Serpent's Pass, two posts and a carved warning to abandon hope, where those without a passport decide whether to walk.
Pace: Guided. An authored opening plays out, then the world is yours.
Danger: 🟠 High. Dangerous ground; a party that picks its fights survives it. (Recommended Level 9-21)

Refugees without passports take the Serpent's Pass to Ba Sing Se: a narrow path between two lakes, with a carving at its start telling travellers to abandon hope, and something enormous living in the water.

starts.name: The Siege Fleet Gathers
starts.info:
ERA · Book One · 1-5 players · guided
📍 Agna Qel'a, The Four Nations. The capital of the Northern Water Tribe at the top of the world, a city built almost entirely of ice on the shore of the Northern Sea, tiered and carved, with canals for streets and a great wall facing the sea.
Pace: Guided. An authored opening plays out, then the world is yours.
Danger: 🔴 Severe. Safe inside; the ground around it is not. (Recommended Level 12-30)

The Northern Water Tribe has held its city for a hundred years, and now the Fire Navy's whole fleet is on the horizon. Master Pakku drills his students, the chief's daughter watches the moon, and the gate is closing.

starts.name: The Solstice at Roku's Temple
starts.info:
AVATAR · Book One · the Avatar's own story · guided
📍 Crescent Island Fire Temple, The Four Nations. The Fire Sages' five-tiered pagoda on the crag of Crescent Island, kept for Avatar Roku, who studied the Avatar State here.
Pace: Guided. An authored opening plays out, then the world is yours.
Danger: 🟠 High. Dangerous ground; a party that picks its fights survives it. (Recommended Level 10-24)

A spirit has told the Avatar to reach Avatar Roku's temple by sunset on the winter solstice. The temple is in the Fire Nation, its sages serve the Fire Lord, and the Fire Navy knows exactly where the Avatar is going.
🎭 The Great Sage, Male, the leader of the five Fire Sages of Avatar Roku's temple on Crescent Island. A Fire Sage at the temple door asking a pilgrim too many questions.
🎭 Shyu, Male, the youngest of the five Fire Sages of Crescent Island at sixty. Tall pointed dark red hood framing the face. The youngest sage, waiting by the temple door as if expecting someone.

starts.name: The Spirit of Senlin
starts.info:
ERA · Book One · 1-5 players · guided
📍 Senlin Village, The Four Nations. A small farming village at the edge of the scorched forest, unoccupied because the Fire Nation saw nothing worth taking, where the villagers farm, trade and keep a shrine to the forest's spirit.
Pace: Guided. An authored opening plays out, then the world is yours.
Danger: 🟡 Moderate. Real fights at the edges; walk in with your eyes open. (Recommended Level 3-12)

Every night near the winter solstice a spirit comes out of the burned forest and takes someone from Senlin Village. The villagers keep the shrine and pray, and tonight the sun is going down.
🎭 Senlin Village Leader, Male, the head of Senlin Village. Tired worried eyes, plain dark grey high-collared robe. A village leader looking at the forest edge as the sun goes down.

starts.name: The Tunnels of New Ozai
starts.info:
ERA · Book Two · 1-5 players · guided
📍 New Ozai, The Four Nations. Omashu under the Fire Nation, renamed New Ozai after the Surrender of Omashu in the spring of 100 AG: the same terraces and chutes with red banners on them, a governor in King Bumi's palace, a statue of Fire Lord Ozai going up in the square and the city's people sick with a plague that is make-up.
Pace: Guided. An authored opening plays out, then the world is yours.
Danger: 🟠 High. Dangerous ground; a party that picks its fights survives it. (Recommended Level 9-24)

Omashu has surrendered and is New Ozai now. Red banners hang on the terraces, a governor sits in King Bumi's palace, and the resistance moves through the sewers and chutes beneath it all.

starts.name: Under Lake Laogai
starts.info:
AVATAR · Book Two · the Avatar's own story · guided
📍 Lake Laogai, The Four Nations. A large lake in the Agrarian Zone, a pleasant place for a day out according to the Joo Dees, with a high-security prison under it where Long Feng interns anyone whose actions cross his plans and the Dai Li do their brainwashing.
Pace: Guided. An authored opening plays out, then the world is yours.
Danger: 🔴 Severe. Deadly to the unready; the top of this band eats mid-level parties. (Recommended Level 12-30)

The Avatar came to Ba Sing Se to warn the Earth King about the eclipse and found a city where nobody may mention the war. Now a friend has gone missing, and the trail leads under the lake.
🎭 Head of the Dai Li, Male, the representative and spokesman of the Dai Li. Dark green and black high-collared robe with a white crescent shape on the chest. A Dai Li commander in an underground hall, deciding which master to serve.

starts.name: Write Your Own
starts.info:
MAKE IT YOURS · open-ended
Write your own beginning anywhere in the four nations. Say who you are, which nation and which art made you, which year of the war it is, and where your road starts.

quests.info: A chamberlain's hand settles the family's quiet troubles. A servant at the beach house has been writing letters to someone in the colonies, and the family wants to know what they say.
quests.goal: Decide what the family is told
steps: Find the servant's letters at the beach house.
Decide what the family is told.

quests.name: The Chief's Councillor
quests.info: A councillor advises the chief. The party must counsel the chief on the fleet that is coming.

quests.name: The Chute Master's Test
quests.info: A chute master runs the post. The king wants the party to ride the chutes from the peak to the gate in under a minute.
quests.goal: Reach the gate in under a minute
steps: Ride the chutes from the peak.
Reach the gate in under a minute.

quests.name: The City They Built
quests.info: Omashu was built where the two lovers met; the nomads want to sing the story at its gate.
steps: Bring the nomads to Omashu's gate.
quests.line: Love Is Brightest in the Dark

quests.name: The Clerk Who Writes Victories
quests.info: A clerk in the harbour quarter rewrites the dispatches from the front before they are posted.
quests.goal: Read a dispatch before and after
steps: Read a dispatch before and after.
quests.line: The Board in the Ash Market

quests.name: The Clerk's Book
quests.info: A council clerk keeps the war's numbers. General How suspects the council's books are being changed.
steps: Compare the books with the reports.

quests.name: The Commander's Choice
quests.info: The commander of the raiders answers for everything the unit did. The party is offered the unit, and with it its past.
steps: Learn what the unit did in the South.

quests.name: The Commissioner's Rock
quests.info: A commissioner answers for the prisons. A riot is brewing in the Boiling Rock, and the general sends the party to end it before it starts.
steps: Learn who is planning the riot.

quests.name: The Commodore's Flight
quests.info: A commodore leads the air. The party must lead three balloons in formation over the capital before the war minister.
quests.goal: Fly the formation over the capital
steps: Fly the formation over the capital.

quests.name: The Courier's Road
quests.info: A courier of the household must ride where the family goes and keep its secrets. Li sets a road with a sealed message and someone on it who wants to read it.
quests.goal: Keep the seal unbroken against whoever follows
steps: Carry the sealed message to the royal spa.
Keep the seal unbroken against whoever follows.

quests.name: The Desert Bender
quests.info: A sandbender at the oasis has never lost a fight.

quests.name: The Director's Play
quests.info: A director chooses what the island sees. The party must stage a play about the Avatar that the Fire Nation will cheer.
quests.goal: Stage it to a cheering house
steps: Stage it to a cheering house.

quests.name: The Duel
quests.info: The last lesson is a duel with the master himself, on neutral ground.

quests.name: The Empty Hands
quests.info: The fans of Kyoshi's statue were taken in the night.
quests.goal: Find which way the thieves went
steps: Find which way the thieves went.

quests.name: The Empty Temple
quests.info: The southern temple holds the monks' memory and their deaths.
quests.goal: Let go of what was seen there
steps: Let go of what was seen there.

quests.name: The Factory Inspection
quests.info: A lieutenant answers for what the army builds. The factory's tanks keep failing in the field, and the general wants to know whether it is bad steel or bad men.
quests.goal: Name the cause of the failures
steps: Inspect the tanks on the factory floor.
Name the cause of the failures.

quests.name: The Factory's Pipes
quests.info: The army factory empties its waste into the river at night.
quests.goal: Find the pipes that poison the river
steps: Find the pipes that poison the river.

quests.name: The Far Landing
quests.info: The refugees landed at the seaport village are being turned away by its garrison.
quests.goal: Find them a place to go
steps: Learn why the garrison turns them away.
Find them a place to go.

quests.name: The Far Shore
quests.info: The boat lands at the camp on the far shore, where the city's guards look for people without papers.
quests.goal: Get them past the camp's guards
steps: Get them past the camp's guards.

quests.name: The Fence
quests.info: The fans are for sale in Chin Village, of all places.

quests.name: The Festival
quests.info: The island holds a festival for the fans' return.
steps: Return the fans to the statue.

quests.name: The Festival Without a Grudge
quests.info: The village could keep its festival without its grudge, if someone told it how.
quests.goal: See the festival kept in peace
steps: See the festival kept in peace.

quests.name: The Fishing Grounds
quests.info: The remedy needs a kelp that grows only under the ice of the fishing grounds.
quests.goal: Bring it back before it freezes
steps: Find the kelp under the ice.
Bring it back before it freezes.

quests.name: The Flotilla
quests.info: A flotilla captain commands ships. Three raider ships must be brought back to port, and one of them has a crew that wants to go home.

quests.name: The General's Aide
quests.info: A general's aide speaks for a general. The party must carry General How's plan to a council that does not want it.
steps: Learn which generals oppose the plan.

quests.name: The General's Plan
quests.info: A general argues with generals. The war council meets, and the party must carry a plan through it that the older officers would rather see fail.
quests.goal: Carry the plan through the council
steps: Gather the support of two officers before the council.
Carry the plan through the council.

quests.name: The General's Wall
quests.info: A general commands the walls. The party must bring two quarrelling commands on the Outer Wall under one plan before the next attack.
quests.goal: Set one plan for the wall
steps: Bring the two commands to one table.
Set one plan for the wall.

quests.name: The Governor's Colony
quests.info: A governor answers for a colony. The mining village's miners have stopped work, and the colony needs the ore.

quests.name: The Great Sage's Door
quests.info: A great sage opens the sealed door. The party must open the Crescent Island temple's door the old way, with five blasts of fire at once.

quests.name: The Grey Water
quests.info: The river at Jang Hui runs grey, the fish are thin, and the children are sick.

quests.name: The Guide
quests.info: No guide at the oasis will take a scholar where the map points.

quests.name: The Handler's List
quests.info: A handler chooses which guides need the lake. One of the guides has started to remember.
quests.goal: Decide whether she goes to the lake
steps: Decide whether she goes to the lake.

quests.name: The Hanging Halls
quests.info: The western temple hangs under a cliff, built by benders who trusted the air.
quests.goal: Cross the gap without a rope
steps: Cross the gap without a rope.

quests.name: The Healing Pool
quests.info: The fishers will only take the remedy from a warrior's hand, by custom.
steps: Make the remedy with the healers.

quests.name: The High Sage
quests.info: The high sage speaks for the faith. The Great Sage asks the party to decide what the sages say at a Fire Lord's coronation.
quests.goal: Settle the words of the rite
steps: Learn what the sages argue about.
Settle the words of the rite.

quests.name: The Island's Answer
quests.info: Kyoshi Island has its own memory of the day the island broke from the land.

quests.name: The Jasmine
quests.info: The best jasmine is grown in the colonies.

quests.name: The King's Hand
quests.info: The king's hand does what the king will not say. Bumi asks the party to find out who in the palace is talking to the Fire Nation.
quests.goal: Deal with them the king's way
steps: Deal with them the king's way.

quests.name: The Lake
quests.info: Everyone who says the word war aloud ends up at the lake, the stories go.
steps: Find the way under the lake.

quests.name: The Landing
quests.info: A trader at the landing saw a boat leave at dawn.

quests.name: The Lead's Night
quests.info: A lead player carries a play. The party leads a new play about the war that the censors have not yet seen.
quests.goal: Lead it to a full house
steps: Get the play past the censors.
Lead it to a full house.

quests.name: The Leaf
quests.info: A firebender must be able to burn a leaf without letting the burn spread.

quests.name: The Lieutenant's Contract
quests.info: A lieutenant takes the band's contracts. A contract comes in to burn a town, and the party decides whether the band takes it.
quests.goal: Take it or turn it down
steps: Take it or turn it down.

quests.name: The Lieutenant's Pass
quests.info: A lieutenant keeps a gate. Refugees without papers are massing at the pass's northern gate, and the garrison wants orders.
steps: Learn who is at the gate.

quests.name: The Lieutenant's Watch
quests.info: A guard lieutenant answers for the palace's night. Men in green robes have been walking the palace at night on no guard's orders.
quests.goal: Tell the captain what they want
steps: Tell the captain what they want.

quests.name: The Lost Remedy
quests.info: A fever is spreading among the fishers, and the old remedy for it was never written down.
quests.goal: Learn who last knew the remedy
steps: Learn who last knew the remedy.

quests.name: The Map
quests.info: A student has copied an old professor's map, and the university will not fund the trip.

quests.name: The Melting Spring
quests.info: The oasis's spring of ice is melting faster every month.
quests.goal: Learn how long it has left
steps: Learn how long it has left.

quests.name: The Meteorite
quests.info: A sword must be forged; the iron the master wants is sold in Fire Fountain City.

quests.name: The Middle Ring's Office
quests.info: The vanished families all signed the same petition at an office in the Middle Ring.

quests.name: The Mountain
quests.info: Master Yu's final test is to move a boulder on the mountain road that no student has moved.
steps: Find the boulder on the road.

quests.name: The Mountain Road
quests.info: A Fire Nation patrol is coming up the mountain road toward the temple's refugees.
quests.goal: Turn the patrol back on the road
steps: Turn the patrol back on the road.

quests.name: The New Joo Dee
quests.info: A guide must become a Joo Dee. The party must keep a curious guest happy for a week without ever answering a question.
quests.goal: Answer no question about the war
steps: Keep the guest happy a week.
Answer no question about the war.

quests.name: The Officer's Secret
quests.info: An airship officer keeps the corps' secrets. A rumour of airships has reached the harbour quarter, and the captain wants its source found and stopped.

quests.name: The Open Sea
quests.info: A waterbender must know the sea, not only the canal.
quests.goal: Feel the tide turn before it does
steps: Bring the fishers through rough water.
Feel the tide turn before it does.

quests.name: The Perfect Pot
quests.info: Good leaves need a patient hand.
quests.goal: Serve it to a full house
steps: Serve it to a full house.

quests.name: The Player's Bow
quests.info: A player earns applause. The party must win over the toughest audience on the island: a row of generals' wives.

quests.name: The Procession Captain
quests.info: A procession captain plans the ride. A royal procession must cross the Royal Plaza on a day of rallies, and the party plans the ride.
quests.goal: Bring it through the rally safely
steps: Bring it through the rally safely.

quests.name: The Raid Captain's Orders
quests.info: A raid captain leads a raid. The party is given a raid's orders and must decide how much of them to carry out.

quests.name: The Raider's Log
quests.info: The log names the waterbenders the raiders took from the South.
quests.goal: Learn which names the village knew
steps: Read the log to the elders.
Learn which names the village knew.

quests.name: The Rig in the Storm
quests.info: A lieutenant answers for what floats. A storm has cracked the prison rig's coal store, and its prisoners are watching the guards.
quests.goal: Keep the prisoners in their cells through the storm
steps: Keep the prisoners in their cells through the storm.

quests.name: The Sergeant's Crack
quests.info: A sergeant finds the weak stone. Something is digging under the drill site.
quests.goal: Stop it before it reaches the wall
steps: Find what digs under the drill site.
Stop it before it reaches the wall.

quests.name: The Tax Farmer's Books
quests.info: A tax farmer keeps the books. Garsai's books do not add up, and somebody is keeping the difference.

quests.name: The Temple's Answer
quests.info: The log says one waterbender was taken to the old air temple first.

quests.name: The Test Flight
quests.info: The new glider must fly from the mountain to the valley.

quests.name: The Thought Chakra
quests.info: The last chakra opens only when the deepest attachment is let go.

quests.name: The Throne Guard
quests.info: A throne guard stands behind the Fire Lord. The party must find a weakness in the throne room's guard before an enemy does.
steps: Find the weakness in the throne room's guard.

quests.name: The Tilted Hull
quests.info: A Fire Navy ship has lain in the ice since the raids, and the children say lights move in it.

quests.name: The Voice of the Throne
quests.info: Only someone the family trusts speaks for the throne. Li asks the party to settle a quarrel between two noble houses in the gardens without either losing face.
quests.goal: Settle the quarrel with both faces kept
steps: Hear both houses out in the gardens.
Settle the quarrel with both faces kept.

quests.name: The Volcano
quests.info: The last lesson is the greatest fire there is, and holding back from it.

quests.name: The Wall
quests.info: The sea wall's ice is raised by many benders at once, in one rhythm.
quests.goal: Keep the rhythm to the end
steps: Raise the wall with the wall benders.
Keep the rhythm to the end.

quests.name: The Warder's Keys
quests.info: A prison warder keeps the keys. A prisoner in the capital city prison has been getting letters out, and the general wants to know how.
steps: Learn how the letters leave the prison.

quests.name: The Waterfall Town
quests.info: A swordsman must know the land he fights on; the master sends the party into the town.
quests.goal: Use it in a sparring match
steps: Walk the town and map its ground.
Use it in a sparring match.

quests.name: The Wild Leaf
quests.info: A rare wild tea grows on the mountain road.

quests.name: The Workshop
quests.info: The mechanist's gliders work for his son and nobody else.

quests.name: Tribe Councillor
quests.info: A councillor leads the crossing. The tribe must cross the canyon without the Zhang.

quests.name: Tribe Speaker
quests.info: A speaker talks for the tribe. The Gan Jin want to talk.

quests.name: Tribe Warrior
quests.info: A warrior keeps the hunters safe. Something is taking the hunters' catch.

quests.name: Under the Moon
quests.info: Pakku's last lesson is at the oasis, under the full moon.

quests.name: Understudy
quests.info: An understudy waits in the wings. The lead actor falls ill on opening night, and the party must go on.

quests.name: University Fellow
quests.info: A fellow argues with the faculty. The party must defend a finding the faculty will not accept.

quests.name: Vine Bender
quests.info: A vine bender moves the swamp's water. Huu sets the party to raise a vine bridge over deep water.

quests.name: Wall Gate Sergeant
quests.info: A gate sergeant knows every face. Someone has been passing the Inner Wall's gate with a forged pass.

quests.name: Wall Waterbender
quests.info: A wall waterbender raises the ice. A gap has opened in the sea wall's ice.
quests.goal: Raise the ice to close it
steps: Find the gap in the wall.
Raise the ice to close it.

quests.name: War Leader
quests.info: A war leader plans the fight. The warriors plan to strike a Fire Navy ship at the cliffs.

quests.name: Warrior of the South
quests.info: A warrior proves himself to the men. Bato sends the party on a night patrol of the bay.

quests.name: Water for the Oasis
quests.info: The tribes will share the water if the oasis keeps the desert's law.
steps: Carry the tribes' terms to the oasis.

quests.name: What the Prisoners Know
quests.info: The prisoners in the capital city prison came from the front, and they know the war the board does not show.
steps: Hear a prisoner's account of the front.
quests.line: The Board in the Ash Market

quests.name: Who Gets the Gliders
quests.info: Fire Nation officers have come asking about the gliders.

text.homeSay: The exact words that set off travel, faction work, atonement and the Avatar State.
text.homeMap: Twelve districts on one map: find a place, show one district.
text.ledePeople: Everyone the Four Nations introduce you to, with where to find them.
text.ledePlaces: Cities, temples, villages and wilds, from the poles to the Fire Islands.
text.ledeCreatures: Animals, spirits and the kinds of people the Four Nations send against you.
text.ledeLore: History, bending, society and places of the Four Nations.
text.ledeMechanics: How the world works, as the guide books every new character carries explain it.
text.ledeSkills: The skills of the Four Nations.
text.ledeMusic: The soundtrack of the Four Nations, by the mood of the scene.
text.ledeDistricts: The Four Nations are twelve districts on one map, the Spirit World among them.
text.ledeSay: The lines that set off the world's systems.
text.ledeFactions: The nations, tribes, armies and bands you can swear to, work for or cross.
text.ledeItems: Weapons, armour, remedies, tools, treasures and goods: what each gives, the slot it takes and how you get it.
text.guideSay: Most of the world's systems listen for plain lines.
text.plannerLede: Every pick the creator offers, in its order, with the same unlocks and exclusions. The totals add up what your picks give.
text.benchLede: Build the exact line to type, then run it through the world's own crafting triggers, the same code the game runs, to see what the narrator will be told.
